title: Platform Implementation & Quality Specialist (Shopify / Web QA)
description:
Job Description:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Platform Implementation & Quality Specialist to help us ensure top-tier quality and accuracy for our merchant-facing web experiences. 



In this role, your primary focus will be reviewing and validating completed site implementations, experience builds, bug fixes, and development work prior to release. You will work directly with our internal Development, Support, and Customer Success teams to track down and resolve issues. Additionally, you will support select web experience builds and platform configurations as needed. 



Key Responsibilities

•        Review and validate implementations, web builds, bug fixes, and dev tickets to ensure they meet specifications. 



•        Perform functional, visual, responsive (desktop/mobile), regression, and edge-case testing. 



•        Identify and document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior, and supporting screenshots/recordings. 



•        Collaborate directly with the Development Team to resolve issues and re-verify fixes before release. 



•        Implement minor merchant-requested changes and configure web platform experiences based on approved requirements. 



•        Maintain clear documentation and seamless communication across our dev and support teams. 



Requirements

•        Experience: 1+ years in web Quality Assurance (QA), platform configuration, web implementation, or website content management. 



•        Ticketing Systems: Proven experience using tools like HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Jira, or similar. 



•        Core Technical Skills: Proficiency in HTML and CSS. 



•        QA & Testing Expertise: Strong functional, visual, responsive, and edge-case testing skills with high attention to detail. 



•        Communication: Excellent written and verbal English skills. Must be able to document findings clearly and communicate effectively. 



Nice-to-Haves / Advantages:

•        Hands-on experience with Shopify or e-commerce, CMS, and personalization platforms. 



•        Familiarity with JavaScript and browser Developer Tools (Chrome DevTools). 



•        Experience or familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) platforms. 





How to Apply:



To apply, please reply with:



•        A working link to your updated resume.



•        A cover letter detailing your hands-on experience with QA and HTML/CSS.



•        Use QA as the subject title of your application message.



Note: We will only review candidates who strictly follow the application instructions above.

title: Experienced Senior Project Manager (Amazon FBA | Full-Time)
description:
# Join a Fast-Growing E-Commerce Brand Based in Singapore



We’re a fast-growing Singapore-based Amazon FBA brand looking for a highly capable **Amazon E-Commerce Director / Senior Project Manager** to help us scale.



This is not a coordinator role.



We’re looking for someone who can **see the big picture while being highly meticulous with the details**. You should be comfortable managing people, analysing data, improving systems, identifying problems early, and taking ownership of execution.



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



You’ll oversee a team of around 6 people across listings, design, and operations.



You’ll manage product launches and Amazon projects from planning through execution.



You’ll review sales, profitability, advertising, inventory, conversion, rankings, and other key data to identify opportunities and risks.



You’ll coordinate suppliers, freight forwarders, inspection agents, inventory planning, production, and shipping.



You’ll review Amazon listings carefully, including keywords, images, backend data, attributes, variations, dimensions, weights, and size tiers.



You’ll maintain accurate dashboards and reporting so management always has a clear view of the business.



You’ll identify bottlenecks and recurring problems, then improve the systems behind them rather than repeatedly fixing the same issues.



## We Want Someone Data-Driven



You should naturally ask questions like:



Why did sales increase or decrease?



Where are we losing margin?



Which products are underperforming and why?



Are we ordering too much or too little inventory?



What are the biggest risks over the next 30, 60, or 90 days?



We do not want someone who simply reports numbers.



We want someone who can **interpret the data, identify what matters, and recommend what we should do next.**



## Attention to Detail Matters



Amazon is a business where small mistakes can become expensive quickly.



Wrong dimensions, incorrect listing data, inventory mistakes, inaccurate spreadsheets, or missed shipping timelines can directly affect profitability.



You should be naturally **careful, structured, meticulous, and willing to double-check important work before execution.**



## Think Like a Director



We want someone who can gradually operate at a director level.



You should be able to understand where the business is going, what the team should prioritise, what risks management should know about, and which processes need improvement.



You should not need to be told every single thing to do.



If you see a problem, raise it.



If you see an opportunity, propose it.



If something does not make sense, question it.



## Managing People



You’ll manage and coordinate a team of around 6 people.



You should be able to set clear expectations, assign responsibilities, track progress, identify bottlenecks, and hold people accountable without simply chasing for updates.



## AI and Technology



We actively use AI to improve research, listings, analysis, reporting, operations, and project management.



AI is a tool, not a replacement for thinking.



We expect you to use it to work faster and make better decisions while still applying your own judgment and checking the output carefully.



## Tools You’ll Use



Amazon Seller Central

Google Sheets and Docs

Notion

Helium 10

DataDive

Zoom

AI tools and internal systems



## What We’re Looking For



At least **5 years of relevant experience**, ideally in Amazon FBA or e-commerce operations.



Strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and backend workflows.



Experience with listings, inventory, product launches, and operational processes.



Strong analytical skills and confidence working with spreadsheets and dashboards.



Excellent attention to detail.



Experience managing people and multiple projects.



Strong problem-solving and communication skills.



Commercial awareness and an understanding of how decisions affect revenue, profit, cash flow, and growth.



Able to work independently without constant supervision.



Proactive, open-minded, and comfortable challenging assumptions when something can be improved.



## Working Hours



Monday to Friday

12 PM to 10 PM Singapore time

1-hour break

Remote

44 hours per week



## How to Apply



Please include:



A short introduction and why you’re a good fit.



Clear details of your Amazon FBA experience.



Your most recent role and what you personally owned.



Examples or references to Amazon brands or projects you have worked on.



Examples of teams or projects you have managed.



A short video introduction if possible.



Please also tell us about **one Amazon or e-commerce problem you identified through data, what you discovered, and what action you took.**



## Important



Only candidates with genuine Amazon FBA experience will be considered.



This role is for someone who can already operate independently and contribute at a senior level.



We’re looking for someone who can become a **key operator in the business: someone we can trust with the numbers, the people, the details, and the bigger picture.**

Excellent communication skills

THE ROLE

 sequences

Assisting with
 marketing, newsletters and nurture sequences

Basic video editing for social media, courses and promotional content

Creating and formatting printable resources, worksheets, activities and teacher/parent resources

Managing and organising digital files and business resources

 correspondence and general inbox support

Researching and pitching me as a guest to relevant podcasts

Website and landing page updates where required

Repurposing existing content across
, social media, podcast and other platforms

Research and general administrative support

Helping keep projects organised, moving and actually finished!



WHO I’M LOOKING FOR



You’ll suit this role if you’re someone who can be given an idea such as, “I want to create this resource/program/campaign” and confidently help turn it into something polished and functional.



I value someone who asks questions when needed, but who can also research, problem-solve and suggest a better way of doing something.



You don’t need to know absolutely everything, but you do need to be tech-confident, resourceful and willing to learn.



Experience working with coaches, course creators, educators, wellbeing businesses or online programs would be highly regarded.



HOURS/PAY



Hours: 5-10 hours per week initially, with the potential for additional hours as the role develops.

Pay: $12/hour

Inclusive of holiday and sick pay.

This is a work-from-home position.



HOW TO APPLY



To help me find the right person, please do not apply via DM.



Please send your application to:







Your application must include:



A short cover letter

Your current CV/resume

References

Examples or a portfolio of relevant Canva/design, social media, funnel,
 marketing or digital work where available

Details of your experience using Ivorey and/or GoHighLevel



Please answer these two questions in your cover letter:



1. Tell me specifically about your experience using Ivorey or GoHighLevel. What have you personally built, managed or maintained within the platform?



2. Imagine I tell you, “I want to create a new downloadable mindfulness resource, add it to my website/portal, create the
 sequence to promote it and prepare the social media content.” How would you approach the project from start to finish?



I’m looking for someone who would love to become a valued part of the business rather than simply tick tasks off a list.



If you’re organised, creative, confident with digital systems and genuinely enjoy helping ideas come to life, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Book Writer – Non-Fiction Books
description:
About the Role



MarketX Inc. is looking for a skilled and experienced Full-Time Book Writer for BraveMind Publishing, the company’s modern publishing brand.



We are looking for a BOOK WRITER with prior experience working with a publishing company, editorial team, book production team, self-publishing company, or similar professional writing environment. The applicant must have written at least one complete nonfiction, self-help, motivational, educational, or business-related book from cover to cover.



The ideal candidate must be capable of developing, writing, improving, and polishing nonfiction manuscripts in Taglish and/or English for Filipino readers. This role requires strong understanding of book structure, manuscript flow, chapter development, reader engagement, and the overall publishing process.



AI tools may be used as part of research, outline, grammar check and idea development. However, the final manuscript must be human-refined, original, well-structured, natural, practical, and suitable for the target market. We are not looking for someone who simply copies AI-generated content. We need a professional writer who can use AI wisely at its limit while applying creativity, judgment, research, and strong writing skills.



Key Responsibilities

Write nonfiction book manuscripts in Taglish and/or English.

Develop chapter outlines, book flow, titles, subtitles, examples, exercises, and key takeaways.

Improve rough drafts, AI-assisted drafts, and existing manuscript materials.

Make content engaging, practical, relatable, and easy to understand.

Organize ideas into a clear, logical, and reader-friendly book structure.

Write in a tone suitable for Filipino mass-market readers.

Remove repetitive, generic, boring, overly academic, or AI-sounding content.

Research topics, reader problems, examples, and references when needed.

Ensure consistency in tone, message, structure, and chapter flow.

Coordinate with the publishing and editorial team for revisions and improvements.

Revise manuscripts based on feedback, editorial direction, and publishing requirements.

Meet agreed deadlines while maintaining quality output.

Qualifications

Must have experience as a Book Writer, Manuscript Writer, Content Writer, Ghostwriter, or Nonfiction Writer.

Must have written at least one complete nonfiction, self-help, motivational, educational, or business-related book from cover to cover.

Preferably with experience working in a publishing company, book production team, editorial team, or self-publishing company.

Strong background in writing books, ebooks, long-form content, educational materials, or practical guide materials.

Excellent writing, grammar, structure, and content organization skills.

Can write naturally in Taglish and/or English.

Understands Filipino readers and practical nonfiction writing style.

Knowledgeable in using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms as part of the writing workflow.

Can improve AI-assisted content instead of simply copying or relying on AI output.

Creative, detail-oriented, organized, and deadline-driven.

Can follow instructions and work independently.

Open to feedback, revisions, and editorial direction.

Preferred Experience



Experience writing or developing any of the following is a strong advantage:



Business books

Self-help books

Motivational books

Educational books

Practical guide books

Filipino or Taglish nonfiction books

Ebooks or printed books for publishing

Social media, marketing, or sales-driven content

AI-assisted manuscript development

Expected Output Per Manuscript



The selected writer may be assigned to produce, improve, or finalize the following:



Chapter outline or improved book structure

Written manuscript draft

Revised manuscript after feedback

Clean final manuscript version

Editorial notes or list of concerns, if any

Research notes or references used, if applicable

Skills Test



Shortlisted applicants will be given a short writing test to assess:



Writing quality

Creativity

Clarity

Grammar

Book structure

Content organization

AI-assisted writing workflow

Ability to write for Filipino readers



The test will be used strictly for SKILLS ASSESMENT PURPOSE ONLY.



How to Apply



Interested applicants may send the following to:







Please include:



Updated resume/CV

Sample written book, ebook, article, or long-form content, if available



Short introduction about your writing and publishing experience

Portfolio or sample manuscript, if available


 Subject Line:

Application – Publishing Book Writer



Important: Applicants who send their complete application requirements directly through email will be given priority in the review process.

Company: MarketX Inc.

Assigned Brand: BraveMind Publishing

Work Setup: Remote / Work From Home

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Schedule: Compressed. Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:30 PM Philippine Time

Break: 1-hour break included

title: Publishing Book Writer – Business and Motivational Books
description:
Company: MarketX Inc.

Assigned Brand: BraveMind Publishing

Work Setup: Remote / Work From Home

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Schedule: Compressed. Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:30 PM Philippine Time

Break: 1-hour break included

Total Work Hours: 48 hours per week under a compressed workweek schedule



About the Role



MarketX Inc. is looking for a skilled and experienced Full-Time Book Writer for BraveMind Publishing, the company’s modern publishing brand.



We are looking for a writer with prior experience working with a publishing company, editorial team, book production team, self-publishing company, or similar professional writing environment. The applicant must have written at least one complete nonfiction, self-help, motivational, educational, or business-related book from cover to cover.



The ideal candidate must be capable of developing, writing, improving, and polishing nonfiction manuscripts in Taglish and/or English for Filipino readers. This role requires strong understanding of book structure, manuscript flow, chapter development, reader engagement, and the overall publishing process.



AI tools may be used as part of research, outline, grammar check and idea development. However, the final manuscript must be human-refined, original, well-structured, natural, practical, and suitable for the target market. We are not looking for someone who simply copies AI-generated content. We need a professional writer who can use AI wisely at its limit while applying creativity, judgment, research, and strong writing skills.



Key Responsibilities

Write nonfiction book manuscripts in Taglish and/or English.

Develop chapter outlines, book flow, titles, subtitles, examples, exercises, and key takeaways.

Improve rough drafts, AI-assisted drafts, and existing manuscript materials.

Make content engaging, practical, relatable, and easy to understand.

Organize ideas into a clear, logical, and reader-friendly book structure.

Write in a tone suitable for Filipino mass-market readers.

Remove repetitive, generic, boring, overly academic, or AI-sounding content.

Research topics, reader problems, examples, and references when needed.

Ensure consistency in tone, message, structure, and chapter flow.

Coordinate with the publishing and editorial team for revisions and improvements.

Revise manuscripts based on feedback, editorial direction, and publishing requirements.

Meet agreed deadlines while maintaining quality output.

Qualifications

Must have experience as a Book Writer, Manuscript Writer, Content Writer, Ghostwriter, or Nonfiction Writer.

Must have written at least one complete nonfiction, self-help, motivational, educational, or business-related book from cover to cover.

Preferably with experience working in a publishing company, book production team, editorial team, or self-publishing company.

Strong background in writing books, ebooks, long-form content, educational materials, or practical guide materials.

Excellent writing, grammar, structure, and content organization skills.

Can write naturally in Taglish and/or English.

Understands Filipino readers and practical nonfiction writing style.

Knowledgeable in using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms as part of the writing workflow.

Can improve AI-assisted content instead of simply copying or relying on AI output.

Creative, detail-oriented, organized, and deadline-driven.

Can follow instructions and work independently.

Open to feedback, revisions, and editorial direction.

Preferred Experience



Experience writing or developing any of the following is a strong advantage:



Business books

Self-help books

Motivational books

Educational books

Practical guide books

Filipino or Taglish nonfiction books

Ebooks or printed books for publishing

Social media, marketing, or sales-driven content

AI-assisted manuscript development

Expected Output Per Manuscript



The selected writer may be assigned to produce, improve, or finalize the following:



Chapter outline or improved book structure

Written manuscript draft

Revised manuscript after feedback

Clean final manuscript version

Editorial notes or list of concerns, if any

Research notes or references used, if applicable

Skills Test



Shortlisted applicants will be given a short writing test to assess:



Writing quality

Creativity

Clarity

Grammar

Book structure

Content organization

AI-assisted writing workflow

Ability to write for Filipino readers



The test will be used strictly for skills assessment purposes only.



How to Apply



Interested applicants may send the following to:







Please include:



Updated resume/CV

Sample written book, ebook, article, or long-form content, if available



Short introduction about your writing and publishing experience

Portfolio or sample manuscript, if available


 Subject Line:

Application – Publishing Book Writer



Important: Applicants who send their complete application requirements directly through email will be given priority in the review process.

title: Principal Go Backend Engineer / Hands-On Architect — US SaaS
description:
Apruv is a growing U.S.-based SaaS company looking for an exceptional backend engineer to join our engineering team full-time.



This is not a traditional “software architect” position where you spend your time creating diagrams and attending meetings. We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on engineer who can make strong architectural decisions and then build those systems in production.



Our backend is primarily Go and PostgreSQL, running on Google Cloud and Kubernetes. We build real-time integrations, event-driven systems, APIs, background processing pipelines, data infrastructure, AI-powered products, and services that integrate with many third-party platforms.



You will work directly with Apruv's CTO and existing engineering team.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Architect and build production backend systems in Go

• Own significant features and services from design through deployment

• Design reliable event-driven and asynchronous processing systems

• Build and maintain third-party API and webhook integrations

• Design PostgreSQL schemas, queries, migrations, and data access patterns

• Solve concurrency, idempotency, retry, rate-limiting, and distributed-systems problems

• Work with Kubernetes and Google Cloud infrastructure

• Debug difficult production issues and improve system reliability

• Review backend code and help establish engineering patterns

• Help other engineers make better technical decisions

• Identify architectural problems before they become large problems

• Ship production code frequently



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for an unusually strong backend engineer rather than someone who simply checks technology boxes.



Ideal experience includes:



• 7+ years professional software engineering experience

• Significant production Go experience

• Strong PostgreSQL/database knowledge

• Distributed systems and event-driven architectures

• REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations

• Kubernetes and Docker

• GCP, AWS, or similar cloud infrastructure

• Queues, background jobs, retries, and asynchronous processing

• Observability, monitoring, and production debugging

• Designing systems for reliability and scale



Experience with Pub/Sub, Kafka, Redis, gRPC, Terraform, Prometheus/Grafana, WebRTC, or high-volume data processing is a plus.



You should be comfortable independently taking a business problem, understanding the existing system, proposing a solution, and implementing it without needing detailed step-by-step instructions.



AI DEVELOPMENT



We actively use modern AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and similar tools.



We care about engineering judgment and the amount of high-quality software you can ship—not whether you wrote every character manually.



You should already be comfortable with AI-assisted development or excited to become extremely good at it.



WORKING HOURS



This position requires FULL overlap with our U.S. engineering team:



9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Mountain Time, Monday–Friday.



This means working overnight hours in the Philippines. Please only apply if you are comfortable maintaining this schedule long-term.



This is a full-time, long-term position. We are looking for someone who wants to become an important member of the Apruv engineering team, not someone managing several freelance clients simultaneously.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A short explanation of the most technically challenging backend system you personally designed and built.



2. Your specific experience with Go in production.



3. An example of a difficult production problem you diagnosed and how you found the cause.



4. Your experience with PostgreSQL and distributed/event-driven systems.



5. Your current use of AI coding tools.



6. Confirmation that you can consistently work 9 AM–5 PM Mountain Time.



7. Your GitHub, LinkedIn, portfolio, or other examples of your work, if available.



Please start your application with the word "GOPHER" so we know you read the complete posting.



We will interview selected candidates directly and may invite finalists to complete a short PAID technical exercise. AI tools will be allowed during the exercise.

I film talking-head videos teaching one money play at a time, and every video ends with a comment keyword CTA that sends viewers a guide in the DMs. 



I try to batch film, but i am extremely busy and typically will get video day before for the next day. Your job is to take my raw footage and scripts and turn them into finished videos using a premade editing assembly guide, on a reliable weekly rhythm.



What you'll do



Edit 7 short-form vertical videos per week (30 to 90 seconds, 9:16) from raw talking-head footage plus a script I provide

Edit 1 long-form video per week (8 to 15 minutes, 16:9) from the same kind of raw footage: chapter pacing, pattern interrupts, and b-roll placement that holds attention past the intro

Cut for retention: tight pacing, dead air removed, the hook landing in the first 2 seconds on shorts, a visual change every few seconds

Add word-by-word captions on short-form 

Overlay b-roll and screen recordings of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, and similar) at the exact moments the script references them; I'll provide most screen recordings, you'll trim and place them.

Add simple text callouts for numbers and prices when the script names them ($500 setup fee, $200/month retainer, etc.)

End every video with the comment-keyword CTA on screen, exactly as written in the script

Deliver short-form first cuts within 12-24 hours of receiving footage, the long-form within 2 days, revisions within 2 hours

Basic editing tricks like punch ins, etc





Captions are readable on mute; most of my audience watches without sound

On-screen text uses the script's wording exactly. Never paraphrase a price, a claim, or the CTA keyword

Never use an em dash in any on-screen text. Use a colon, comma, or period instead



You're a fit if:

You've edited short-form business or educational content before, and at least some long-form YouTube-style content 

You can hold a consistent template look across dozens of videos without drifting

You work with any editing software and can match an existing caption style from a reference video

Your English is strong enough to catch when a caption doesn't match the spoken audio

You hit deadlines without being chased



Pay and hours



6$/hour 20 hours a week



How to apply



Send Any examples of work/portfolio as stated below:

2 to 3 examples of short-form videos you edited yourself, ideally business, finance, or educational content

1 long-form video you edited

Tell me which editing software you use and your typical turnaround for a 60-120 second reel and a 10-minute video

title: Twitch VOD Editor for YouTube — Timestamped Segments, A$50 Per Video
description:

I provide the start and end timestamps for each segment. The segment usually starts with my recorded “Hi YouTube” introduction and contains 1–2 hours of footage, occasionally up to 3 hours. You do not need to search entire streams to find a video idea.

Pay: A$50 AUD per completed video, including the agreed edit and one minor revision round. Please confirm this rate works for you for the stated scope. Flag whether occasional 3-hour segments fit this rate before accepting work. We agree any exception before editing begins.

- Confirmation that A$50 AUD per video works for you.

- Your usual turnaround for a timestamped 1–2-hour source segment, and how many videos you can handle weekly.

- Your editing software and ability to download/upload large video files.

title: Senior Systems & Network Engineer – Proxmox, Microsoft 365 and SonicWall | Remote Philippines
description:
# Senior Systems & Network Engineer  

### Tier 3 MSP Support | Remote – Philippines



## About Consuro



Consuro is a U.S.-based managed IT services company that has been helping businesses manage and improve their technology since 2008.



We are expanding our technical team and looking for an experienced Senior Systems & Network Engineer based in the Philippines. You will work closely with our Philippine and U.S. teams, serving as a senior escalation resource and helping deliver infrastructure projects for our managed-service clients.



This is a long-term, full-time independent-contractor opportunity for someone who enjoys solving difficult technical problems, taking ownership of client environments, and helping other technicians succeed.



## About the Role



You will support and manage client infrastructure across networking, Windows Server, virtualization, storage, Microsoft 365, identity, virtual desktops, backup, and security.



This is a senior technical position—not an entry-level help-desk role. You will be expected to diagnose complex issues independently, communicate directly with clients and team members, lead infrastructure projects, and take problems through to a successful resolution.



## Key Responsibilities



- Serve as a Tier 3 escalation resource for the Philippine and U.S. technical teams.

- Take ownership of complex i
 and service requests from initial investigation through resolution.

- Troubleshoot network, server, virtualization, storage, identity, Microsoft 365, backup, and security issues.

- Design, deploy, configure, and maintain network environments using SonicWall, Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, and Dell technologies.

- Configure and troubleshoot firewalls, switches, wireless networks, VLANs, routing, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, and multi-site connectivity.

- Deploy, configure, and administer Proxmox Virtual Environment.

- Manage Proxmox hosts, clusters, virtual machines, containers, storage, backups, replication, and high-availability configurations.

- Administer Microsoft Active Directory, including domain controllers, users, groups, Group Policy, permissions, DNS, DHCP, trusts, and replication.

- Provision, configure, secure, and manage Microsoft 365 tenants, users, licenses, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and related services.

- Plan and perform integrations and migrations between on-premises Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID/Microsoft 365.

- Configure and manage identity synchronization, multifactor authentication, Conditional Access, and single sign-on.

- Administer virtual desktop and remote-application environments, including user access, profiles, applications, capacity, and performance.

- Deploy and configure new physical and virtual Windows Servers.

- Perform server upgrades, migrations, patching, performance tuning, and lifecycle management.

- Deploy, configure, and administer enterprise storage systems, including Dell Storage Center/SC Series systems, formerly known as Compellent.

- Administer backup, replication, disaster-recovery, and business-continuity systems.

- Review monitoring alerts, identify root causes, and implement permanent corrective actions.

- Improve infrastructure security through system hardening, patch management, access controls, multifactor authentication, and vulnerability remediation.

- Plan technical changes, evaluate risks, communicate expected impacts, and perform post-change validation.

- Create and maintain accurate technical documentation, network diagrams, procedures, standards, and client configuration records.

- Mentor junior and intermediate technicians and share technical knowledge with the team.

- Communicate with clients professionally and explain technical issues in clear, understandable language.

- Participate in scheduled after-hours maintenance and escalation coverage when required.



## Required Qualifications



- At least five years of progressive experience in systems administration, network engineering, infrastructure engineering, or advanced technical support.

- Experience serving as a senior or Tier 3 escalation resource.

- Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server and Active Directory.

- Strong understanding of TCP/IP, subnetting, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, VPNs, wireless networking, and firewall administration.

- Hands-on experience administering Proxmox VE or comparable enterprise virtualization platforms.

- Experience administering SonicWall firewalls.

- Experience with Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, Dell, or comparable business networking equipment.

- Strong Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID administration experience.

- Experience integrating or migrating on-premises Active Directory environments with Microsoft 365 and Entra ID.

- Experience deploying and supporting physical and virtual Windows Servers.

- Experience administering virtual desktop or Remote Desktop Services environments.

- Working knowledge of enterprise storage, RAID, SAN, NAS, iSCSI, and storage networking.

- Experience managing backup systems and performing successful file, server, and virtual-machine recoveries.

- Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues methodically and independently.

- Ability to research unfamiliar problems and make sound technical recommendations.

- Strong understanding of security best practices, least-privilege access, multifactor authentication, patching, and system hardening.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Strong technical writing and documentation skills.

- Excellent customer-service, organizational, and time-management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities across different client environments.

- Reliable high-speed internet and a suitable professional remote-work environment.

- Ability to provide coverage during an agreed schedule that includes regular overlap with U.S. business hours.



## Preferred Qualifications



Experience in the following areas is highly desirable:



- Managed service provider experience

- Proxmox clustering, high availability, replication, and backup

- SonicWall Network Security Manager

- Ubiquiti UniFi switching and wireless administration

- Cisco and Dell switching

- Dell Storage Center/SC Series/Compellent storage

- Microsoft Entra Connect or Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync

- Active Directory and Microsoft 365 migration projects

- Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, and SharePoint administration

- Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, and endpoint management

- Microsoft Defender and Microsoft 365 security tools

- Azure infrastructure or Azure Virtual Desktop

- Remote Desktop Services, Citrix, VMware Horizon, or other virtual desktop platforms

- VMware vSphere or Microsoft Hyper-V

- Veeam or comparable backup and disaster-recovery platforms

- PowerShell scripting and infrastructure automation

- Remote monitoring and management platforms

- Professional services automation and ticketing systems

- IT service-management processes, including i
, problem, and change management

- Relevant Microsoft, Cisco, SonicWall, Dell, VMware, or Proxmox certifications



A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred but not required. Demonstrated technical ability, professional experience, sound judgment, and a record of successful project delivery are more important than a particular degree.



## The Person We Are Looking For



Our ideal candidate is:



- Dependable and accountable

- Proactive and self-directed

- Calm and methodical under pressure

- Comfortable taking ownership of difficult problems

- Security-conscious and attentive to detail

- Customer-service oriented

- Contractual 13th-month payment

- Healthcare allowance

- Company-provided computer and required technical equipment

- Regular collaboration with Philippine and U.S. team members

The selected contractor will be responsible for their own Philippine tax registration, filings, and other obligations applicable to self-employed professionals.



This is a direct engagement with Consuro. We are looking for an individual professional, not an agency or subcontracting company.



## How to Apply



Please submit your résumé and answer the following questions:



1. How many years of experience do you have in systems and network administration?

2. Describe the most complex infrastructure problem you personally diagnosed and resolved.

3. Describe your experience integrating or migrating on-premises Active Directory with Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID.

4. Describe your hands-on experience with Proxmox, including any work with clusters, storage, high availability, replication, or backup.

5. Rate your hands-on experience with each of the following: SonicWall, UniFi, Cisco, Dell networking, Windows Server, Microsoft 365, virtual desktops, and Dell Compellent.

6. Have you worked for a managed service provider? If so, describe your responsibilities and the types of clients you supported.

7. Are you comfortable providing service coverage that overlaps with U.S. business hours?

8. What monthly contract fee are you seeking?

9. When would you be available to begin?



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term relationship with Consuro and becoming an important senior resource for our global technical team.

We are an AI content agency that's strongly committed to creating the AI content of the highest quality and realism to help reach new heights for our clients while creating the culture and environment that simply makes you better as an AI creator.



The ideal candidate will have already worked their way through the low-quality AI outputs with unrealistic background sounds and motions, knows how to operate and prompts in AI generation tools and is now ready for the next step in their journey.



You should be comfortable focusing mostly on yourself and love thinking deeply about how "real" looks like and how to get it out of AI models. You have already created viral AI videos and you know that a great video comes from great inputs. You know how to make any product look natural and authentic. You are a driven person who turns scripts into reality with AI generation tools, and you love to analyze your generations to see what you can improve.



You will get to work with passionate and driven creators who excel at what they do. You will be a part of a culture where everyone likes to help each other, gives honest feedback to each other and strives to be their best. You will make new friends, have fun, and be around people who are serious about what they do. You will get to learn from courses, videos, and other sources that will help you grow and improve your AI creation and how to apply it to your content the best way.



What we do



- We create and turn organic AI content ideas into videos, for social media platforms that helps brands increase their revenue

- Our agency is a team full of passionate and driven AI creators who work together side by side and like to be challenged

- We create a friendly and competitive culture where each of us can individually grow and have fun

- Education is very important to us, so we help creators on how to constantly improve in content and AI creation

- We believe in every member of our team and make it the highest priority to ensure everyone has what they need to make their content successful

- we break down content and provide honest feedback to make each of us learn, improve and grow



Who we are looking for



- A content creator with a deep understanding of AI content creation and a strong feel for realism

- An individual who is driven, competitive, and passionate about AI content

- Someone who loves to turn scripts and ideas into finished videos with AI on a continual basis



Your role



- You will generate realistic images based on the idea/concept given to you and turn them together with script into clips with Veo Omni, Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0 or other up-to-date video models

- You will work with reference images and starting/ending frames and write prompts that tell the model exactly what to do

- You will create voiceovers in ElevenLabs or other apps with similar functioning when the video needs them

- You will do simple editing by connecting all your generations together, cutting out the silences, and adding captivating add-ons, captions and headlines to finalize your video for posting

- You will take part in meetings where your content will be reviewed, and you will receive direct feedback

- You will analyze your generations and your metrics in order to keep your content realistic, unique and attractive



Things that should resonate with you



- You already have a great amount of experience with creating AI content on a daily basis

- You have already generated a significant amount of views with content created by AI

- When you watch an AI video, you can instantly tell what breaks the realism and how to fix it



What we expect from you



- You have a deep understanding of AI realism. You know how "real" looks like, how physics behaves on camera, and you apply it directly to your generations

- Image generation is very close to you. You know how to generate authentic and realistic images with Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2.0, Seedream, or other up-to-date image models

- You have already generated AI UGC content with Omni, Kling 3.0, and Seedance 2.5. You possess high level prompting skills and understand video generation to its core

- You know that the quality of the output is d
 by the quality of the inputs, and you take your time with references, frames and prompts

- You can edit your generations into a flawless final video from start to end

- You take ownership of your work, and you are not afraid of new challenges

- You love learning new things, and you have a strong desire to prove yourself you can be even better at what you do

- You speak English fluently, and you use it and understand it at a high level



We are here to push the limits with organic AI content while helping clients reach new heights. Everyone here is serious and loves to create content with AI. We respect each other, help each other, and grow together while having fun in the process. There are no egoistic people here, only humble ones. title: SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGER
description:
🇺🇸 Growing U.S.-Based Tours Company | Content + Engagement + Growth



We are a fast-growing U.S.-based tours company looking for a creative, aggressive, and results-driven Social Media Manager to take ownership of our social media presence.



We are NOT looking for someone who simply posts a few pictures, writes generic captions, and calls it a day.



We need someone who understands that social media is a business tool.



Your job is to help us grow our audience, increase engagement, build our brand, showcase our tours, generate interest, and ultimately help drive customers and bookings.



🔥 IF YOU'RE CREATIVE, FAST, AND OBSESSED WITH SOCIAL MEDIA — KEEP READING.

🎯 WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

📱 Social Media Management



Manage and grow our social media accounts across platforms such as:



Instagram


TikTok

YouTube Shorts

Pinterest

Other relevant platforms



You will be responsible for keeping our social media presence active, attractive, consistent, and engaging.



🎥 CONTENT CREATION



You will help create content that makes people want to travel, explore, and book a tour.



Responsibilities include:



Creating engaging posts

Creating Instagram Reels

Creating TikTok videos

Creating YouTube Shorts

Creating travel-related graphics

Writing captions

Creating content ideas

Finding trending topics and formats

Repurposing existing content

Creating promotional content for tours

Highlighting destinations and experiences

Creating content around customer experiences

Developing content themes and series

Maintaining a consistent brand voice



You should be able to look at a destination or tour and think:



"How can we turn this into content people actually want to watch?"



🚀 GROWTH & ENGAGEMENT



We don't just want followers.



We want attention, engagement, interest, and ultimately customers.



You will:



Research social media trends

Identify trending sounds, formats, topics, and hashtags

Monitor competitors

Research successful travel accounts

Improve content based on performance

Respond to comments and messages

Engage with relevant audiences

Encourage conversations

Identify opportunities for organic growth

Track social media performance

Test different content styles

Continuously improve our strategy

DON'T JUST POST.



THINK. TEST. ANALYZE. IMPROVE.



🧳 TRAVEL & TOUR CONTENT



Our business is all about experiences.



You will help showcase:



Tours

Destinations

Attractions

Activities

Travel experiences

Local experiences

Hotels and accommodations

Food and entertainment

Travel tips

Destination guides

Customer experiences

Special offers

Seasonal travel opportunities



The goal is to make someone scrolling through their phone think:



"I WANT TO GO THERE."

📊 ANALYTICS & REPORTING



You will monitor important metrics such as:



Reach

Impressions

Engagement

Views

Watch time

Followers

Profile visits

Clicks

Leads

Content performance



You should be able to identify:



What is working?



What isn't working?



Why?



What should we do differently next time?



We want someone who uses data to make better decisions — not someone who simply says:



"The post got 500 views."



💻 TOOLS & SOFTWARE



You should be comfortable learning and using tools such as:



Canva

Meta Business Suite

Instagram


TikTok

YouTube

Google Drive

Google Sheets

Content scheduling platforms

Basic video editing software



Experience with CapCut or similar video-editing software is a major plus.



You don't need to know every tool already.



You DO need to be extremely comfortable learning new tools quickly.



🔥 WE NEED SOMEONE WHO...

Understands social media

Is naturally creative

Has excellent attention to detail

Writes good English

Understands what makes content engaging

Can create content independently

Is constantly watching trends

Has strong visual taste

Understands short-form video

Can work quickly

Can meet deadlines

Takes ownership

Is organized

Is proactive

Can work without constant supervision

Is comfortable experimenting

Is willing to learn

Actually cares about results



We want someone who can take ownership of our social media and help build something.



⭐ EXPERIENCE THAT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT



Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:



Travel social media

Tourism

Hotels

Hospitality

Travel agencies

Tour operators

Destination marketing

E-commerce

Digital marketing

Content marketing

Short-form video

Instagram growth

TikTok growth

 marketing

YouTube Shorts

Canva

CapCut

Meta Business Suite

Social media analytics



Portfolio or examples of social media accounts/content you've managed are highly valuable.



🚀 GROW WITH US



We are a growing U.S.-based company, and we want people who want to grow with the company.



As we expand, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility in:



Social media strategy

Content strategy

Digital marketing

Paid advertising

Influencer marketing

Brand management

Campaign management

Marketing operations



We want someone who can start by managing social media and eventually become a key part of our marketing team.



🔥 BOTTOM LINE



We don't want someone who waits for instructions.



We want someone who sees an opportunity and says:



"Let's try this."



We want someone who sees a boring post and thinks:



"We can make this better."



We want someone who sees a trending video and thinks:



"How can we adapt this for our business?"



We want someone who looks at the analytics and asks:



"How do we improve?"



If that's you — APPLY.



If you're just looking for a job where you can post content, clock out, and forget about it...



PLEASE DON'T APPLY.



We are looking for someone who wants to build, experiment, grow, and win with us.

title: Shopify Web Designer / Graphic Designer
description:
Dear Applicants,



## Shopify Web Designer / Graphic Designer – We're Hiring! ##



We're looking for a Shopify Web Designer / Graphic Designer who can genuinely do the job well. One day you might be rebuilding a product page to convert better, the next designing the banners and creatives for a new launch. If you love turning ideas into a clean, on-brand storefront that sells, and you can show us work that proves it, this role is for you.



IMPORTANT: We value responsible, self-motivated people who take ownership of their work and can deliver quality work with minimal supervision.



Job Scope:

• Build, customise, and maintain pages on our Shopify store (landing pages, product pages, collection pages, and campaign pages)

• Customise the Shopify theme and work with page builder apps such as Shogun, GemPages, or PageFly to create clean, high-converting layouts

• Design storefront and marketing graphics: banners, hero images, product graphics, infographics, and promotional creatives

• Create on-brand visual assets for email (EDMs), social media, and ad campaigns

• Ensure every page is mobile-responsive, fast-loading, and visually consistent with our brand guidelines

• Update and optimise pages and creatives for launches, promotions, and seasonal campaigns

• Work with the marketing and product teams to turn briefs into polished, on-brand designs

• Keep a consistent look and feel across the store and all marketing touchpoints



You should be comfortable with:

• Shopify theme customisation and at least one page builder app (Shogun, GemPages, PageFly, or similar)

• Core design tools such as Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or Canva

• Building mobile-responsive, fast-loading pages

• A good eye for layout, typography, spacing, and brand consistency



Note:

• Full-time basis, 40 hrs/week

• Monday to Friday

• 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holidays Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines) included



IMPORTANT: When applying, please provide:

• Your CV/Resume

• A short video introduction of yourself and why you think you're a good fit

• Why you are leaving your last job or what you were doing just before this application

• A portfolio or examples of Shopify pages and graphic design work you have created previously.



Applications without the above points will be less considered.



P.S. Please format your replies in point form according to the items asked above, e.g.:

My resume is here:

Video introduction here:

I am currently doing... / I am leaving because...

Here are examples of my work...



The more information you provide in your initial application, the better.



Best regards,

Loo Yi

title: AI Video Creator & Meta Ads Editor — Animation, Song Ads, UGC & VSLs
description:
AI Video Creator & Meta Ads Editor — Animation, Song Ads, UGC & VSLs



We’re looking for an experienced AI video creator and direct-response editor to produce Meta ads for men’s skincare and health products targeting ages 30–60.



You must be able to take a script or concept, generate the assets, and turn them into a finished ad that grabs attention, holds interest, and sells.



What You’ll Create



Most ads will be 30–90 seconds, with occasional 2–3 minute VSLs. Formats include:



AI animation ads: talking characters, animated objects, expressive characters, and product-focused storytelling.

AI song ads: catchy songs, jingles, and musical concepts with synchronized vocals, lip-sync, animation, and visuals.

AI UGC ads: natural-looking presenters, believable delivery, and product demonstrations.

Authority-style talking-head videos: educational content with supporting visuals.

Mechanism explainers: animations that make ingredients, product benefits, and how the product works easy to understand.

Direct-response VSLs: combining AI footage, UGC, stock footage, voiceovers, and text overlays.



Required AI Skills



You must have strong, hands-on experience with:



Higgsfield

Google Flow

ElevenLabs

AI lip-sync tools such as Sync

AI UGC generation

AI image, video, and animation tools

AI music and song generation



Knowing the names of these tools is not enough. You should be able to show finished work and explain how you created it.



You must know how to:



Write detailed prompts and iterate until the result is usable.

Create and animate characters with consistent appearances across scenes.

Control expressions, movement, camera angles, and visual style.

Produce talking and singing characters with accurate mouth movements.

Create natural voiceovers with the right emotion, pacing, and pronunciation.

Build song ads where the lyrics, vocals, visuals, and editing work together.

Generate clear product and mechanism animations.

Fix distracting AI artifacts and unnatural movement.

Combine generated assets into a cohesive, polished ad.



Direct-Response Editing Skills



The visuals need to support the message and move the viewer toward a purchase.



You should understand how to:



Build a strong opening hook in the first 3 seconds.

Pace a Meta ad and maintain viewer attention.

Use purposeful pattern interrupts, cuts, punch-ins, and zooms.

Reinforce the script with clear, readable subtitles and text overlays.

Match footage and animation to what the voiceover is saying.

Keep talking-head content engaging.

Create alternative hooks and variations for testing.



You should be comfortable editing in CapCut or another professional editing tool and adapting your style to men aged 30–60.



Who We’re Looking For



Someone who can own the production process—from concept or script to finished video.



You should be able to suggest visual ideas, choose the right tools, solve generation problems, and deliver consistently. Production speed matters, alongside quality and attention to detail.



Experience with direct-response ads for health, skincare, supplements, or men’s products is a strong advantage.



Compensation



Per video or weekly, depending on experience and production capacity.

Long-term collaboration for the right person.

Potential performance bonuses for successful creatives.



How to Apply



Please send:



Your strongest AI animation, song ad, AI UGC, and Meta ad examples.

A brief explanation of which tools you used and what you personally created.

Your rate and availability.

How many finished 30–90 second ads you can realistically produce per week, distinguishing new concepts from simple variations.



Prioritize examples of complete ads, especially animated characters, lip-synced videos, and song ads. We want to see what you can actually produce.

title: Senior Help Desk Technician – Microsoft 365, Windows & MSP Support | Remote Philippines
description:
# Senior Help Desk Technician – Microsoft 365, Windows & MSP Support | Remote Philippines



## About Consuro



Consuro is a U.S.-based managed IT services company that has been helping businesses manage and improve their technology since 2008.



We are expanding our technical support team and looking for an experienced Senior Help Desk Technician based in the Philippines. You will work remotely as part of our established Philippine and U.S. teams, providing responsive and professional technical support to Consuro’s managed-service clients.



This is a long-term opportunity for an experienced technician who can solve problems independently, communicate confidently with clients, take ownership of tickets, and assist less-experienced team members.



## About the Role



The Senior Help Desk Technician will provide advanced remote support for Windows computers, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, applications, mobile devices, printers, connectivity, and other common business technologies.



You will handle escalated help-desk issues, assist with high-priority i
, and help maintain the quality of our service desk. You must be comfortable supporting multiple clients with different environments, priorities, and business needs.



This is a hands-on, client-facing role. Success requires strong troubleshooting skills, excellent English communication, careful documentation, and consistent follow-through.



## Key Responsibilities



- Provide remote technical support through telephone,
, remote-support tools, and our ticketing system.

- Handle escalated Tier 1 and Tier 2 support requests.

- Take ownership of assigned tickets from initial investigation through resolution or appropriate escalation.

- Prioritize work based on urgency, business impact, contractual service targets, and client needs.

- Troubleshoot Windows 10 and Windows 11 desktops, laptops, applications, user profiles, performance problems, and operating-system errors.

- Troubleshoot Microsoft Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and other Microsoft 365 applications.

- Provision and administer Microsoft 365 users, licenses, mailboxes, groups, permissions, and multifactor authentication.

- Troubleshoot Exchange Online mail flow, mailbox access, spam filtering, shared mailboxes, distribution groups, and calendar issues.

- Perform routine Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory administration, including users, groups, passwords, permissions, account lockouts, and computer accounts.

- Complete employee onboarding and offboarding tasks accurately and securely.

- Troubleshoot domain login, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi, internet connectivity, and basic network issues.

- Support printers, scanners, docks, monitors, mobile devices, and other business peripherals.

- Assist users with remote-access and virtual-desktop environments.

- Support endpoint management, device enrollment, application deployment, patching, and compliance policies.

- Troubleshoot endpoint security, antivirus, EDR, phishing, and
-security issues.

- Perform approved routine maintenance and administrative tasks on Windows Servers.

- Review monitoring and backup alerts, perform documented troubleshooting, and escalate when necessary.

- Use remote monitoring, management, documentation, and professional-services automation platforms effectively.

- Identify recurring problems and help develop permanent solutions.

- Create and maintain clear ticket notes, procedures, knowledge-base articles, and client documentation.

- Communicate status, next steps, and resolution details clearly to clients and team members.

- Recognize when an issue requires escalation to a systems, network, security, or project engineer.

- Provide useful diagnostic information and complete documentation when escalating a ticket.

- Assist junior technicians with troubleshooting and ticket-handling questions.

- Help maintain service quality by reviewing procedures, identifying process improvements, and sharing technical knowledge.

- Participate in occasional scheduled maintenance or escalation coverage outside the normal work schedule.



## Required Qualifications



- At least four years of professional IT support, service-desk, desktop-support, or systems-support experience.

- At least two years of experience supporting multiple client environments in an MSP or outsourced IT support organization is strongly preferred.

- Demonstrated experience handling advanced Tier 2 or senior help-desk escalations.

- Strong hands-on knowledge of Windows 10 and Windows 11.

- Strong Microsoft 365 support and administration experience.

- Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and on-premises Active Directory.

- Experience with Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.

- Experience with user onboarding, offboarding, permissions, licensing, and multifactor authentication.

- Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPNs, and basic firewall concepts.

- Experience using ticketing, remote-support, documentation, and remote-monitoring tools.

- Working knowledge of Windows Server environments.

- Understanding of endpoint security, patching, phishing, least-privilege access, and secure support practices.

- Ability to troubleshoot unfamiliar problems through research, testing, and logical analysis.

- Ability to manage multiple tickets without losing accuracy or follow-through.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Strong telephone communication and customer-service skills.

- Ability to explain technical issues clearly to nontechnical users.

- Reliable high-speed internet, backup connectivity, and a suitable professional remote-work environment.

- Ability to work an agreed schedule that includes regular overlap with U.S. business hours.



## Preferred Qualifications



Experience with any of the following is helpful:



- Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot

- Microsoft Defender or other endpoint-detection and response platforms

- Microsoft Entra Conditional Access

- Windows Server, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP

- Azure Virtual Desktop or Microsoft Remote Desktop Services

- SonicWall firewalls

- Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, or Dell networking

- VMware, Hyper-V, or Proxmox virtualization

- Backup and disaster-recovery platforms

- PowerShell scripting

- Voice-over-IP telephone systems

- IT service-management practices

- Supporting executives or other high-priority users

- CompTIA, Microsoft, Cisco, ITIL, or similar certifications



A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred but not required. Relevant experience, technical ability, communication skills, and sound judgment are more important than a specific degree.



## The Person We Are Looking For



Our ideal candidate is:



- Dependable and accountable

- Professional and customer-service oriented

- Calm and courteous under pressure

- Proactive and self-directed

- Organized and attentive to detail

- Comfortable taking ownership of difficult issues

- Able to balance speed with accuracy

- Security-conscious

- Willing to ask for assistance when appropriate

- Interested in sharing knowledge and helping teammates improve

title: TikTok Ops Specialist
description:
We're hiring a TikTok Operator to run and grow our U.S. TikTok Shop. This isn't a content or social media job — it's a business role. You'll own the whole channel: TikTok Shop, creators/affiliates, content, ads, livestreams, and the numbers behind all of it.



We want a builder! Someone who either launched a TikTok Shop from zero and made it succeed, or took over a shop that wasn't performing and turned it around. It needs to be *their* win — not a channel they just helped run while someone else called the shots.



You'll start hands-on, with room to build and lead a team as the channel grows.

---





JOB SPECIFICATIONS



[TikTok Business & Profitability]

- Understands how to grow TikTok sales while protecting margin, not just chasing GMV

- Good with numbers — can tell what's working, what's not, and what to scale or stop



[TikTok Shop Operations]

- Knows how TikTok Shop works — listings, pricing, promos, bundles, discount codes, store health



[Creators & Affiliates]

- Experience finding, recruiting, and managing TikTok creators and affiliates



[Content, Advertising & Livestream]

- Can guide short-form content strategy based on what performs well

- Familiar with TikTok Ads/Spark Ads and livestream operations



[Analytics & Reporting]

- Comfortable pulling together weekly performance updates and explaining the "why" behind the numbers



[Systems & Team Building]

- Can build simple SOPs/processes so the work runs smoothly as the team grows

- Open to eventually helping hire and manage a small supporting team





DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run the TikTok channel and grow its sales for the U.S. market

- Manage the TikTok Shop — product listings, pricing, promos, and store health

- Find, recruit, and manage TikTok creators and affiliates to promote products

- Plan and guide short-form video content based on what performs well

- Handle or oversee TikTok ads and livestreams

- Give weekly updates on sales, ads, creators, and content performance

- Create simple processes so the work can run smoothly as the team grows

- Strong English communication skills, written and verbal

- Can work independently, solve problems, and take full ownership of results





NON-NEGOTIABLES



- Based within Luzon, and willing to travel to NCR whenever the CEO is in Manila to check in with the team

- Was the main driver — not just a helper — behind a TikTok Shop's growth or launch. This means one of:

    [1] Launched a TikTok Shop from scratch and built it into a success (or at least got it to a strong state before leaving the company/client), or...

    [2] Took over a TikTok Shop with little to no traction (low sales/GMV) and turned it around

- Can clearly explain *their own* strategy and decisions behind that growth — not just point to results the shop achieved under someone else's plan

- Strong track record of driving measurable sales growth and improving overall TikTok channel performance

- Strong understanding of the TikTok Shop ecosystem and its key sales/growth drivers





NICE TO HAVE



- Background in health, wellness, beauty, personal care, supplements, medical products, sports, or other regulated consumer categories

- Experience managing TikTok at significant sales/GMV scale, or across multiple brands/shops

- Experience building or leading a TikTok/e-commerce team, or managing large creator networks

- Direct experience working with TikTok account managers or platform reps

- Experience managing TikTok alongside Amazon or other major e-commerce channels

description:
We are Orgin, a fast-growing e-commerce brand in the supplement space. We sell across US and our own webshop, and video is the engine behind almost everything we do. We are building a world-class remote team and looking for a video editor who treats every edit like it matters.

Write and refine scripts, then build the full video around them

What We Offer



A real role with ownership, not a task list to tick off. A small, fast-moving team where your work goes live quickly and your ideas count. Full-time hours with overlap with the European morning, paid time off, and a clear growth path as we scale our content output.

Send us your portfolio and three to five sentences on why this role excites you. Include one example of a video where you used AI tools in the process and tell us exactly what you did. We will ask shortlisted candidates to complete a short paid edit so we can see how you work.

title: Short form + Long form Video Editor
description:
Our videos are talking head style with a clear story, and the editing is what makes them work. Think of the way Alex Hormozi's videos are cut. Someone talking to camera, and around that a constant layer of motion graphics, animated text, b-roll and visual proof that keeps the viewer watching to the end.



We are looking for one editor who owns this from raw footage to publish ready file. You get the footage and the script, you deliver the finished video and the thumbnail.



What you will do



Edit long form YouTube videos of maximum 10 minutes from raw talking head footage

Build motion graphics, animated text and transitions that carry the story instead of decorating it

Visualize what is being said. When the script says "you see on screen a ..." the right visual appears at the right second and it looks clean

Replace backgrounds and change the full setting of a shot when the story calls for a different environment

Generate and integrate AI images and AI visuals so they blend with the real footage

Design a simple thumbnail for each video. This is a small part of the job, editing is the main work

Handle sound design, music, color and captions so the video is ready to publish



What we are looking for



A strong portfolio of talking head videos with heavy motion graphics. This is the most important requirement. Applications without a portfolio are not reviewed

Advanced Premiere Pro or Final Cut, plus After Effects for motion graphics

Real experience with background replacement, masking, keying and rotoscoping

Working knowledge of AI image and video tools such as Midjourney, ChatGPT, Runway or Kling, and the taste to make that output look believable next to real footage

Clear written English and the discipline to hit deadlines without being chased



Nice to have



Thumbnail design in Photoshop or Canva

Experience editing for a brand channel or personal brand channel that actually grew

Understanding of YouTube retention and what makes people keep watching



How to apply



Send your application with the following.



A link to your portfolio with at least two talking head videos you edited yourself, with the motion graphics clearly visible

One example where you replaced a background or changed the setting of a shot, and one example where you used AI generated visuals inside an edit

A short note on which tools you use and how long you normally need for a 10 minute video

Start your message with the word GRAPHICS so we know you read the full post

title: Shopify Expert Needed (Ongoing Work)
description:
We build Shopify stores for clients on an ongoing basis and are looking for someone who can take on app installations and setups that go beyond the basics.



Most apps install in a few clicks. That is not what this role is about. We need someone who can take an app, work through its documentation, and get it doing exactly what the project requires — including the configuration, the theme integration, and the troubleshooting when it does not work as expected out of the box.



Examples of the kind of work involved:



* Collection filtering set up with custom filters, including metafield-based ones

* Rewards and loyalty programs configured and styled to match the store

* Product page customisation apps — configuring options, variants and conditional logic so the right choices appear on the right products

* Metafield and metaobject setups, including displaying that content on the theme where the app does not handle it automatically

* Product configurators and build-your-own product setups

* Bundle, upsell and subscription apps configured to a specific brief

* Getting two apps to work together when they conflict

* Placing app blocks and embeds correctly in the theme, and fixing them when they break the layout



What we are looking for:



* Someone who has installed and configured a wide range of Shopify apps, not just the common ones

* Comfortable working through an app's documentation and support material to get a result, without needing to be walked through it

* Able to make small theme code edits where an app requires it, and to do that safely

* Able to test your own work and fix issues before handing it over

* Someone who enjoys working out how to do something they have not done before



The work:



* Paid per task, agreed before each job

* Ongoing volume — we build stores continuously

* Two trial tasks as the first step, both paid per task regardless of the outcome



How to apply:



Include the phrase "I listen Dylan" in your message so we know you have read this listing.



Give us a few examples of the more complex apps you have set up in the past, and what you configured them to do.

This is not a bedside-nursing role. It is a client-service and operations role for an RN who wants to use healthcare knowledge, communication skills, judgment, and organization in a broader professional setting.



You will support families who are exploring homecare, help keep client follow-up organized, assist with caregiver communication and recruiting coordination, and become a trusted part of our ISL team.



## Your Main Responsibilities



### Support Families Exploring Homecare



Families often contact us when they are worried about a parent or loved one. You will help make the first steps clear and manageable.



You will:



- Speak professionally and empathetically with prospective clients and their families

- Handle pre-screened calls transferred by our Care Coordination team

- Ask thoughtful questions and document important details accurately

- Help families understand the next step in beginning homecare

- Schedule consultations in our calendar system

You will also help our team communicate with caregiver applicants and keep recruiting activities moving.



You may:



- Follow up with caregiver applicants

- Coordinate interviews and next steps

- Maintain organized records and trackers

- Communicate clearly with Recruiting, Human Resources, Scheduling, Operations, and Care Coordination



### Learn Homecare Operations



This role will grow over time. You will learn the systems and processes that help a homecare company serve clients well.



You will use tools such as:



- Wel
rsonal Care

- Google Workspace

- Google Calendar

- Google Sheets

- Microsoft Excel

- CRM and communication systems



## Required Background



You must have:



- Real professional work experience as a Registered Nurse

- Strong spoken and written English

- Professional, calm, and empathetic communication

- Comfort speaking with clients, families, caregivers, and applicants

- Strong attention to detail and accurate documentation habits

- Confidence using computers, calendars, spreadsheets, and new software

- Good follow-through without needing repeated reminders

- Full-time availability with meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours



An active RN license is not required. However, your nursing employment history must be clearly explained and available for verification.
