title: Senior B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
VenAI Agency is seeking a highly experienced, reliable B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to make outbound calls to a prepared prospect list and book qualified, attended demos.



This is a part-time independent-contractor role for an experienced cold caller. You will make outbound B2B calls to businesses and decision-makers across Australia.



VenAI Agency will provide approved calling lists, the calling process, calendar rules, and relevant sales material. Your focus is to make professional outbound calls, speak confidently with Australian business owners and decision-makers, identify genuine interest and suitability, handle objections appropriately, book suitable demos, help reduce no-shows, and keep accurate records of every call outcome.



You must be able to explain AI, automation, and business-growth solutions in clear, confident, professional, non-technical language. You must not make misleading claims, pressure prospects, or book unsuitable appointments simply to increase numbers.



CALLING TERRITORY AND HOURS



You will make outbound B2B cold calls to businesses and decision-makers across Australia.



You must call prospects only during approved local business hours in their relevant Australian state or territory. You must account for Australian time-zone and daylight-saving differences when scheduling calls and demos.



The role is initially scheduled in four-hour work blocks. Your final working schedule will be agreed with VenAI Agency. You must state your local time zone, working availability, and ability to consistently work the agreed shift when applying.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Make high-quality outbound B2B cold calls to businesses and decision-makers across Australia using VenAI Agency’s prepared calling lists

• Introduce VenAI Agency’s AI and automation solutions clearly and professionally

• Speak with business owners, decision-makers, and relevant stakeholders

• Identify genuine interest, relevant business needs, and basic suitability

• Handle objections calmly, professionally, and naturally

• Book 30-minute demos only for suitable prospects and only within VenAI Agency’s approved calendar availability

• Confirm meeting details and follow the approved process to reduce cancellations and no-shows

• Record every call attempt, conversation, objection, follow-up action, booking, and outcome accurately in the CRM

• Keep complete and accurate notes so VenAI Agency can understand the prospect’s needs before the demo

• Escalate questions, unusual requests, or unsuitable prospects rather than making assumptions

• Maintain daily activity records and provide a concise end-of-shift update

• Follow approved scripts, processes, privacy requirements, booking rules, and Australian local-business-hour calling requirements



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



• At least 5 years of proven B2B cold-calling or outbound appointment-setting experience

• Strong record of booking qualified meetings with business owners and decision-makers

• Experience selling SaaS, technology, AI automation, digital services, or another complex B2B service is strongly preferred

• Excellent spoken English, with clear pronunciation, professional tone, and confidence on live calls

• Demonstrated ability to handle objections and maintain natural, consultative conversations

• Able to follow a script and process while adapting naturally to each conversation

• Very high attention to detail when recording call outcomes, notes, and follow-up actions

• Highly reliable, organised, self-directed, and consistent

• Comfortable using a CRM, dialler, calendar-booking system, and calling tools

• Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet professional calling environment, quality headset, and reasonable backup arrangements for connectivity or power interruptions

• Able to consistently complete agreed shifts and communicate early about unavoidable absences



COMPENSATION AND PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES



This is a part-time independent-contractor role, initially scheduled in four-hour work blocks.



Hourly rate: USD $8–$12 per hour, depending on demonstrated cold-calling experience, communication quality, reliability, attention to detail, and performance.



In addition to the hourly rate, you will earn an AUD $15 commission for each qualified demo that you personally generate through outbound cold calling, provided that:



• The prospect attends the demo

• The prospect meets VenAI Agency’s agreed qualification criteria

• VenAI Agency approves the opportunity after review

• The call history, contact details, prospect needs, objections, and meeting outcome are accurately recorded in the CRM



You will receive an additional AUD $20 bonus if that same approved prospect becomes a paying VenAI Agency client.



Maximum performance payment per prospect that becomes a paying client: AUD $35, in addition to the agreed hourly rate.



Commission is payable only where you convert a contact from VenAI Agency’s approved outbound calling list into an attended, qualified demo. Commission does not apply to leads, inquiries, or bookings generated through VenAI Agency’s social media, advertising, marketing campaigns, website, chatbot, referrals, existing CRM/database, or any other inbound channel.



No commission is payable for cancelled appointments, no-shows, duplicate records, incomplete or inaccurate CRM records, appointments booked outside agreed rules, or prospects that do not meet the agreed qualification criteria.



QUALIFIED DEMO DEFINITION



A qualified demo is an attended meeting with a prospect contacted by you through VenAI Agency’s approved outbound calling list. The prospect must match VenAI Agency’s target-customer profile, have a genuine business need or relevant use case, and be a decision-maker or an appropriate stakeholder with a credible route to the decision-maker.



The prospect’s contact information, company details, call history, source, needs, objections, meeting details, and meeting outcome must be fully and accurately recorded in the CRM.



RELIABILITY AND PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



You must consistently complete agreed work hours, maintain dependable internet access and reasonable backup arrangements, communicate as early as possible about unavoidable absences, and keep accurate daily activity and CRM records.



Repeated unexplained absences, missed shifts, inaccurate reporting, poor communication, failure to follow documented processes, or failure to meet agreed performance standards may result in termination of the independent-contractor agreement.



TO APPLY



Please submit:

• Your CV/resume

• A short 1–2 minute introduction face to camera video in English

• A brief written summary of your B2B cold-calling and appointment-setting experience

• The industries, services, or offers you have previously cold called for

• The typical number of qualified, attended meetings you have generated in comparable roles

• Your experience using CRMs, diallers, calendars, and calling tools

• Your available working hours, local time zone, and confirmation that you can consistently work the agreed shift

title: Paid Ads Specialist (WFH /Remote)
description:
Trident Digital | Singapore

Full-time | Remote Setup/Work from Home

Salary: SGD 1,500 monthly (with performance bonus)

Working Hours: 9AM - 6PM (SGT)



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their field, and they measure us on one thing: leads that turn into booked calls and closed business.

This role owns that engine. You’ll lead our ads department from day one, running Meta campaigns end to end across our client accounts, with real budget responsibility and real say in strategy. You’ll work directly with the founder. We’re not hiring someone to press buttons in Ads Manager. We’re hiring someone who wants to own outcomes.



What the setup looks like

You’ll lead a small ads team with different specialist skill sets across media buying, copy and funnels. We serve a growing base of ad clients and we’re scaling fast, which means the team under you grows as we do. Meta is the main channel, YouTube is a plus. Stack includes GoHighLevel. Client accounts and our processes are documented, so you’re not walking into a mess.



What you’ll do

• Own Meta campaigns end to end: strategy, structure, launch, optimisation and scaling

• Make the performance calls: what to turn off, what to scale, what to test next, and explain why

• Direct creative: give the copywriter and creative team briefs so clear they can execute without a second meeting

• Protect the funnel: catch landing page and tracking issues before they waste budget

• Keep clients in the loop: your analysis and recommendations go to clients through our ops team, so clients always know what’s happening and why

• Run the weekly ads huddle and keep every account’s status honest





How you’ll be measured

Steady lead costs across the accounts you manage, fast turnaround on launches and fixes, and accounts kept healthy. If you like being judged on results instead of activity, you’ll enjoy this.



You’ll do well here if you

• Feel personally responsible when a campaign underperforms, before anyone points it out

• Can look at an account and tell a clear story: what’s working, why, and what you’re testing next

• Think in full funnels: ad, landing page, offer, follow up, not just what happens inside Ads Manager

• Communicate clearly and proactively. The team should never have to chase you for an update



This is not for you if you

• Want a quiet execution role where someone else makes the decisions

• Have freelance ad accounts or side hustles competing for your focus. This has to be your main thing

• Report numbers without opinions. “CTR dropped 12%” is data. “CTR dropped because the hook fatigued, and here’s the next test” is the job

No hard feelings either way. Different roles suit different people.



Bonus points

• You’ve run lead generation for service businesses

• Bigger bonus: financial advisory, insurance or real estate

• Biggest bonus: Singapore market experience



What you get

• Lead the ads department from day one, working directly with the founder

• Real decision-making power: you shape strategy, not just execute someone else’s plan

• A team that invests in its people: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, overseas team trips

• As the agency scales, your scope and team scale with you





HOW TO APPLY

Please email your application to 
 with the subject line:

Your Next Paid Ads Specialist – [Your Full Name]



Your email should include:

• Cover Letter (years of experience running paid campaigns and how you think you can contribute to Trident Digital)

• Updated CV / Resume

• Portfolio: your 3 best pieces of ad copy or scripts, with 2 to 3 sentences on each explaining the choices you made

• One campaign that didn’t go to plan: what went wrong and what you changed because of it. Everyone who’s run enough campaigns has one. We’re interested in how you learn.

• Expected Salary (in SGD)



Important: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The exercise is part of the screening. It tells us more than a CV can.

title: Business Development Associate (WFH / Remote)
description:
Trident Digital | Singapore

Full-time | Remote (Work from Home)

Working hours: Singapore hours (9am–6pm)

Salary: SGD 300 base + performance bonus (total est. SGD 500–1,000 with commissions)



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Every client we work with started as a conversation someone had to start. This role starts those conversations.

You'll be the front end of our business development: reaching out to potential clients, keeping conversations warm, and making sure no opportunity slips through the cracks. It's a hands-on, execution-focused role — and it's how careers in sales and business development actually begin. Not with a fancy title, but with learning how to open doors, day after day, and getting paid more when more of them open.

If you're organised, consistent, and not afraid to message a stranger, keep reading.



What the setup looks like

You'll work closely with our BD lead and the founder — which means you'll see, up close, how deals actually move from first message to signed client. Outreach runs mainly through LinkedIn, Instagram and email. Prospects are financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. You'll follow proven outreach processes and scripts to start, with real room to improve them as you learn what works.



What You’ll Do

• Reach out to potential clients daily across LinkedIn, Instagram, email and other platforms

• Start conversations and build genuine initial connections — not spray-and-pray spam

• Follow up consistently so leads stay warm and conversations keep moving forward

• Keep the pipeline clean: every prospect tracked, every response logged, nothing dropped

• Support the BD lead with simple decks, proposals and client coordination when needed



How you'll be measured

Conversations started, replies earned, and meetings booked for the BD lead. Your commissions are tied to results, so the better you get at this, the more you earn — and you'll see your numbers every week. If you like the idea of your pay reflecting your output instead of just your hours, you'll enjoy this.



You'll do well here if you

• Show up consistently. Outreach rewards the person who does it every day, not the person who does it brilliantly once a week

• Write like a human. Your messages should read like a real person reaching out, not a template blast

• Don't take silence personally. Most people won't reply — the ones who do are why the job exists

• Sweat the small stuff: names spelled right, follow-ups on time, tracker always current

• Want to grow into a real sales or business development career, and see this as the ground floor of it



This is not for you if you

• Need every day to feel new and exciting. The core of this job is repetition done well

• Get discouraged after a week of no's. Resilience isn't optional here, it's the job

• Have freelance work or side hustles competing for your focus. This has to be your main thing

• See outreach as beneath you. The founder of this company did it too. It's how businesses get built

No hard feelings either way. We'd rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

• You've done outreach, sales or lead generation before, even informally

• You're familiar with LinkedIn, Instagram or CRM tools

• You've handled high message volume without letting quality slip

• Fresh grads are welcome to apply. We care more about consistency and hunger than years of experience.



What you get

• Direct exposure to the founder and BD lead — you learn how deals are won, not just how messages are sent

• Commissions that grow with your results, so your ceiling is set by your effort

• A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, and overseas team trips

• A clear path into business development and sales roles as the agency scales



How to Apply

 
 with the subject line:

Your Next Business Development Associate - [Your Full Name]

Your email should include:

• Cover letter: a bit about yourself and why this role fits you

• Updated CV/Resume

• One short exercise: write the first outreach message you'd send to a financial advisor on LinkedIn to start a conversation about working with a marketing agency. Keep it short — the kind of message you'd actually send. We're looking at how you write and how you think

• Expected salary in SGD



Important Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The exercise is part of the screening. It tells us more than a CV can.

title: Contract Renewals Specialist - UK
description:
Supporting the EMEA sales team, the Renewals Specialist owns a defined book of existing customers and is responsible for securing on-time contract renewals, protecting recurring revenue and converting single-year SaaS agreements into multi-year commitments.



This is not a cold calling role. 



Every conversation is with an existing customer who already uses the platform. 



The focus is proactive, well-timed engagement ahead of contract expiry: understanding how the customer is using the solution, reinforcing the value they are already receiving, resolving anything standing in the way of renewal, and positioning the commercial structure — multi-year terms, expanded entitlements, new capabilities — that best fits their next term.



The role also covers the sales and administrative process attached to renewals and in-term changes, including adds, program changes, cloud migrations and true-ups.



• EXCELLENT written and verbal ENGLISH communication is REQUIRED

• APPLE MacBook LAPTOP REQUIRED (MANDATORY REQUIREMENT).



Key Responsibilities:



• Own and achieve renewal revenue and billings targets across the UK region through disciplined, structured engagement of the assigned customer book.

• Manage the full renewal cycle end to end — from early pre-expiry outreach through commercial negotiation to signed agreement — ensuring no contract reaches expiry unworked.

• Drive multi-year billing commitments as a key measure of customer confidence and commercial success, positioning the value case for longer terms rather than defaulting to like-for-like annual renewals.

• Proactively engage customers well ahead of contract expiry via phone,
 and LinkedIn, working a structured renewal cadence based on expiry date, account value and risk profile.

• Conduct value and usage conversations to understand how the customer is deploying the solution, what has changed in their business, and what they need from the next term before positioning commercial options.

• Identify renewal risk early — low adoption, unresolved support issues, sponsor change, budget pressure — and coordinate the internal response required to secure the renewal.

• Identify cross-sell, upsell and expansion opportunities within the renewal conversation to maximise customer lifetime value, collaborating with Account Management to advance larger opportunities.

• Champion adoption of new platform capabilities, features and technologies as part of the renewal and expansion narrative.

• Maintain accurate pipeline management, renewal forecast visibility and close-date discipline in Salesforce.

• Manage the sales and administrative process attached to renewals and in-term changes, including adds, program changes, cloud migrations and true-ups.

• Build and maintain productive relationships with channel partners and resellers where they hold or influence the customer relationship, coordinating renewal activity through the partner where appropriate.

• Act as a trusted commercial contact for the customer, coordinating engagement with internal specialists, Customer Success and accredited partners.

• Actively contribute to customer success initiatives that increase adoption, engagement and long-term value.

• Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Marketing, Product and Partner teams to protect and grow the installed base.

• Test and refine renewal messaging, outreach sequences and cadences to improve on-time renewal and multi-year conversion rates.

• Proactively collect account intelligence during every customer interaction by asking targeted questions to uncover insights around account structure, decision-makers, use cases and growth potential. Ensure all relevant information is accurately captured and maintained in SFDC to support broader account planning and strategy.

• Provide feedback to sales and customer success leadership on renewal trends, churn drivers and market insights.



KPI's:

• On-Time Renewal Rate: Secure renewal of the assigned contract base in line with the agreed target.

• Allocated Task Completion: Complete 100% of allocated daily tasks.

• Pipeline Hygiene: No contract enters its final 30 days without documented customer contact.



Experience Required:

• EXCELLENT written and verbal ENGLISH communication.

• Apple MacBook laptop required (MANDATORY REQUIREMENT).

• Essential: 2+ years in a quota-carrying SaaS/software sales role with direct renewals, account management, inside sales or customer expansion responsibility.

• Experience working with channel partners or reseller ecosystems.

• Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding renewal, retention or quota targets within an existing customer base.

• Experience selling and negotiating multi-year subscription or licensing agreements.

• Experience using Salesforce for pipeline management, renewal forecasting and account record keeping.

• Experience engaging business decision-makers across multiple industries.

• Strong organisational, pipeline management and forecasting discipline across a high volume of concurrent contracts.

• Ability to work independently and manage a renewal book aligned to UK business hours.

title: Customer Support Representative (Jewelry E-Commerce)
description:
About Us



We're a jewellery brand, but our customers aren't really buying jewellery. They're buying a gift for a sister who just moved abroad, a charm that marks a trip they took with their best friend, a piece that will sit on someone's wrist for the next ten years. When something goes wrong with that order, it's not a product issue, it's a ruined moment. We need someone who gets that, and who treats every ticket like it matters, because to the person on the other end, it does.



The Role



This is a hybrid role: part Customer Support Representative, part General Virtual Assistant. Customer support is the core of the job. You'll be the first point of contact for our customers across
 and social media, helping with everything from sizing and material questions to shipping updates, returns, and the occasional "my parcel says delivered but it isn't here."



Around that, you'll pick up general VA work as the business needs it. That might mean updating order details in Shopify, tagging and organising tickets, keeping trackers and spreadsheets current, pulling together simple reports, researching a supplier or a competitor, or helping the team get a project over the line. The mix will shift week to week, and we'd rather hire someone who's comfortable with that than someone who needs a fixed list.



We're not looking for someone who pastes templates and closes tickets. We need a problem solver who is caring enough to make the customer feel looked after, and sharp enough to protect the business while doing it.



What We're Looking For



Detail-oriented. Jewellery orders are unforgiving. A wrong ring size, a typo in an address, or a missed engraving note means a disappointed customer and a costly reship. You catch these things before they become problems.



A problem solver. "I don't know" isn't where you stop, it's where you start. You dig into the order, check the tracking, read the policy, ask the right person, and come back with an answer.



Pragmatic. You understand that customer happiness and business policy aren't opposites. You can calm down an angry customer and land on a solution that works for both sides, and you know a full refund isn't the only tool in the box.



A strong writer. Excellent grammar, clear structure, and the ability to shift tone from warm and reassuring to polite and firm depending on who's in front of you.



Self-directed. This is a remote role with a lot of autonomy. You manage your own queue, flag issues before they're chased, and don't need hand-holding to get through a task list.



Adaptable. One hour you're handling a delivery complaint, the next you're cleaning up a spreadsheet. You're fine with that.



Responsibilities



Customer support:



Manage customer inquiries via
 and social media about orders, shipping, sizing, materials, and care.

Respond to and moderate social media comments and DMs in the brand's voice.

Handle returns, exchanges, and replacements efficiently, following our policies while keeping customer goodwill intact.

De-escalate frustrated customers dealing with shipping delays, damaged items, or wrong orders.

Spot and flag recurring issues (a batch defect, a carrier problem, a confusing product page) so we can fix the root cause.

General VA:



Order admin in Shopify: address changes, order edits, cancellations, and manual fulfilment updates.

Keep internal trackers, sheets, and documentation up to date.

Light reporting: pulling weekly ticket numbers, common contact reasons, or other simple data the team asks for.

Ad-hoc research and admin tasks to support the wider team.

Requirements



English proficiency at C1 or C2 level, written and spoken.

At least 1 year of customer support experience, ideally for an e-commerce or DTC brand.

Comfortable working across multiple tools at once. Experience with Shopify and a helpdesk (Commslayer, Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or Intercom) is a strong plus.

Confident with Google Sheets or Excel at a basic-to-intermediate level.

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet working setup, and a backup plan for power or internet outages.

Availability for 30-40 hours

What You'll Get



3$/h, paid fortnightly.

Fully remote, long-term role with a small team that actually reads what you write.

Clear processes and a helpdesk with AI assistance, so your time goes on the tickets that need a human, not the ones that don't.

Room to grow into more responsibility if you show you can handle it.

title: US Placement Recruiter / Closer (Extroverts Only) - US Eastern Hours, Base + Commission
description:
ABOUT US



Suarez Assistant is a US staffing company. We place talent into American companies across engineering, accounting, insurance and manufacturing.



We are opening a new line: US direct-hire placements, where we put American candidates into on-site jobs inside US companies. This seat is the first hire on that team. You report directly to the owner. No layers, no middle manager.



THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE



You are a closer. You take American candidates through a live hiring process on somebody else's calendar and you get them seated in the chair on day one.



THIS IS NOT A SOURCING JOB



Finding names is the easy part and we already have it solved. Our problem is conversion. Candidates say yes and then go quiet. They confirm an interview and do not show up. Client hiring managers are too busy to schedule anyone. Your job is to own all of that and drag it to a finish.



If your idea of recruiting is posting a job and forwarding resumes, this is not your seat.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



- Call, text and message American candidates until they commit to a real interview time

- Get interviews physically booked on the client hiring manager's calendar

- Keep candidates warm between the offer and the start date, which is where most placements die

- Run your own tracker so nothing lives in your head or in a chat thread

- Tell the owner directly, out loud, when something is not working



YOUR FIRST PROJECT



A US manufacturer hiring in two states. Four roles: inside sales, outside sales, general labor and a production supervisor. After that you move onto our insurance line.



REQUIREMENTS (all five, no exceptions)



1. Conversational, confident English on a live call. We test this on a video call, not from your resume.

2. You can work US Eastern hours, 9am to 6pm ET. That is roughly 9pm to 6am Manila time. It is a permanent night shift. Please only apply if you genuinely want that.

3. You have personally talked a stranger into a scheduled appointment that they actually showed up to. You will need to tell us the number and how you know it.

4. You already run a written system today. A CRM, Airtable, Trello, or even a spreadsheet. You will show it on screen in the interview.

5. You are comfortable on camera with American clients.



WHAT WE DO NOT REQUIRE



- Recruiting or staffing experience. Some of the best people at this come from route sales, hospitality, bartending, car dealership BDC, door to door, gym memberships, or anywhere else you had to move real humans for a living. We can teach you recruiting.

- A degree. We have never cared.

- A perfect resume. We care about what you have actually closed.



WHO THIS SUITS



Extroverts. People who pick up the phone without being told to. People who follow up a fourth time. People who will push back on the owner when he is wrong, on the call, in the moment.



If you are quiet, if you wait to be told what to do, and if you go silent when things get hard, you will be unhappy here and we will both know it by week two. That is an honest warning, not a filter to beat.



PAY



$900 per month base, plus $450 per placement.



2 placements a month = $1,800

3 placements a month = $2,250

4 placements a month = $2,700



Paid monthly. Full time, long term. These numbers are real and we have done the arithmetic. We are not going to wave a big number at you that you can never actually reach.



HOW TO APPLY



Send all three of the following. Applications missing any of them are deleted, no exceptions.



1. Use the subject line: SEATED



2. Record a 60 second voice message or video. One take, no script. Answer this: tell me about the last person you talked into showing up somewhere they had not planned to go. How many times did you follow up, and what did you say to them on the day?



3. Send a screenshot of the system you use to track people today.



Do not send a cover letter. Do not send a generic resume blast. We read those three things and nothing else.

title: Indie Game Marketing & Community Assistant
description:
We run an established text-based online RPG and are looking for someone to help grow the game, support the community, and create marketing content.



This is not a generic virtual assistant role. We are specifically looking for someone who understands gaming, online communities, and digital marketing.



Because the game is primarily text-based, we need someone who can create interesting content from player stories, screenshots, events, updates, community moments, memes, and game mechanics rather than relying on flashy gameplay footage.



What you’ll help with



* Creating marketing content for the game

* Creating short-form videos/Reels/TikToks/Shorts from existing game content and community material

* Managing and growing our Reddit presence

* Helping with Discord and community engagement

* Finding practical ways to attract new players

* Supporting small paid advertising campaigns

* Helping plan social media and content campaigns

* Responding to basic player support/helpdesk tickets

* Collecting player feedback and identifying common issues

* Promoting in-game events and updates



You won’t need to do everything immediately. We’ll start with a small amount of work and expand the role based on your strengths.



Who we’re looking for



Ideally you have experience with some of the following:



* Gaming or indie-game marketing

* Managing gaming communities

* Reddit and Discord

* TikTok, Reels or YouTube Shorts

* Social media growth

* Copywriting or gaming content creation

* Video editing using CapCut, Premiere or similar

* Paid ads / Meta Ads

* Customer or player support

* Influencer or creator outreach



You should also:



* Have strong written English

* Be comfortable learning an existing online game

* Be able to work independently

* Have good judgment when communicating with players

* Be proactive and suggest ideas rather than needing constant instructions



Hours & Pay



Initially around 5–10 hours per week.



Budget is approximately $5–$10 USD/hour, depending on experience and ability.



There will be a paid trial before we commit to ongoing work.



If things go well, there is potential for more responsibility and additional hours.



How to apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Examples of gaming-related work you’ve done

3. Examples of social media posts, videos, memes, or other content you’ve created

4. Any experience growing a game, gaming brand, Discord, Reddit community, YouTube/TikTok account, etc.

5. Your experience with Reddit and Discord

6. Your hourly rate

7. One quick idea you would try to bring new players to an established text-based online RPG



Please do not send a generic VA application. Gaming experience and an understanding of online communities are important for this role.



If you’ve worked directly with an indie game, gaming studio, esports company, gaming creator, browser game, MMO, or live online game, please mention that near the top of your application.

title: Customer Support & General Virtual Assistant (Remote, Jewelry Brand)
description:
About Us



We're a jewelry brand, but our customers aren't really buying jewelry. They're buying a gift for a sister who just moved abroad, a charm that marks a trip they took with their best friend, a piece that will sit on someone's wrist for the next ten years. When something goes wrong with that order, it's not a product issue, it's a ruined moment. We need someone who gets that, and who treats every ticket like it matters, because to the person on the other end, it does.



The Role



This is a hybrid role: part Customer Support Representative, part General Virtual Assistant. Customer support is the core of the job. You'll be the first point of contact for our customers across
 and social media, helping with everything from sizing and material questions to shipping updates, returns, and the occasional "my parcel says delivered but it isn't here."

Around that, you'll pick up general VA work as the business needs it. That might mean updating order details in Shopify, tagging and organising tickets, keeping trackers and spreadsheets current, pulling together simple reports, researching a supplier or a competitor, or helping the team get a project over the line. The mix will shift week to week, and we'd rather hire someone who's comfortable with that than someone who needs a fixed list.

We're not looking for someone who pastes templates and closes tickets. We need a problem solver who is caring enough to make the customer feel looked after, and sharp enough to protect the business while doing it.



What We're Looking For



Detail-oriented. Jewelry orders are unforgiving. A wrong ring size, a typo in an address, or a missed engraving note means a disappointed customer and a costly reship. You catch these things before they become problems.



A problem solver. "I don't know" isn't where you stop, it's where you start. You dig into the order, check the tracking, read the policy, ask the right person, and come back with an answer.



Pragmatic. You understand that customer happiness and business policy aren't opposites. You can calm down an angry customer and land on a solution that works for both sides, and you know a full refund isn't the only tool in the box.



A strong writer. Excellent grammar, clear structure, and the ability to shift tone from warm and reassuring to polite and firm depending on who's in front of you.



Self-directed. This is a remote role with a lot of autonomy. You manage your own queue, flag issues before they're chased, and don't need hand-holding to get through a task list.

Adaptable. One hour you're handling a delivery complaint, the next you're cleaning up a spreadsheet. You're fine with that.



Responsibilities



Customer support (primary):

Manage customer inquiries via
 and social media about orders, shipping, sizing, materials, and care.

Respond to and moderate social media comments and DMs in the brand's voice.

Handle returns, exchanges, and replacements efficiently, following our policies while keeping customer goodwill intact.

De-escalate frustrated customers dealing with shipping delays, damaged items, or wrong orders.

Spot and flag recurring issues (a batch defect, a carrier problem, a confusing product page) so we can fix the root cause.

General VA (secondary):

Order admin in Shopify: address changes, order edits, cancellations, and manual fulfilment updates.

Keep internal trackers, sheets, and documentation up to date.

Light reporting: pulling weekly ticket numbers, common contact reasons, or other simple data the team asks for.

Ad-hoc research and admin tasks to support the wider team.

- Frontend performance

We care about the quality of the interface as much as whether the code technically works.



A component should not only function correctly. It should look polished, behave properly across screen sizes and feel like it belongs on a high-quality ecommerce website.

Ecommerce Experience

We want someone who understands ecommerce, not simply Shopify development.



You should understand concepts such as:

 and SMS integrations

Experience working with apps and platforms such as the following is highly valuable:

-

is valuable, particularly where Shopify forms part of a larger application or integration.

"Cool Bananas"



Applications that do not include relevant Shopify examples or that appear to have been submitted by an agency or recruiter will not be considered and will be ignored.

We are looking for someone excellent who wants to work with us for the long term.

title: TradingView MNQ Manual Backtesting Specialist – Rejection Block Indicator
description:
Job Title



TradingView MNQ Historical Backtesting & Pattern Analysis



Job Description



I’m looking for someone experienced with TradingView and MNQ/NQ charts to review historical data using my Rejection Block indicator.



Main Goal



I want you to find every time my Rejection Block indicator appears and price moves away from the zone WITHOUT pulling back into the Rejection Block zone.



For every qualifying setup, record ONLY:



• Date

• Exact time

• Bullish or bearish



Pattern Analysis



After collecting the setups, I also want you to compare them and determine if there is a repeating pattern that happens before or when these no-pullback Rejection Blocks appear.



Look for similarities such as:



• Candle formation

• Market structure

• Higher-timeframe direction

• Liquidity sweep

• Displacement

• Fair Value Gap (FVG)

• Order Block

• Previous highs/lows

• Time of day

• Volume

• Consecutive candles

• What happens immediately before the Rejection Block



The goal is to answer:



What do the strongest Rejection Blocks that leave the zone without pulling back have in common?



I want the final results to include the dates and times of the setups and a simple explanation of any repeating pattern you discover.



I will provide the TradingView indicator and explain exactly what qualifies as a Rejection Block and a no-pullback setup.



This is primarily manual historical chart research and pattern recognition. No Pine Script coding is required.

* Collaborate with our Google Ads specialist and account team so Meta, Search, LSA and remarketing work together throughout the buyer journey.

Most importantly, you’re proactive.

Experience working with U.S. clients, home-service companies or other local lead-generation businesses is a major plus.



About the Role



This is a full-time position, not freelance work squeezed around other clients. We’re looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our team, take ownership of their work and grow with us.



We offer paid time off, paid U.S. holidays, a supportive remote team and plenty of room to bring your own ideas to the table.

ABOUT THE ROLE



You will be the right hand to our President & Founder, based in California. This is a true executive assistant role — you will run her calendar, her inbox, her travel, her LinkedIn, and the personal and family logistics that keep a busy executive's life on track. You will learn her preferences, anticipate her needs, and be her go-to person throughout her workday. She is looking for a long-term partner, not a task-taker: someone who takes full ownership so nothing ever falls through the cracks.

: triage her inbox, draft responses in her voice, flag what matters, follow up until items are closed

7:00 AM – 3:00 PM US Pacific Time, Monday–Friday (10:00 PM – 6:00 AM Philippine time). Outside shift hours, we may occasionally ping you for genuinely urgent items; this is the exception, not the routine.



WHAT MAKES YOU A FIT



- 4+ years as an executive assistant or senior VA supporting a C-level executive, founder, or business owner — ideally US-based

- Excellent written and spoken English; you will draft
s and LinkedIn posts in the President's voice

WHAT WE OFFER

title: Client Support / Accountability Coordinator — Online Fitness Coaching Business (VA)
description:
Client Support / Accountability Coordinator — Online Fitness Coaching Business (VA)

Previous Hands on TRAINERIZE experience Required



**Pay: $1,300–$1,730 USD/month, based on experience**



**About the Role**



Pro Train Fitness runs the Men's Shred Program and Women's Shred Program — online coaching programs helping busy professional men and women (mostly ages 35–60) transform their health and fitness. We're growing, and we need a reliable, detail-driven Accountability Coordinator to keep our clients on track, engaged, and supported every single day.



This isn't a fitness-coaching role — you won't be designing programs or giving training advice. This is an **operations and client-support role**: keeping our systems accurate, our clients accountable, and our community engaged, so our coach can focus on actually coaching.



**What You'll Be Doing**



- Checking daily that clients are logging their food, weight, and workouts — and personally following up when they're not

- Keeping our WhatsApp community groups active and positive (weekdays only)

- Making sure clients show up to their coaching calls, and calling anyone who's missed their booking

- Helping new clients get set up smoothly in their first week

- Basic tech support (helping clients connect their fitness apps)

- Keeping accurate records in our systems

- A short weekly check-in with the business owner to flag anything that needs attention



**Hours**



Monday–Friday, 8:00am–6:30pm Sydney time, plus a short 2-hour window on Sunday afternoon (Sydney time) for outstanding call bookings. (We'll walk you through what this looks like in your own local time.)



**What We're Looking For**



- Excellent written English and a warm, professional communication style

- Someone who genuinely enjoys helping people and takes pride in follow-through

- Fast learner — comfortable picking up new apps and systems quickly

- Reliable internet with a backup connection (mobile data/pocket WiFi) — this is a requirement, not optional

- Detail-oriented and dependable — this role is trusted with real client health data

- A positive, can-do attitude — someone who brings energy to the team, not just gets the job done



No fitness industry experience required — we'll train you on everything specific to our systems. What matters most is your reliability, attitude, and communication.



**Bonus Skills (Not Required, But a Big Plus)**



- Experience using **Trainerize** (fitness coaching app)

- Experience with **InShot** or **CapCut** for basic video editing



**What We Offer**



- $1,300–$1,730 USD/month, based on experience

- Long-term, stable role with a growing business (not a short-term gig)

- 4-week paid trial period, followed by ongoing work once you're confirmed as a good fit

- Clear systems and a detailed SOP — you won't be left guessing what to do

- Real support from the business owner, not just left to figure it out alone



**To Apply**



Please include the word **"ELEPHANT"** somewhere in your application so we know you read the full ad. Then answer the following questions:



1. What word did we ask you to include in your application?

2. This role requires you to work 8:00am–6:30pm Sydney time on weekdays, plus 4:00pm–6:00pm Sydney time on Sundays. What would those hours be in your own local time, and are you able to commit to this schedule long-term?

3. A client hasn't logged their bodyweight or food for 3 days. What would you do?

4. Do you have a backup internet connection (e.g. mobile data or pocket WiFi) in addition to your main internet, or would you need to set one up?

5. Have you used Trainerize before? If yes, briefly describe how. Have you used InShot or CapCut? If yes, what kind of videos have you edited?

7. What's your current employment status — are you working full-time elsewhere, part-time, or fully available?

8. Are you a fast learner? Give an example of a time you were asked to learn a new tech-based skill — how quickly did you learn it, and were you able to use it effectively?

You will sell directly to U.S.-based IT leaders, including CIOs, IT Directors, IT Managers, Infrastructure leaders, Network leaders, and MSP executives. This is not an appointment-setting-only or inbound-only role. You will own your opportunities from first contact through signed agreement.

title: Home Health Operations & Administrative Coordinator
description:
**Home Health Operations & Administrative Coordinator**

**U.S. Healthcare Experience Strongly Preferred**



We are a growing U.S.-based home health therapy company providing Speech Therapy, Occupational Therapy and Physical Therapy services. We are seeking a highly organized, proactive Virtual Assistant / Operations Coordinator to support our daily administrative operations.



This is *not a basic data-entry role*.



We are looking for someone who enjoys managing multiple moving pieces, follows tasks through to completion, communicates professionally with therapists and referral sources and notices when something is stalled or incomplete.



The right person will become an important part of our day-to-day operations and help ensure that referrals, documentation, therapist communication and administrative workflows continue moving without unnecessary delays.



**Schedule**

Approximately: 20 hours per week, Monday through Friday, averaging 4 active working hours per day.

Distribution: The 4 daily hours are distributed across the U.S. Eastern business day through split shifts and planned check-in periods to ensure timely inbox and operational coverage.

Peak Coverage Window: Reliable availability is especially important around 10:00 AM-12:00 PM Eastern and during the 1:00–4:00 PM Eastern period.

This role is best suited for someone comfortable with a **flexible, split-shift structure** rather than a single continuous four-hour block.



**Objective:** 

Maintain consistent responsiveness to referrals, therapist communications, and incoming operational requests while keeping active work time efficient at approximately 4 hours daily.



**Primary Responsibilities**



1) Email & Inbox Management- A major responsibility of this role will be actively managing company email during U.S. business hours. Responsibilities include:

* Monitoring incoming emails and referral requests

* Organizing and categorizing messages

* Identifying urgent or time-sensitive items

* Drafting and sending routine administrative responses

* Following up on outstanding requests

* Tracking items that require additional action

* Flagging messages requiring owner or clinician review

* Helping ensure important emails do not sit unanswered or get lost in the inbox

The goal is not simply to organize email. The goal is to help **move work forward through the inbox**.



2) Referral Coordination- You will help manage Speech Therapy, Occupational Therapy, and Physical Therapy referrals from receipt through admission, setup, or closure. Responsibilities may include:

* Reviewing incoming referral information

* Maintaining referral trackers

* Identifying missing documentation or information

* Following up regarding missing items

* Tracking therapist coverage

* Confirming whether therapists have accepted referrals

* Obtaining evaluation dates

* Tracking whether cases are ready for EMR setup

* Updating referral status

* Monitoring cases that are stalled or awaiting action

* Closing or updating referrals that are no longer moving forward

A typical referral may move through stages such as: Referral Received → Missing Information → Coverage Search → Therapist Assigned → Pending Referral Source → Ready for EMR Setup → EMR Setup Complete → Closed / Not Admitted



3) Therapist Communication & Follow-Up

* Send routine reminders and follow-up messages

* Obtain scheduling and evaluation updates

* Track therapist availability

* Follow up regarding outstanding documentation or administrative requirements

* Communicate professionally with therapists regarding routine operational matters

* Escalate unusual, clinical, financial, or sensitive situations to company leadership

We are looking for someone who is comfortable following up respectfully and consistently when something remains outstanding.



4) EMR / Documentation Administration

Experience with U.S. healthcare EMR systems is strongly preferred. Responsibilities may include:

* Creating new referrals/ patients in EMR

* Uploading documents

* Checking whether required documentation has been submitted

* Tracking outstanding notes

* Monitoring signatures or administrative deficiencies

* Updating patient/referral status

* Maintaining organized documentation workflows

Clinical documentation and clinical decision-making remain the responsibility of licensed clinicians.



5) Timesheet & Billing Preparation

* Track therapist timesheet submissions

* Identify missing visit

* Follow up regarding incomplete submissions

* Compare expected visits with submitted visits when appropriate

* Organize information needed for billing and payroll review

* Prepare exception lists for company leadership

You will not independently approve payroll or client billing.

Your role is to help ensure the information required for those processes is complete and organized.



6) Contractor Onboarding

* Maintain therapist onboarding checklists

* Track required forms and documents

* Organize contracts and administrative records

* Track system access

* Track required training completion

* Maintain credential and expiration-date records

* Follow up on missing onboarding items



7) File & Operations Management

* Maintain organized Google Drive folders

* Update spreadsheets and trackers

* Maintain administrative checklists

* Help organize company templates

* Assist with recurring operational tasks

* Help document and improve administrative workflows as the company grows



**What We Are Looking For**

Our ideal candidate is:

* Extremely organized

* Detail-oriented

* Proactive

* Reliable

* Comfortable managing multiple workflows simultaneously

* Professional in written English

* Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based healthcare professionals

* Comfortable following up when something is outstanding

* Able to work independently after training

* Good at recognizing when something needs escalation

* Comfortable using email, spreadsheets, cloud-based software, and EMR systems

* Someone who enjoys bringing tasks to completion



We especially value someone who thinks:

“I noticed this was still outstanding, so I followed up, updated the tracker, and flagged the issue.”

rather than:

“I was waiting for someone to tell me what to do next.”



Experience We Strongly Prefer:

Applicants with previous U.S. healthcare administrative experience will be strongly prioritized.



Experience in any of the following is especially valuable:

* U.S. home health

* Medical Virtual Assistant work

* Therapy practices

* Speech, Occupational or Physical Therapy companies

* Referral coordination

* Home health intake

* Healthcare staffing

* Medical scheduling

* EMR/EHR systems

* Medical terminology

* Provider communication

* Insurance or authorization workflows

* Healthcare documentation

* HIPAA-compliant administrative environments



This is not an entry-level general VA position.

We are happy to train the right person on our specific company workflows, but candidates should ideally already understand the basics of working within a U.S. healthcare environment.



**Systems We Use**

Experience with the following is helpful but not required:

* Gmail / Google Workspace

* Google Drive

* Google Sheets

* QuickBooks

* TherapyBOSS EMR

* Time-tracking or project-management platforms AVAZA

Training will be provided on our specific systems and workflows.



**Confidentiality**

Because this role involves U.S. healthcare operations, confidentiality and data security are extremely important.

The successful candidate must be comfortable following strict company privacy, security, and HIPAA-related procedures.

Patient information may only be accessed through approved company systems, devices, and workflows.



**Compensation**

Starting compensation:

$5–$7 USD per hour depending on experience.

Exceptional candidates with significant U.S. healthcare or home health experience may be considered at a higher rate.

The position will begin at approximately 20 hours per week, with the opportunity for increased hours, responsibility, and compensation as the role develops.



We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our team.



**How to Apply**

Please begin your application with the words: **BLUE FOLDER**

Applications that do not begin with these words may not be reviewed.

Please include:

1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Your experience working with U.S. healthcare companies.

3. Any home health, therapy, referral coordination, or medical administrative experience.

4. EMR/EHR systems you have used.

5. Your current work schedule and whether you can reliably provide coverage around **11:00 AM Eastern and 2:30–4:30 PM Eastern, Monday through Friday**.

6. Your desired hourly rate.

7. An example of a position where you were responsible for following multiple tasks or cases through to completion.

8. How you typically keep track of outstanding items that require follow-up.



**Short Application Scenario**



Please review the following situation:

You begin work Monday and see the following:

Patient A: PT referral received, but physician information is missing.

Patient B: SLP referral email sent, but no therapist has been assigned.

Patient C: An OT accepted the case Friday, but no evaluation date has been provided.

Patient D: An evaluation was reportedly completed, but the documentation has not been submitted.

Patient E: A therapist can accept a referral but is asking what the visit rate is.



Please briefly explain:

* What order you would address these items

* What action you would take for each

* Which items you would handle independently

* Which items you would escalate to company leadership

* How you would make sure none of the five items were forgotten after your initial follow-up



We are looking for someone who can help us build and maintain a **calm, responsive, organized operation** as our company continues to grow.

title: Ads Copywriter (WFH / Remote)
description:
Full-time | Remote Setup/Work from Home

Working Hours: 9AM - 6PM (SGT)

Salary: SGD 1,000+ monthly (with performance bonuses)



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their industry, and they don’t pay us for views or pretty content. They pay us for leads, booked calls and closed business.



This role is a big part of that engine. Your job is to come up with strong angles for each client, and then write everything that carries those angles: video ad scripts, image ads, landing page copy, VSL scripts, Meta ad copy, and follow-up emails and WhatsApp messages. Your work runs on live campaigns with real budgets, and you’ll know within days whether it worked. If that excites you, keep reading.



What the setup looks like

You’ll join our ads department and work alongside team members with different specialist skill sets across media buying, funnels and creative, plus our strategists and the founder. We serve a growing base of ad clients and we’re scaling fast. Main channel is Meta. Market is Singapore. Niches are financial advisory and real estate, which means trust-based selling.



What you’ll do

• Come up with strong angles for each client based on their positioning, audience and offer

• Write high converting video ad scripts, image ad copy, VSL scripts, landing page copy and Meta ad copy

• Write follow-up emails and WhatsApp messages that keep leads moving towards booked calls

• Review results weekly with the ads lead, spot the winning angles, and write the next round based on data

• Write for real Singapore FA and RE audiences based on what they actually think and want. No generic “financial freedom” filler

• Build our angle library as you go, so every winning angle compounds for the whole team



How you’ll be measured

Hit rate. Out of every batch of scripts you write, a minimum share needs to become winners: strong lead costs, campaigns that can scale. Our current bar is at least 2 winners out of every 8 video scripts. You’ll see your numbers every week. Good writers want to be measured. It’s how you prove you’re good.



You’ll do well here if you

• Care about the difference between copy that reads well and copy that converts, and chase the second

• Rewrite your own hooks before anyone asks

• Study why an ad worked, not just that it worked

• Take feedback well. Your copy gets reviewed, tested and sometimes rewritten. That’s how everyone here improves, including us



This is not for you if you

• Want a job where you clock in, clear tasks and clock out at 6 sharp

• Have freelance clients or side hustles competing for your focus. We’re not saying no life outside work. We’re saying this has to be your main thing, because split attention shows in the work

• Prefer writing from templates instead of thinking through the audience and angle each time



No hard feelings either way. We’d rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

• You’ve written copy for service professionals

• Bigger bonus: financial advisors or real estate specifically

• Biggest bonus: you’ve done it for the Singapore market



What you get

• Your work runs on live campaigns with real budgets. Fast feedback, real stakes, visible results

• Direct access to the founder and strategists. You learn how campaigns are actually planned, not just briefed

• A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, and overseas team trips

• Real room to grow into a senior copy and strategy role as we scale



How to apply


 
 with the subject line: 

Your Next Copywriter - [Your Full Name]

Your email should include:

• Cover letter: years of copywriting experience and how you think you can contribute to Trident Digital

• Updated CV/Resume

• Portfolio: your 3 best pieces of ad copy or scripts, with 2 to 3 sentences on each explaining the choices you made

• One short exercise: pick any ad you’ve seen that you think is weak, and rewrite the hook. A few lines is enough. We’re looking at how you think

• Expected salary in SGD



Important Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. The exercise is part of the screening. It tells us more than a CV can.

Brand growth and client confidence. Clients whose authority and presence visibly grow — stronger positioning, growing reach, content their market actually engages with and remembers. And clients who renew because they can feel the strategy working. You'll run insights calls with clients to review whether the strategy is delivering — and adjust when it isn't. If you'd rather be measured on outcomes than on how many posts went out, you'll enjoy this.



You'll do well here if you

• Think in brand outcomes first: you ask "what does this client need to be known for?" before you ask "what should we post?"

• Can walk into a client call, present a direction, and hold your ground when it's challenged—with reasoning, not stubbornness

• Study why a piece of content worked, not just that it worked

• Give creatives feedback that makes the work better, not just different

• Communicate proactively. Clients and the team should never have to chase you for an update



This is not for you if you

• Think strategy means a content calendar with theme days

• Have freelance clients or side hustles competing for your focus. This has to be your main thing, because split attention shows in the work

• Chase trends for their own sake. A trending format that doesn't fit a financial advisor's positioning is a distraction, not a strategy

• Avoid client-facing pressure. Presenting, defending and realigning is half this job



No hard feelings either way. We'd rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

• You've built content strategies for service professionals or personal brands

• Bigger bonus: financial advisors, insurance or real estate specifically

• Biggest bonus: you've done it for the Singapore market



What you get

• Real ownership of strategy, working directly with the founder and clients — not three layers removed from the decisions

• Your strategies run on real accounts with real stakes. You see whether your thinking works, fast

• A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, and overseas team trips

• Room to grow into a head of strategy role as the agency scales

 with the subject line:

title: GenAI Prompt Engineer
description:
GenAI Prompt Engineer

HeartStamp  •  Remote  •  Full-Time



About HeartStamp



HeartStamp is an AI-powered greeting card & invitation platform built for Millennials and Gen Z who find traditional cards cringe, generic, and emotionally hollow. Our platform lets users customize cards with AI, then either print them on demand or deliver them as interactive digital cards.



Art is one of the five pillars of every HeartStamp card (Holiday, Emotion, Art, Relationship, Text), and it's the pillar that makes a card feel like nothing else on the shelf. We're looking for someone to own that pillar.



About the Role



We're hiring a GenAI Prompt Engineer to lead the visual language of our card library: the art styles, movements, and looks that show up across every card we create. This role reports directly to our CEO and works alongside our creative director.



This is a full-time, fully remote position. We're looking for someone who treats generative AI models, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and the latest image generators, as their studio. You should already be building your own workflows to research styles, invent new ones, and produce work at a volume no single human hand could match without AI.



We move fast and ship constantly, so we need someone who can take a concept, turn it into a fully realized, production-ready style, and keep raising the bar on both quality and range as they go.



What You'll Create



Your work spans style development, production, and workflow. At a high level:



Art Style & Creative Direction



-Draw from the full history of art movements and media (painting, illustration, animation, photography, digital art, and beyond) to build new looks for HeartStamp cards



-Combine styles that don't normally get combined, creating original looks that are ours and ours alone



-Develop new art styles built specifically to resonate with Gen Z, grounded in what's actually trending in their feeds and communities, not what we assume they like



-Keep expanding our style library so our card art never goes stale or repeats itself. We have a creative staff to support. 



Production at Scale



-Write and structure image prompts in JSON so they can be generated, stored, and reused at scale across our card library

-Build prompt sets and templates that let us produce large batches of on-style card designs without starting from scratch each time

-Work with our GenAI Orchestrator (the internal system that routes render requests to our supported image models) to get new styles into production



AI-Native Workflow Development



-Use Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and other LLMs to design and refine art styles, not just to generate one-off images

-Build and improve your own workflows and tooling to automate the repetitive parts of prompt writing and style development

-Track the newest image generation models, including GPT-Image-2.5, xAI's Imagine, and Nano Banana, and fold what's useful into our production pipeline



What We're Looking For



Must-Have



-A strong portfolio showing command of a wide range of art styles and movements, and the ability to combine them into something new

-A demonstrated ability to create original art styles, particularly ones that resonate with Gen Z

-A genuine, current understanding of Gen Z culture: the visual trends, aesthetics, and social media movements they respond to, and why

-Comfort using LLMs like Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini as creative tools, to develop new art styles and automate parts of your own workflow, not just to write one-off prompts

-Experience working with JSON data, and the ability to write and structure image prompts in JSON format at scale

-Familiarity with the newest image generation models, including GPT-Image-2.5, xAI's Imagine, and Nano Banana

-Ability to produce a high volume of on-brand, high-quality art without sacrificing creative range



Nice to Have

-Familiarity with ComfyUI



Aesthetic Direction



HeartStamp's brand is smart, emotionally literate, and a little unhinged in the best possible way. Our card library should reflect the full range of art under the sun: watercolor, neon carnival, cyberpunk, Bauhaus, anime, character style transfers, and anything else that helps a card say exactly the right thing. We want someone who can push our style range further than it's ever gone, especially into territory that feels current and native to Gen Z rather than dated or generic.



We'll work closely with you on creative direction, but we want someone with strong instincts and opinions about what makes an art style actually land with our audience.



Engagement Details



-Remote: Fully remote, anywhere in the world

-Employment type: Full-time, reporting directly to our CEO

-Hours: Mon-Fri 8am-4pm EST

-Compensation: [$8-$13/hr range based on experience, talent, proficiency]



How to Apply



-Send us a brief introduction that covers the following:

-A portfolio link showing the range of art styles and movements you work in, including any original styles you've developed

-Examples of prompts or workflows you've built using JSON and LLMs like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini

-The image generation models and tools you use, including any experience with GPT-Image-2.0/2.5, xAI's Imagine, Nano Banana, or ComfyUI



We review on a rolling basis and move quickly when we find the right fit. We'd love to see your work.

title: Admin VA | Job Tracking & Data Accuracy| Trade/Construction Experience Non-Negotiable
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



A fast-moving plumbing/trade business needs a full-time, admin-focused Virtual Assistant who can step in and immediately reduce the amount of oversight the business owners currently have to provide. The single biggest lesson from the previous placement is that trade and construction industry knowledge is no longer a preference — it's a non-negotiable. This time, the candidate needs to already understand how job tracking, timesheets, quoting, and trade platforms work, so they can spot when something looks wrong and take initiative rather than waiting to be told.



The challenge being solved is consistency and trust. The business wants someone who is present and getting things done in the background, without needing to be actively managed, chased for updates, or asked to redo work. Success looks like the owners opening their inbox or WhatsApp to find that timesheets have already been cross-checked, job management and accounting data is clean, invoices have a home, and any judgement calls have been made with a recommended option attached, not bounced back as a question.



What You'll Own



SimPro & Project Management



Data syncing and audits between the job management platform and accounting system: spotting duplicates and ensuring "true numbers" for price files

Project tracking: updating job notes, closing finished projects, and flagging overdue items and stale quotes

Generating POs from invoices that come into the account without an existing job to sit under (daily/weekly review)



Financial & Bookkeeping Admin (bonus, not core)



An external bookkeeper handles daily bank reconciliation and cost-tracking, so this is not part of the VA's core scope

Strong accounting-platform experience alongside trade admin experience is a genuine bonus, not a requirement

Payroll and compliance remain core: timesheet collection, leave tracking, and Long Service Leave database entries alongside the accounting platform



Data Entry & Quality Assurance



A standalone priority following past issues with unchecked, duplicated, or guessed data

Catching duplicate job entries, incorrect addresses, and other data errors before they're submitted or actioned

Comfortable saying "I don't have this information yet" rather than filling a gap with something unverified



Documentation & Safety



Moving SWMS/JSAs onto the job management platform so the team signs on daily for liability coverage

Building and maintaining a library of Standard Operating Procedures as tasks are handed over



Customer & Team Coordination



Calendar and scheduling upkeep is internal-facing only — sending push reminders to keep dates and calendars accurate; client-facing scheduling is managed personally by the business owner, largely by phone

Direct handling of client
 inquiries is not part of this role

Team coordination: proactively cross-checking timesheets, job addresses, and site details directly with the crew via short, personalised phone calls or messages — not long
s and not group broadcasts, which the team tends to tune out

Confidence to have those quick, direct conversations with the team rather than avoiding them



HR & Marketing Admin



Recruitment support: managing job listings and preparing new-hire files — templates and interview materials are already built, so this is a lighter lift than a from-scratch recruitment function

Marketing lite: sourcing job imagery (before/after photos) for future content and marketing use

Bonus/future scope: possible social media management once the new business website is live — a best-case scenario, not a core requirement for this hire



What We're Looking For



Experience



Trade or construction industry background is non-negotiable

Prior experience supporting an Australian trades or construction business preferred



Technical Proficiency



SimPro experience is the gold standard

ServiceM8 or Tradify (or a comparable trade platform) is the acceptable minimum — general trade/construction exposure matters more than the specific platform

Xero exposure is helpful but no longer core

Comfortable with task management, cloud file storage, and digital form tools (e.g. Asana, Google Drive, Jotform, or equivalents)



Organisational Skills / Data Accuracy



A genuine "numbers brain": high attention to detail, comfortable auditing data rather than copy-pasting it without checking

Catches duplicate entries, incorrect addresses, and inconsistencies before they cause downstream problems



Non-Negotiables



Works with minimal supervision and minimal detailed briefs, comfortable filling gaps using workflow knowledge rather than defaulting to a question

Brings already-considered options ("do you want A or B") rather than open-ended questions

Proactively confirms once requested feedback has actually been implemented, without needing to be chased

Understands how a trade/construction business runs day to day: jobs, timesheets, SWMS, PO generation, stale quotes

Able to plug into an existing job management/accounting/task-management setup and contribute from day one, ideally having done this with another trades client before



Why This Role



Real trust and autonomy from day one for someone who's earned it through relevant experience

Work directly with business owners who want a true second-in-command on admin, not someone to micromanage

A defined, well-supported task list — recruitment templates, interview materials, and existing systems are already in place

Room for the role to grow into broader marketing/social scope as the business's website and content plans mature



How to Apply



To be considered, please complete this form and include a short video introduction — it helps us shortlist quickly:

title: Female Virtual Assistant
description:
Join a Fast-Growing U.S. Residential Remodeling Company — Long-Term Opportunity



Are you the type of person who notices the details other people miss?



Are you highly organized, great with technology, excellent at communicating, and capable of figuring things out on your own?

You actually care about doing excellent work

Enter and maintain data

Organize project information

Track important information and deadlines
