As you become more familiar with the company, your responsibilities can grow.



We want someone who can eventually take ownership of important parts of our customer service, lead management, administration, and operations.



🧠 THE TYPE OF PERSON WE WANT



We're NOT looking for someone who simply says:



"Tell me what to do."



We're looking for someone who says:



"I noticed this problem. Here's what I think we should do."



That's the difference.



We want someone who is:



🔥 Proactive — You take initiative instead of waiting around.



🎯 Detail-Oriented — You double-check your work and catch mistakes before they become problems.



💻 Tech-Savvy — You aren't intimidated by new software. You actually enjoy learning it.



📋 Organized — You know what needs to be done and keep track of your responsibilities.



🗣️ An Excellent Communicator — Your English is clear, professional, and easy to understand.



🧩 A Problem Solver — You can research, troubleshoot, and figure things out.



⚡ Fast & Efficient — You understand that speed matters, but never at the expense of accuracy.



🤝 Reliable — When you say you'll do something, you get it done.



📈 Growth-Minded — You want to develop your skills and take on more responsibility over time.



✅ REQUIREMENTS

Previous VA, administrative, customer service, or similar experience

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong attention to detail

Excellent organizational skills

Strong computer skills

Comfortable using Google Workspace

Comfortable with Google Sheets/Excel

Comfortable learning CRM systems and other software

Fast learner

Strong internet connection

Reliable computer

Quiet and professional workspace

Ability to work independently

Excellent follow-through

Ability to handle confidential customer/business information professionally



Experience with a remodeling, construction, home-services, real-estate, or similar U.S. business is a PLUS — but not required.



🚨 PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



We are looking for a long-term team member, not someone who plans to disappear after a few weeks.



We will invest time into training the right person, so we expect the right person to bring:



Commitment + Reliability + Initiative + Attention to Detail + A Willingness to Learn



If you are looking for a job where you can do the bare minimum, this isn't for you.



If you want an opportunity where your responsibilities can grow as you prove yourself, keep reading.



🌟 WHY THIS CAN BE A GREAT OPPORTUNITY



We're a growing company, which means there is room to grow with us.



As you learn our business and demonstrate that you can handle more responsibility, there will be opportunities to take on more important responsibilities within the company.



We value people who:



Take ownership

Learn quickly

Solve problems

Communicate well

Consistently deliver high-quality work

Help make the company better



We don't just want an employee. We want someone who can become a valuable part of our team.



🚀 READY TO JOIN US?



If you're a smart, organized, tech-savvy, detail-oriented woman who wants to build a long-term career working with a growing U.S. company, we want to hear from you.



When you apply, make sure your application shows us why YOU are different from the average VA applicant.



We are looking for someone who can make us think:



"We need to interview this person."

title: Sims 4 Mod Developer
description:
SIMS 4 MOD DEVELOPER — NIMALU SIMS ™️



Remote · Part-time · Up to $600 USD per month

Apply at 
 — do not DM, apply through the portal



THE BASICS

Hours: 20 hours per week, EST

Pay: Up to $600 USD per month, depending on experience

Paid on: The 5th and the 20th of each month, prorated

Location: Fully remote

Must have: The Sims 4 installed on a Windows PC with Storage Space

Start: ASAP



WHO WE ARE

Nimalu Sims is a Sims 4 studio run by a creator who's been playing since she was 12. We make mods, custom content and tools — from CAS to build/buy to gameplay nobody else has built yet — and we make them cozy. Our work is on Curse Forge, Patreon, Tumblr and TikTok, our Trait Generator runs free in the browser, and we have a Skool community and a 
 that grow with every release.



Until now one person has built all of it. We need a second pair of hands who can take a mod from idea to working package on their own, and keep the existing catalog working through every EA patch.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Build new mods end to end: mesh or clone, textures, package, tuning, strings across all locales

• Write tuning XML for interactions, buffs, loots, traits, aspirations, scenarios and lot traits

• Write Python 3.7 script mods where tuning alone can't do it

• Create custom content and recolors — swatch sets, material variants, catalog placement, thumbnails

• Fix what breaks after each game patch, and verify the fix actually worked

• Reproduce community bug reports and trace them through lastException.txt

• Keep everything base-game compatible unless there's no way around it



WHAT YOU NEED

• Published Sims 4 mods people have actually downloaded — this is not a role to learn on

• Tuning XML, fluently

• Python 3.7

• Sims 4 Studio, including the Warehouse tab

• Mod Constructor

• Blender, enough for object meshes and LODs

• Photoshop for textures and recolors, Canva for release graphics

• The Sims 4 on your own PC, with a machine that runs it heavily modded



WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU STAND OUT

DBPF structure. S4TK or similar tooling. Animation tuning. Having maintained a mod through several patch cycles. Knowing why an object might only show with bb.showhiddenobjects on.



You will be tested on these. Make sure you're fully knowledgeable before applying.



THIS ISN'T FOR YOU IF

• You've never played or modded The Sims 4

• Your experience is tutorials, not published work

• You only want to build new things — half this job is keeping old things alive



HOW TO APPLY

1. Links to mods you've made — packages, scripts, CC or recolors. Two finished things beat a long list.

2. A piece of custom content you made yourself, and what was hard about it.

3. A short task: A custom interaction stopped appearing on chairs after a game patch. Walk us through the first five things you'd check, in order, and why.



The task carries more weight than the CV. If it's a fit, there's one call and a practical test.



Apply via 
 — do not DM.

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career

Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Fully remote position

title: Social Media Content & Repurposing VA:  Coaching/Podcast Brand (Part-Time, Room to Grow)
description:
About Me

I'm Janna Holterman, a Cardiac ICU nurse turned mindset and emotional healing coach and trained intuitive. I help high-achieving women who look like they have it all together (the career, the certifications, the house, the relationship) but still feel numb, empty, or like something's missing. I teach from the intersection of neuroscience, psychology, emotional processing, intuition and energy healing. My podcast, Unlocking Your More: with Janna Holterman, and my Instagram/TikTok content are where most people first find me I post everything under my own name/personal brand.

I'm looking for a Social Media Content Assistant to help me turn the content I already have (podcast episodes, past posts, raw video/audio) into fresh, scroll-stopping posts and Reels and to help move the right people from "just scrolling" into my world: listening to the podcast, signing up for my free training, or exploring a paid offer.

This is a part-time, remote, long-term role starting at 6 hours/week, with room to grow in hours and responsibility as we build trust and you show me what you can do.



What You'll Be Doing

Content repurposing (the core of the role)

Turn podcast episodes (audio and video) into short-form clips for Instagram Reels and TikToks,  finding the strongest hooks, moments, and quotes

Edit clips with captions/subtitles, clean cuts, and a consistent, on-brand look and feel

Repurpose existing content (past posts, podcast transcripts, quotes, testimonials) into new static posts, carousels, and Stories

Write captions and hooks that sound like me: direct, warm, no-fluff, and rooted in real teaching, not generic motivational quotes

Driving the right action

Every piece of content should point toward one of three outcomes: listening to the podcast, signing up for my free training (Regulated AF or a free monthly webinar), or learning about a paid offer

Build simple, consistent calls-to-action into captions, Stories, and video end cards

Help maintain a content calendar so posting stays consistent

Content organization

Keep an organized library of raw footage, edited clips, graphics, and captions so content is easy to find and reuse

Flag which older podcast episodes or posts have the strongest potential for repurposing

(This role may grow to include light community engagement replying to comments/DMs, engagement pods, or basic analytics tracking as hours increase.)



Who I'm Looking For

Must-haves:

Proven experience repurposing long-form content (podcast, YouTube, webinars) into short-form social content please include samples or a portfolio link

Comfortable editing video independently in tools like CapCut, Premiere Pro, Descript, or similar (you should already have a workflow this isn't a role where I'll be training someone on the basics of editing)

Strong eye for hooks you understand why the first 1-3 seconds of a Reel/TikTok either stops the scroll or loses it

Confident, clear written English for captions and copy

Experience with Canva (or similar) for static posts and carousels

Self-starter who can take a pile of raw content and turn it into a week's worth of posts with minimal hand-holding

Reliable, communicative, and comfortable with async work and weekly check-ins

Nice-to-haves (not required, but a bonus):

Familiarity with the coaching, wellness, mindset, or personal development space

Experience with email marketing platforms or funnels (since one of the goals of this role is growing my email list)

Basic understanding of Instagram/TikTok algorithm best practices and current trends/audio

Experience writing hooks or captions for a personal brand (not just a business/product brand)



Schedule & Compensation

Hours: Starting at 6 hours/week, with strong potential to grow into more hours (and more responsibility) for the right person

Rate: $6–$9 USD/hour, depending on experience and skill level to be discussed during the interview

Schedule: Mostly asynchronous/flexible you manage your own time to hit weekly deliverables, with one short weekly check-in call

Type: Independent contractor, long-term ongoing role if it’s a strong fit



How to Apply

To help me find the right person quickly, please apply with:

Your resume or a short intro about your relevant experience



2–3 examples of content you've repurposed before and after (e.g., "here's the podcast clip, here's the Reel I made from it") or a portfolio/social link showing your editing and caption work



A one-line answer to this question in your application: "What's one thing that makes you stop scrolling on a Reel or TikTok and want to click to learn more from someone?"



To confirm you've read this whole posting, please start your application message with the word "Intuition" in the subject line and tell me about an adversity you’ve overcome and how it made you stronger. Applications without this will not be reviewed.

I'm excited to find someone who gets genuinely excited about turning raw content into scroll-stopping posts and who wants to grow with me long-term.

title: Remote Front Desk & Operations Coordinator
description:
Position Overview

We are a New Jersey-based glazing company specializing in residential and commercial glass installation. We are seeking an extremely organized, detail-oriented, and dependable Front Desk & Operations Coordinator to manage the administrative flow of jobs from the initial customer inquiry through scheduling, ordering, installation, invoicing, and payment.

This is much more than a traditional receptionist position. The person in this role will serve as a central point of coordination between customers, estimators, technicians, management, and vendors.

Because measurements, product specifications, scheduling, and ordering must be highly accurate, the ideal candidate is someone who naturally double- and triple-checks their work, catches inconsistencies before they become problems, and enjoys creating organized systems.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Intake & Job Setup

• Answer and manage incoming customer inquiries professionally.

• Gather all required information for new residential and commercial jobs.

• Accurately enter customer, project, measurement, scheduling, and job information into the appropriate company software and spreadsheets.

• Make sure job files are complete before moving them to the next stage.

• Follow up with customers when additional information is required.

Estimating & Measurement Scheduling

• Schedule estimates and on-site measuring appointments.

• Coordinate appointments between customers and company estimators/technicians.

• Confirm appointments and communicate schedule changes.

• Ensure measurements and job specifications are properly documented and entered into the system.

Technician Scheduling & Dispatch Coordination

• Build and manage technicians' daily schedules.

• Coordinate installations, measurements, service calls, and other field appointments.

• Handle last-minute customer cancellations, rescheduling, technician changes, and other scheduling conflicts.

• Communicate schedule updates quickly and clearly to customers and technicians.

• Help maximize technician productivity while maintaining realistic travel and job-completion schedules.

Ordering & Vendor Coordination

• Manage product and material orders for jobs.

• Communicate directly with vendors regarding pricing, product specifications, availability, lead times, order status, and delivery timelines.

• Compare purchase information against job specifications before submitting orders.

• Follow up on delayed or incomplete orders.

• Maintain organized records of vendor communications and purchase information.

Measurement & Order Accuracy

Accuracy is a critical part of this position. The coordinator will be expected to:

• Cross-reference measurements between estimates, field measurements, orders, invoices, and job records.

• Double- and triple-check measurements before orders are finalized.

• Identify conflicting or missing information before it causes a costly mistake.

• Verify dimensions, quantities, product types, finishes, hardware, and other job specifications.

• Escalate questionable or inconsistent measurements before an order is placed.

Candidates must be comfortable reading and working with tape-measure measurements and fractions down to 1/16 of an inch, including measurements such as 24 15/16", 37 7/16", and 48 3/8".

Invoicing & Payments

• Prepare and send customer invoices.

• Follow up regarding outstanding balances when necessary.

• Process customer payments according to company procedures.

• Maintain accurate payment records.

• Verify that invoices correspond correctly with completed work and job information.

Payroll & Administrative Support

• Assist management with payroll preparation and employee time information.

• Verify technician hours and related information before payroll is submitted.

• Maintain accurate administrative records.

• Assist management with other operational and administrative responsibilities as needed.

Software & Process Improvement

• Learn and utilize Smart Glazier.

• Work extensively with Microsoft 365, Outlook, and Excel.

• Help implement new software, modules, automations, and operational systems.

• Test new workflows and identify repetitive or inefficient processes.

• Help management create more organized and streamlined procedures.

• Learn new software and technology quickly.

Required Qualifications

• Excellent written and verbal American English communication skills.

• Exceptional attention to detail.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills.

• Ability to manage multiple active jobs simultaneously.

• Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

• Strong follow-through and accountability.

• Excellent computer skills and strong Microsoft Excel skills.

• Experience using Microsoft 365 and Outlook.

• Ability to learn unfamiliar software quickly.

• Comfort working with tape-measure measurements and fractions down to 1/16 of an inch.

• Ability and willingness to cross-reference and triple-check important information.

• Professional telephone and customer-service skills.

• Ability to remain organized while handling last-minute changes and interruptions.

• Comfortable communicating regularly through video calls using Microsoft Teams and Zoom.

Experience in glazing, construction, home improvement, contracting, installation, dispatching, estimating, or a similar field is strongly preferred but not required for an exceptional candidate who learns quickly.

Ideal Candidate

• Notices when one number does not match another.

• Naturally checks their work before submitting it.

• Enjoys organizing complicated information.

• Can manage many moving parts at once without losing track of the details.

• Is comfortable asking questions when something does not look correct.

• Learns new systems quickly.

• Communicates clearly and professionally with both customers and technicians.

• Takes ownership of problems until they are resolved.

• Is proactive rather than waiting to be told every next step.

• Enjoys finding better, faster, and more organized ways to operate.

In this position, accuracy is just as important as speed.

A small measurement, ordering, or scheduling mistake can create significant delays and costs, so we are looking for someone who takes pride in getting things right.

Remote Work Requirements

This is a 100% remote position. Candidates must have their own professional work-from-home setup, including:

• Modern, updated computer capable of efficiently running all required company software.

• Reliable high-speed internet connection.

• Reliable backup internet connection.

• Reliable power backup solution.

• Quality noise-canceling headset.

• Webcam.

• Quiet, private, and professional workspace.

• Ability to participate professionally in Microsoft Teams and Zoom video meetings.

• Ability to work uninterrupted during scheduled business hours.

Schedule

Monday-Friday | 9:00 AM-6:00 PM Eastern Time

Candidates must be consistently available during these hours.

Systems Used

• Smart Glazier

• Microsoft 365

• Microsoft Outlook

• Microsoft Excel

• Microsoft Teams

• Additional software and operational tools as implemented

Prior Smart Glazier experience is a plus but is not required. The ability to quickly learn and confidently use new software is required.

What Success Looks Like

• Every incoming job is entered correctly.

• Estimates and measurements are scheduled promptly.

• Technicians know exactly where they need to be and when.

• Customers receive clear communication.

• Orders match the actual measurements and job specifications.

• Vendors are followed up with consistently.

• Invoices and payments are processed accurately.

• Management has reliable information.

• Fewer mistakes occur because details are caught before they become problems.

• Company processes become more organized and efficient over time.

title: Administrative and Referral Support Assistant
description:
Position Overview



Recovery Resources Network is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Administrative and Referral Support Assistant to support referral coordination, administrative operations, data management, communications, and social media outreach.



This position helps maintain accurate referral records, coordinate follow-up, support communication with clients and community partners, manage administrative information across approved systems, and ensure that public-facing content is entered and tracked accurately. The ideal candidate is dependable, professional, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and committed to protecting confidential information.



Key Responsibilities



Referral and Administrative Support



* Receive, organize, and process new client referrals.

* Enter referral information accurately and promptly into Solutionize TeamPatient.

* Track referral status, follow-up dates, required documents, insurance information, placement activity, and assigned responsibilities.

* Document client-related calls and communications in TeamPatient.

* Complete follow-up calls and communications with referral partners, clients, families, providers, and community partners as directed.

* Maintain accurate referral timelines and identify missing or outstanding information.

* Schedule meetings, appointments, interviews, and follow-up activities.

* Prepare approved correspondence, forms, reports, agendas, and administrative documents.

* Support daily office operations and special projects assigned by leadership.

* Escalate urgent concerns, incomplete referrals, placement barriers, and unresolved issues to the appropriate RRN team member.



Data Entry and Records Management



* Enter information accurately and promptly into approved systems.

* Review records for completeness, consistency, and duplicate entries.

* Update contact information, referral status, follow-up activity, and administrative notes.

* Maintain organized electronic files in accordance with RRN procedures.

* Use approved templates, naming conventions, and documentation standards.

* Verify information before saving, submitting, or distributing records.

* Protect confidential information and follow minimum-necessary-information procedures.

* Report data-entry errors, access concerns, or system issues promptly.



Social Media and Outreach Support



* Enter and maintain approved social media content in RRN CONNECT’s designated content calendar or scheduling platform.

* Accurately input captions, dates, times, hashtags, links, campaign information, and platform-specific details.

* Schedule approved posts across designated social media platforms.

* Maintain social media tracking spreadsheets and reports, including post dates, content categories, campaign names, links, and engagement information.

* Track published, scheduled, revised, and canceled posts.

* Enter approved community events, announcements, resources, and outreach activities into social media systems.

* Monitor assigned accounts for basic administrative activity, including comments, messages, tags, and engagement.

* Route clinical, crisis-related, confidential, or sensitive inquiries to the appropriate RRN team member without providing unauthorized advice.

* Ensure all content is entered exactly as approved and contains no protected client information.

* Maintain consistent spelling, grammar, formatting, branding, and accessibility standards.

* Assist with basic social media reports covering posting frequency, reach, engagement, and campaign performance.

* Confirm leadership approval before scheduling or publishing content.



Client names, photographs, diagnoses, treatment information, referral details, insurance information, and other confidential information must not be posted without written authorization and organizational approval.



Systems and Data Responsibilities



Solutionize TeamPatient



Solutionize TeamPatient is RRN CONNECT’s secure system of record for client and referral activity. Responsibilities include:



* Entering referrals promptly and accurately.

* Documenting client-related calls and communications.

* Maintaining referral status, contact attempts, insurance information, required documents, placement activity, follow-up dates, and assigned responsibilities.

* Uploading referral documents only through approved TeamPatient procedures.

* Creating and managing follow-up tasks.

* Alerting the appropriate team member when documentation is incomplete or a referral requires immediate attention.

* Maintaining a complete and accurate referral timeline.

* Following TeamPatient access controls and confidentiality requirements.

* Never exporting, photographing, downloading, copying, or transmitting client information outside approved RRN systems without authorization.



Little Green Light



Little Green Light is used for nonclinical organizational relationship management, including:



* Donor and fundraising records.

* Community-partner contacts.

* Treatment-provider and organizational relationships.

* Outreach history.

* Event and meeting records.

* Grant-related contacts.

* General relationship-management activities.



Client medical information, diagnoses, treatment history, insurance records, referral narratives, clinical notes, and placement documentation must not be entered into Little Green Light.



Slack



Slack is used for workflow communication and hourly accountability. Client-related updates must use an RRN-assigned client identification number rather than a client’s full name.



Detailed client information, diagnoses, insurance information, referral documents, and clinical discussions must remain in TeamPatient.



Google Workspace



Google Workspace is used for approved administrative functions, including:



* Calendar management.

* Meeting scheduling.

* Nonclinical meeting agendas and minutes.

* General organizational documents.

* Approved templates and resource directories.

* Nonclinical spreadsheets and administrative reports.

* Social media content calendars and approved outreach-tracking documents.



Information from TeamPatient must not be transferred into Google Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail, Slack, social media platforms, or any other system unless the specific workflow has been approved by RRN leadership.



Required Qualifications and Skills



* High school diploma or equivalent; additional training in administration, communications, marketing, or human services is preferred.

* Experience in administrative support, data entry, referral coordination, customer service, communications, or social media support.

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

* Ability to enter, organize, and maintain information across multiple systems.

* Familiarity with social media platforms and content-scheduling tools.

* Ability to follow written procedures and protect confidential information.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Professional, respectful, dependable, and service-oriented work style.

* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.

* Basic proficiency with Google Workspace, spreadsheets,
, calendars, and online databases.

* Ability to learn and use Solutionize TeamPatient, Little Green Light, Slack, and approved social media tools.

* Ability to work independently while communicating effectively with the RRN CONNECT team.



Preferred Qualifications



* Experience in behavioral health, healthcare, social services, nonprofit administration, or referral coordination.

* Experience with electronic health records or secure referral-management systems.

* Experience with donor or relationship-management databases.

* Experience entering, scheduling, and tracking social media content.

* Familiarity with privacy, confidentiality, HIPAA-related practices, or protected information.

* Experience preparing basic social media or outreach reports.

* Experience working with community partners, treatment providers, or referral sources.



Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be demonstrated by:



* Accurate and timely entry of referral and administrative records.

* Consistent completion and documentation of follow-up tasks.

* Accurate entry, scheduling, and tracking of approved social media content.

* Public-facing content that reflects approved messaging, accurate information, and RRN CONNECT branding.

* Consistent protection of confidential and protected information.

* Professional, timely, and appropriate communication.

* Prompt identification and correction of data-entry errors.

* Completion of required hourly updates and workflow communication.

* Appropriate escalation of questions, risks, urgent concerns, and unresolved issues.

* Reliable, organized, accountable, and respectful interactions with clients, families, referral sources, community partners, and coworkers.

Only apply if you can produce professional animation comparable in quality, movement, and intensity to: 

* The Boondocks 

* Hellsing Ultimate 

* Black Lagoon 

* Tokyo Ghoul 

* Attack on Titan 



These are quality references only. All work must be original. 



The series includes graphic blood, violence, firearms, weapon usage, injuries, fight scenes, and mature themes. Do not apply if you are uncomfortable animating this content. 



Portfolio Required 

You must provide a relevant animation portfolio showing character movement, action, fight scenes, cinematic camera work, or completed animated scenes. 



Illustration-only portfolios will not qualify. Applications without relevant professional animation samples will be declined.



Paid 30- Second Trial Test - $150



Shortlisted applicants will receive a paid 30-second trial for $150. It will not include dialogue or lip-sync but may include action, character movement, weapons, blood effects, backgrounds, camera movement, and sound effects. 

Any sound effects must be original or legally licensed for commercial use. YouTube audio without confirmed usage rights is prohibited. 



AI-generated animation, AI-generated drawings, AI-generated in-between frames, AI-generated backgrounds, or AI-assisted work is not permitted unless explicitly approved in writing beforehand.



The trial includes one reasonable revision round based on creative direction.

An applicant hired for the full production may receive an additional $50 welcome bonus. 



Required Trial Files 

An MP4 alone will not be accepted. You must submit: 

* Final animation export 

* Editable native project files 

* Storyboard and animatic 

* Roughs, keyframes, breakdowns, and in-betweens 

* Original drawings and separated layers 

* Backgrounds, props, weapons, and effects 

*Rigs and reusable assets, if used 

*Compositions and audio stems 

*Fonts, plug-ins, and linked assets required to open the project 

*Organized folders and handoff notes 



Files must be organized so another animator can open the project, continue production, reuse assets, or revise previous work without starting over.



You must be comfortable collaborating with other artists and working within an established production pipeline. This project may involve coordinating with storyboard artists, background artists, animators, compositors, sound designers, and other team members to ensure a consistent, high-quality final product.





You may be required to provide progress files, timeline screenshots, layer structures, or a short workspace recording proving you created the submitted work. Stolen, traced, AI-generated, or secretly subcontracted work will be disqualified. 



Ownership and Agreement 

Before starting, the animator must sign an Animation Development Agreement (ADA) and Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA). 



All work created, provided, or submitted specifically for the paid trial or series—including drafts, drawings, animation, rigs, backgrounds, effects, reusable assets, and project files—will belong exclusively to me upon payment. I may edit, continue, reproduce, publish, monetize, and use that work without additional permission or payment. 



Project materials may not be reused, sold, shared, leaked, subcontracted, or posted publicly without my written permission. No copyrighted third-party materials may be used without approved commercial rights. 



To Apply 

Please provide: 

1. Your animation portfolio 

2. Your best action or cinematic animation sample 

3. The software you use 

4. Your location, time zone, and availability 

5. Whether you work alone or with a team 

6. Your rate for continued production 

7. Confirmation that you accept the $150 trial 

8. Confirmation that you will provide all editable source files 

9. Confirmation that you will sign the ADA and NDA 



Begin your application with “SOURCE FILES INCLUDED” so I know you read the complete posting.

title: Senior Accountant / Controller
description:
**PLEASE MAKE SURE TO ATTACH/LINK YOUR RESUME AND VIDEO INTRODUCTION BEFORE APPLYING OTHERWISE YOUR APPLICATION WILL BE IGNORED**



Senior Accountant / Controller







Job Type: Full-Time



Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM Central Time, with a 30-minute break







Job Overview:



We are seeking a highly experienced and hands-on Senior Accountant / Controller to take full ownership of the accounting function for a growing apparel decoration, manufacturing, and e-commerce company with approximately 50 employees. This is a hands-on role where the successful candidate will work directly in the books every day, managing the full accounting cycle, including AP, AR, reconciliations, journal entries, month-end close, inventory accounting, landed costs, and financial reporting.



The ideal candidate will bring strong QuickBooks Online expertise and the ability to independently maintain accurate financial records, identify and resolve accounting issues, and improve accounting processes and controls. The owners should be able to rely on this person to provide complete, accurate, and clearly presented financials while remaining accountable for the day-to-day accounting function without requiring constant oversight.







Key Responsibilities:



Take full ownership of the company’s books and daily accounting activities from start to finish.

Manage and monitor accounts payable and accounts receivable.

Perform bank, credit card, payment processor, and balance-sheet reconciliations.

Prepare, review, and post journal entries and adjusting entries.

Lead the complete month-end close process within five to seven business days.

Prepare accurate monthly financial statements and management reports.

Present the owners with clear, organized, and reliable financial information.

Review existing accounting records and correct inconsistencies, duplicate entries, and classification errors.

Complete and maintain the chart of accounts and account-mapping structure.

Establish clear accounting workflows for multiple team members who process transactions.

Oversee accounting across both the apparel-decoration business and the growing blank-headwear business.

Manage inventory accounting and ensure inventory transactions are accurately recorded.

Calculate landed product costs, including product cost, freight, customs duties, tariffs, and other import-related expenses.

Support monthly container imports from Bangladesh and properly allocate costs across inventory items.

Reconcile Shopify, production, billing, payroll, sales-tax, banking, and payment platforms with QuickBooks Online.

Maintain organized supporting documentation and a clear audit trail.

Identify process gaps and implement stronger accounting procedures and internal controls.

Coordinate with administrative staff while remaining personally accountable for the accuracy and completion of all accounting work.

Provide daily or regular progress updates and respond promptly during scheduled working hours.

Be fully available during the five-to-seven-day month-end closing period.





Required Qualifications:



A Bachelor of Accountancy degree is required.

At least five years of hands-on accounting experience, preferably as a Senior Accountant, Accounting Manager, Assistant Controller, or Controller.

Advanced, hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online.

Strong knowledge of U.S. accounting practices and financial reporting.

Demonstrated experience independently managing the full month-end close process.

Strong experience with account reconciliations, journal entries, AP, AR, and general-ledger accounting.

Experience with inventory, manufacturing, apparel, wholesale, product-based, or e-commerce accounting.

Understanding of landed-cost calculations for imported inventory.

Ability to review disorganized books, identify problems, and establish accurate accounting processes.

Ability to personally perform detailed accounting work without relying on the owners for daily direction.

Excellent attention to detail, organization, accountability, and problem-solving skills.

Full-Time Outbound Calling VA – Live Transfers (Medicare) – Fresh Leads Provided – US Hours



Type: Full Time | Pay: $5/hr base + $2 per qualified live transfer, bi-weekly pay | 40 hrs/week



If you are a strong phone closer stuck dialing cold lists for flat pay, read this one to the end.



Cole Insure is a growing US independent Medicare agency, serving veterans and seniors in 30 states. We are hiring 2 elite Calling VAs, not ten, not twenty. You will be a named member of a small US team, working directly with our licensed agents, not a seat in a call center farm.



Why top setters want this seat:



You never prospect cold. Every lead you call asked us for information on
, minutes before you dial. Fresh, exclusive, never resold. Your talent goes into converting, not into surviving hang-ups from dead lists.



Your paycheck follows your skill. $5/hr base is guaranteed. Every qualified live transfer our agents confirm adds $1, uncapped. Strong callers run 8-12 confirmed transfers a day. Do the math on your own ability.



Real tools. Professional dialer, CRM, proven scripts, paid training starting September 8. You bring the voice, we bring everything else.



What you'll do: call brand-new leads within seconds, qualify with 2-3 simple questions, and transfer them live to a licensed agent while they're on the line. Book a firm appointment when a transfer isn't possible. Follow up no-answers and aged leads. Keep clean CRM notes. Plan details and coverage advice stay with licensed agents, we train you on exactly where that line is.



Schedule, be honest with yourself: US Central daytime hours 8:30am-5:00pm CST, roughly 8:30 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday, permanent night shift. Our best applicants are natural night owls who want US hours on purpose. If that's not you, don't apply.



You: excellent spoken English with a neutral accent, a confident and warm phone presence seniors trust, unbothered by rejection, reliable fiber internet with backup power, full-time with no side clients, and appointment setting or call center experience strongly preferred.



How to apply. Incomplete applications are not reviewed.



To be considered, record a video of yourself on Loom or any platform and cover all of the following in detail:



Read this script exactly once, naturally, like a real call: "Hi John? I'm just getting back to you about your request for additional money back for Veterans. You responded to our post about getting up to $2,200 back. Are you still located in Texas? Perfect. And what branch did you serve in?"



Then answer these four questions on camera:



1. Walk me through your phone sales or appointment setting background. What did you dial, and what results did you put up?

2. This is a permanent overnight shift, 9 PM to 6 AM your time. Tell me honestly how that fits your daily life, and whether you've done it before.

3. Show or describe your work setup: internet speed, workspace, and exactly what happens on your end when the power or connection goes out mid-shift.

4. When you work for someone you never see in person, how do they know what you got done without ever having to ask?



Attach your resume, and start your application with the words NIGHT OWL so we know you read everything.



This team is small on purpose, and every seat on it matters. We want callers who show up sharp, treat scheduled hours as non-negotiable, and want to be paid for performance. If what you actually need is a side gig or something to hold you over for a few months, skip this one.



Interviews start within days. Paid training begins September 8. Two or three people are getting these seats. Make the recording the reason one of them is you.

title: SIMS 4 COMMUNITY MANAGER
description:
SIMS 4 COMMUNITY MANAGER — NIMALUSIMS



Remote · Part-time · Up to $500 USD per month

Apply at 
 — do not DM, apply through the portal



THE BASICS

Hours: 20 hours per week

Pay: Up to $500 USD per month, depending on experience

Paid on: The 5th and the 20th of each month. Partial periods are prorated.

Location: Fully remote, work from wherever you are

Reports to: The founder, directly

Must have: The Sims 4 on PC — not console

Start: ASAP



THE SHORT VERSION

You already play The Sims 4 on PC, not console. You know why a .ts4script has to sit near the top of the Mods folder and what happens on patch day. You've managed communities before and you've posted across multiple platforms.



You won't be on camera. You will be in the game most days: testing mods before they go out, shooting the screenshots we release them with in GShade, looking after the people who pay for this, and getting the work in front of everyone who hasn't found it yet.



WHO WE ARE

NimaluSims is a custom content and script mod studio for The Sims 4.



We build things that don't exist anywhere else in the modding scene. Recent releases include a Holy Bible object with 110 hand-made covers in English and Simlish, a group Bible study system that gathers multiple Sims around a reader and gets them studying together, narrative choice cards that interrupt a quiet moment and ask the player what their Sim does next, plus faith traits, aspirations, lot traits and custom scenarios.



Everything ships base-game compatible. No pack dependencies unless there's no way around it, because a mod that needs four expansion packs isn't a mod most people can play.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Right now one person builds the mods, looks after 49K+ patrons, writes every post, answers every install question, takes the screenshots and handles the re-uploads. That worked at a smaller size and it doesn't any more.



Patrons are the ones paying for this to exist, and they should never be the ones waiting longest for a reply. That's the first thing we want fixed.



WHAT YOU'D OWN



1. PATREON MEMBERS — THIS IS THE PRIORITY

This comes before everything else on the list.



Patrons pay every month and they should feel looked after every month. You'd own their experience end to end: welcoming new patrons, making sure they can find and install what they paid for, answering their questions first and fastest, checking tier access is actually working, and telling us when someone is about to cancel and why.



If a patron is stuck, nothing else on this list matters that day.



2. GETTING THE WORK FOUND

Our mods need to exist where Simmers actually look for them. You'd create and maintain our listings on CurseForge, The Sims Resource and Pinterest — writing the descriptions, uploading the images, tagging properly, and keeping versions current when a mod updates.



A mod nobody can find is a mod nobody downloads.



3. POSTING EVERYWHERE ELSE

Publishing and scheduling across Patreon, Skool, Tumblr, Ko-fi, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube,
, Instagram, X and Threads.



You'd write the copy, adapt each post to the platform it's going on, and keep the schedule moving. Video production stays in-house — you're publishing and captioning it, not filming it.



4. TESTING AND SCREENSHOTS

You play every mod before it ships, in a real save, with your own mods loaded — that's where the conflicts show up. Then you shoot the promotional images in GShade and edit them for the release.



5. 

Moderating it, keeping it warm, welcoming people in, and making sure nobody's question sits unanswered overnight. We'd rather be the small community where you always get an answer than the big one where you don't.



6. DOCUMENTATION AND SUPPORT

Release notes, install guides and troubleshooting a player can follow without knowing what tuning is. Then answering the same install question for the fortieth time as patiently as the first — most people who say a mod is broken have script mods switched off, or XML Injector missing, or a .ts4script buried four folders deep.



7. BUG TRIAGE

Reproduce it, collect the lastException.txt, narrow down which mod and which interaction, and write it up properly. A good bug report from you saves the developer an hour.



8. TRANSLATIONS AND RE-UPLOADS

Coordinating community translators and keeping the string tables straight — including leaving the {0.SimFirstName} tokens intact, because a translation that strips those breaks every notification in that language.



And watching the file-dump sites. When our mods get copied around, players end up on old broken versions and we get the bug reports for a file we can no longer fix.



WHAT A WEEK ACTUALLY LOOKS LIKE

Every day — Patreon first: new patrons welcomed, patron questions answered, access problems fixed. Then 
. Then whatever came in overnight everywhere else.



Release weeks — Get the build early, play it, try to break it. Shoot and edit the screenshots. Draft the Patreon post, the 
 announcement, the install notes and the platform posts. Get the listings up on CurseForge, TSR, Tumblr and the other platforms. Publish and watch the first hour closely.



Patch weeks — EA pushes an update and something breaks. Reports arrive in different words describing the same fault. You reproduce it, collect the exception file, write it up for the developer, and post the honest holding message so nobody thinks they've been abandoned.



Ongoing — Keep the posting schedule moving. Keep listings current. Coordinate translators. Tell us what the community keeps asking for that we haven't built.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 30 — Patrons are getting same-day answers. You're handling most of 
 without asking. You've shipped screenshots for a release.



By day 60 — Our mods are listed and current on CurseForge, TSR, Pinterest and the other platforms. Posts go out on schedule across every platform without being chased. Bug reports reaching the developer are clean and reproducible.



By day 90 — You own the community rhythm. Patron questions don't reach the founder. You're telling us what to build next because you hear it before we do.



HOW WE'D WORK TOGETHER

You draft, and posts go out once they're approved. The voice and the aesthetic matter, so we'd rather get that right together early than hand it over cold. As you settle in and the voice becomes second nature, that gets looser.



You'll have direct access to the founder. Small team, no layers, fast answers.



WHAT YOU NEED

• You love this game. Not "I've played it." You have opinions about the packs, you follow creators, and your Mods folder is bigger than you'd admit out loud.

• The Sims 4 installed on your own PC, with the packs you own. This job can't be done on a borrowed machine or a console.

• GShade, installed and running. You'll use it to test mods and shoot every release image. This one isn't negotiable.

• A computer that can run all of it — a heavily modded game with a shader on top.

• Photoshop and Canva. Editing screenshots and building the graphics that go out with every release.

• You've managed a paying membership before — Patreon, Ko-fi, Skool, a subscription community, anything where people pay monthly and expect to be looked after.

• You can run a multi-platform posting schedule without being chased, and adapt one piece of news to eleven different places.

• You can explain a technical thing simply. Walking someone through enabling script mods who has never opened their Mods folder is most of this job.

• You write clearly and warmly in English. Nearly everything you produce here is writing.

• You're comfortable representing any kind of mods community and speaking in its voice.



WHAT WOULD MAKE YOU STAND OUT

Having published on CurseForge or The Sims Resource yourself. Experience running a Patreon from the creator side. A scheduling tool you're fast with. Basic Sims 4 Studio. A second language. Having handled a DMCA or re-upload takedown. Your own Sims content, however small.



THIS PROBABLY ISN'T FOR YOU IF

• You've played The Sims 4 on console but not on PC.

• You want to be the face of a brand. You won't be on camera here.

• You've never used mods and were planning to learn on the job. The community will know.

• You need everything spelled out. A lot of this is noticing what needs doing before anyone asks.

• Repetition frustrates you. You'll answer the same three questions forever, and doing it warmly every time is the job.



HOW TO APPLY

Send:

1. A community or membership you've run, and what it looked like when you started

2. Your Sims 4 setup — roughly how many mods you run, which creators you follow, and your PC specs

3. Three screenshots you've taken yourself in-game with GShade. If you've edited them, or made a graphic out of one in Photoshop or Canva, send that too — we want to see your eye.

4. A short task: pick any mod by any creator and write the release post you'd publish for it. 150 words. We want to see how you explain a technical thing to a player who just wants it to work.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

We read every application, and the task carries more weight than the CV. If it's a fit, there's one call — a conversation about the game and the community, not a quiz — and we'll ask for a short Loom video walking through your Mods folder, your graphics work and what you know about The Sims 4. We'll tell you either way.



Apply via 
 — do not DM, apply through the portal.

title: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper | Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines
description:
Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper

Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines





Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

Engagement Type: Long-term Independent Contractor

Service Days: Monday to Friday

Reports To: Australian Client Manager

Client Contact: No direct client communication required



About the Role



We are an Australian accounting practice seeking an experienced Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support a portfolio of Australian clients.

This is a hands-on, non-client-facing role. You will work directly with an Australian Client Manager, who will manage all external client communication and provide instructions, priorities and review feedback.



You will be responsible for delivering accurate bookkeeping, payroll, BAS/IAS preparation, reconciliations, month-end work and accounting support across multiple Australian entities.

This opportunity is suitable only for candidates with substantial recent experience working within, or directly supporting, an Australian accounting firm, bookkeeping practice or public practice environment.



Key ResponsibilitiesBookkeeping and Reconciliations

· Manage end-to-end bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Complete bank, credit card, loan and merchant facility reconciliations.

· Reconcile payment platforms such as Stripe, Square, PayPal, Shopify and Wise.

· Process accounts payable and accounts receivable.

· Process supplier bills, sales invoices, credit notes, refunds and payments.

· Review aged receivables and aged payables.

· Process journals, accruals, prepayments and accounting adjustments.

· Reconcile director, shareholder, beneficiary and intercompany loan accounts.

· Maintain fixed asset registers and assist with depreciation schedules.

· Investigate unreconciled, duplicated, missing or incorrectly recorded transactions.



Account Code and GST Code Review



This is a senior-level role. You must be able to review the quality and technical accuracy of bookkeeping work.



You will be required to:



· Review and correct account codes.

· Review and correct GST tax codes.

· Identify incorrect use of GST on Income, GST on Expenses, GST-Free, Input Taxed and BAS Excluded codes.

· Review the GST treatment of overseas transactions, exports, reimbursements, disbursements, insurance payments and government grants.

· Identify personal, capital, private and non-deductible transactions.

· Review general ledger accounts for unusual balances and incorrect classifications.

· Review suspense, clearing and uncategorised transaction accounts.

· Self-review all work before submitting it to the Client Manager.

· Review work prepared by junior bookkeepers where required.



Australian Payroll



· Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payroll.

· Set up and maintain employee payroll records.

· Process ordinary hours, overtime, allowances, bonuses, deductions and reimbursements.

· Process annual leave, personal leave and termination payments.

· Prepare Single Touch Payroll reporting and year-end STP finalisation.

· Calculate and reconcile PAYG withholding.

· Calculate and reconcile employer superannuation.

· Review superannuation clearing house payments and identify rejected or unpaid amounts.

· Reconcile payroll reports, payroll journals and payroll liability accounts.

· Assist with payroll tax, workers compensation and other payroll compliance requirements.



BAS, IAS and Compliance Support



· Prepare BAS and IAS workpapers for internal review.

· Reconcile GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalment accounts.

· Review GST reporting under both cash and accrual methods.

· Reconcile BAS figures to the general ledger.

· Identify prior-period errors and transactions requiring GST adjustments.

· Assist with PAYG instalment variation calculations.

· Assist with Taxable Payments Annual Reports.

· Prepare supporting documents and schedules for the firm’s accountants and tax agents.

· Monitor internal deadlines and escalate missing information promptly.



Month-End and Year-End



· Complete monthly, quarterly and annual bookkeeping files.

· Reconcile all material balance sheet accounts.

· Review payroll, GST, superannuation and PAYG liabilities.

· Prepare accruals, prepayments and other adjusting journals.

· Review accounts payable and accounts receivable cut-off.

· Reconcile fixed assets, inventory and cost of goods sold where applicable.

· Prepare year-end workpapers and supporting schedules.

· Ensure client files are ready for financial statement and income tax return preparation.



Financial Reporting



· Prepare Profit and Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

· Prepare cash flow and management reports where required.

· Compare results with prior periods, budgets or forecasts.

· Identify unusual movements, negative balances and potential accounting errors.

· Provide clear internal explanations and supporting schedules to the Client Manager.



Tax Return Experience – Highly Regarded, but not essential



Experience preparing Australian income tax returns or tax workpapers is not essential but will be a strong advantage.



Relevant experience may include:

· Individual and sole trader tax returns.

· Company tax returns.

· Trust tax returns and distribution workpapers.

· Partnership tax returns.

· Rental property schedules.

· Depreciation and capital allowance schedules.

· Tax reconciliation workpapers.

· Xero Tax, MYOB Practice, HandiTax or BGL.



Essential Experience and Skills



Applicants must have:

· At least five years of recent Australian public practice bookkeeping experience.

· Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Advanced practical experience using Xero.

· Strong practical experience using MYOB.

· Strong practical experience using QuickBooks Online.

· Experience preparing BAS and IAS workpapers.

· Strong knowledge of Australian GST and account coding.

· Demonstrated experience reviewing and correcting GST codes.

· Strong Australian payroll, STP and superannuation experience.

· Advanced reconciliation and problem-solving skills.

· Experience preparing month-end and year-end workpapers.

· Excellent written and spoken English.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

· The ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.

· High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional conduct.

· Ability to use AI tools



Experience limited to internal bookkeeping for one Australian business may not satisfy the public practice experience requirement.



Qualifications



The following qualifications are highly regarded:

· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce.

· Diploma or recognised qualification in Accounting or Bookkeeping.

· CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent studies.

· Xero Advisor Certification.

· MYOB or QuickBooks certification.



Software



You must be confident using:



· Xero

· MYOB

· QuickBooks Online



Independent Contractor Arrangement



This is an independent contractor opportunity and not an employee position.



The contractor will:



· Provide services remotely from the Philippines.

· Provide their own computer, secure workspace, internet and backup power arrangements.

· Be responsible for their own business registration, taxation, invoicing and insurance obligations.

· Issue a valid monthly contractor invoice.



The contractor will ordinarily provide services Monday to Friday and maintain regular overlap with Australian business hours.



The parties will agree on a daily core collaboration window for meetings, questions and internal communication. Outside that window, the contractor may arrange their own working schedule, provided all deadlines and service requirements are met.



Timesheets and Work Records



The contractor must complete a daily timesheet recording:



· Date.

· Client or entity.

· Task performed.

· Time spent.

· Work completed.

· Outstanding issues and next steps.



Timesheets are used for client costing, workflow management, capacity planning and supporting the contractor’s invoice. They are not intended to operate as employee attendance records.

Remote Work Requirements



Applicants must have:



· A reliable computer or laptop.

· Stable high-speed internet.

· Backup internet.

· A quiet and secure home office.

· A suitable headset for online meetings.

· The ability to use multi-factor authentication and secure password systems.

· A strong commitment to privacy, confidentiality and data security.



How to Apply



Please submit:

· Your current resume.

· A brief cover letter of your Australian public practice experience.

· Details of your Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks Online experience.

· Details of your BAS, IAS and Australian payroll experience.

· Details of any Australian tax returns you have prepared.

· Your expected monthly contractor fee in Philippine pesos.

· Your earliest available commencement date.

· Confirmation of your internet.

· Confirmation that you can issue invoices as an independent contractor.



Pay: Php70,000.00 - Php80,000.00 per month

· Reconcile payroll reports, payroll journals and payroll liability accounts.

· Prepare BAS and IAS workpapers for internal review.

title: Property Manager -Short Rentals
description:
Virtual Assistant  Short-Term Rental Operations



We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to manage day-to-day operations for our short-term rental business. This role requires someone who can work independently  you'll own your shift, make sound judgment calls, and keep things moving without being managed hour to hour. The right person is organized, responsive, professional with guests, and comfortable juggling multiple tasks across booking platforms and internal systems.



You'll be central to guest communication, cleaner and maintenance coordination, booking-related tasks, and delivering a great guest experience.



Key Responsibilities



-Monitor and respond to guest messages across Airbnb, direct bookings, SMS, and other platforms

-Maintain a friendly, professional, and helpful tone with guests

-Reply to guest inquiries

-Coordinate daily cleaning schedules with cleaners through Slack

-Communicate early check-ins, late check-outs, same-day turns, and special requests

-Manage early check-in and late check-out requests based on availability

-Request related fees through the Airbnb Resolution Center

-Verify security deposits and signed rental agreements before check-in instructions are sent

-Check reservations and transactions in OwnerRez

-Follow up with guests when deposit holds are missing

-Handle maintenance issues by communicating with guests and scheduling service as needed

-Create and send guest quotes in OwnerRez

-Answer incoming calls through Quo and document call details properly

-Enforce company policies, including no off-platform bookings and discount approval procedures

-Leave guest reviews when appropriate and send post-stay follow-up messages

-Turn off automated guest messages when a guest is having a negative experience

-Monitor team communication through WhatsApp during shift hours

-Send an end-of-day report covering daily activity, concerns, maintenance, pending follow-ups, and operational updates



Requirements



-Ability to work independently with minimal supervision — self-directed, accountable, and able to prioritize without daily hand-holding

-Professional references required and must be provided before work begins. Candidates who cannot supply verifiable references will not be considered.

-Previous experience in short-term rental, Airbnb, hospitality, property management, or customer service preferred

-Excellent written English and strong communication skills

-Highly responsive and able to manage time-sensitive guest communication

-Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow SOPs exactly

-Comfortable using or learning Airbnb, OwnerRez, Slack, WhatsApp, Quo, and Schlage

-Able to manage multiple conversations and tasks at once

-Professional judgment and a willingness to ask questions before confirming uncertain information



Ideal Candidate



-Organized and dependable

-Calm under pressure

-Friendly and professional with guests

-Proactive with follow-up and communication

-Works independently while staying aligned with the team



Work Expectations



-Available to check messages consistently during shift hours, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST

-Responds quickly to urgent guest matters

-Stays active in Slack and WhatsApp for team updates

-Follows company policies regarding deposits, discounts, reviews, and guest communication

-References must be submitted and cleared prior to the first shift

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper (QuickBooks Online) – US Agency, ~5–8 hrs/week
description:
About us

Lucra Commerce is a boutique Amazon and Walmart marketplace agency based in New York. We manage advertising and channel growth for brands, and we bill clients bimonthly. We're small, organized, and looking for someone reliable to own our books so the founder doesn't have to.



What you'll do



Categorize all bank and credit card transactions in QuickBooks Online on a weekly basis

Reconcile accounts monthly and flag anything that looks off

Prepare and send client invoices each month from our billing schedule

Track outstanding invoices, send payment reminders, and follow up until paid

Keep our chart of accounts clean and consistent

Send a short weekly update: what was categorized, what's unpaid, what needs my input



What we're looking for



2+ years of hands-on QuickBooks Online experience (required – please don't apply without it)

Experience with accounts receivable / invoicing and chasing payments

Comfortable working with a US-based service business; agency or e-commerce experience is a plus

Detail-oriented and consistent – you'll notice a duplicate charge before we do

Clear written English; you'll occasionally
 clients about invoices

Able to work independently with minimal supervision



Hours and pay



Part-time, roughly 5–8 hours per week to start, with room to grow

Flexible schedule, but transactions should be categorized by Monday each week and invoices sent on time

Rate: ~$5/hour depending on experience, paid biweekly via Wise

Long-term role for the right person



How to apply

Start your application with the word "LEDGER" so I know you read this. Then tell me:



How many years you've used QuickBooks Online and for what kinds of businesses

Describe your process for following up on an invoice that's 30 days overdue

Your hourly rate and weekly availability (US Eastern time)



Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short paid categorization test in a sample QuickBooks file.

Flexible Hours – work whenever you want throughout the day!

iPhone Users Only – please apply only if you use an iPhone.

Creativity is key! We are searching for people who are highly creative and can think outside the box.



Core Competencies

Must be consistent

Adapts quickly

Strong communication skills

AI, Nano Banana Pro

CapCut

Canva

TikTok



Pinterest, Reddit, Google (image sourcing)

Google Docs/Sheets

ChatGPT



Bonus Skills (Not required, but priority given to applicants with these):

Knowledge in holistic/wellness topics, especially niche or lesser-known remedies

Expertise in beauty/fashion (e.g., skincare tips like using vitamin C serum for hyperpigmentation)

Post a set number of TikTok slideshows per account based on daily tasks

English copywriting: hooks, scripts, creative writing, storytelling, sparking emotion, and effective CTAs

Create, replicate, and format TikTok slideshows using content inspiration

Source, find, recreate/create and/or upscale images using AI and Pinterest

Perform split-testing by replicating content on multiple accounts

Conduct simple research on topics like "wellness tips" or "health tips"

Simplify complex information so that it’s easy to understand

Use a VPN to post content on U.S. servers

Have a separate work phone to target U.S servers

Monitor viral accounts/content on burner accounts and share with the team



Compensation Overview:

Base Pay: $
per month

Huge growth potential within the team:

If you become a top performer you may be promoted to a coach.

title: LAND BUILDER ACQUISITION AND QUALIFICATION VA
description:
LAND BUILDER ACQUISITION AND QUALIFICATION VA



We are looking for an experienced Real Estate VA who has previous experience communicating with home builders, land developers, or real estate acquisition professionals.



This is NOT a beginner position.



I am specifically looking for someone who already understands how to identify, contact, qualify, and build relationships with builders and developers who are actively acquiring vacant land.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your primary responsibility will be to identify builders and developers in our target markets, contact them, speak with the person responsible for land acquisition, and determine exactly what type of vacant land they are currently looking to purchase.



You will:



* Research active builders and land developers in specific markets

* Identify the decision maker responsible for land acquisition

* Call builders and developers directly

* Speak professionally with acquisition managers, owners, land managers, and developers

* Qualify builders based on their current land-buying activity

* Find out exactly what types of land they are looking for

* Obtain their specific land acquisition criteria and buy box

* Determine their preferred locations and counties

* Determine acreage requirements

* Determine desired number of lots

* Determine zoning requirements

* Determine utility requirements

* Determine price ranges and land budgets

* Determine whether they purchase raw land, entitled land, finished lots, or development sites

* Determine their preferred property characteristics

* Determine what makes them immediately reject a property

* Determine how frequently they are currently acquiring land

* Determine their acquisition timeline

* Identify their preferred method of receiving opportunities

* Maintain accurate records of every conversation

* Enter qualified buyers and their criteria into our CRM

* Follow up with qualified builders to keep their buying criteria current

* Build long-term relationships with active land buyers



The goal is NOT simply to build a list of builders.



The goal is to build a database of QUALIFIED, ACTIVE builders with specific and actionable buying criteria.



For example, we don’t want:



“ABC Homes buys land in Texas.”



We want:



“ABC Homes is actively looking for 5-15 acre residential development sites in X County, needs public water and sewer, prefers 20+ potential lots, budget is up to $1.5M, and is looking to acquire another site within the next 90 days.”



That is the level of information we are looking for.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You MUST have previous experience with one or more of the following:



* Calling home builders

* Calling land developers

* Builder acquisition

* Land acquisition

* Real estate acquisitions

* Real estate wholesaling

* Land wholesaling

* Land development

* Builder/developer prospecting

* Qualifying real estate buyers

* Speaking with acquisition managers or decision makers



You must be comfortable getting on the phone and having professional conversations with builders and developers.



I am NOT looking for someone with no experience who needs to be taught how to do this from scratch.



If you have never spoken with builders or developers before, this position is probably not a good fit.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate:



* Has proven real estate experience

* Has experience speaking with builders or developers

* Is comfortable making outbound calls

* Can speak confidently with business owners and acquisition managers

* Knows how to ask good qualifying questions

* Can dig deeper instead of accepting vague answers

* Understands the difference between a general buyer lead and a qualified buyer

* Is highly organized

* Has excellent English communication skills

* Can accurately document conversations

* Understands real estate terminology

* Can work independently

* Is comfortable using a CRM

* Is results-oriented



IMPORTANT



This position requires someone who can have an intelligent conversation with a builder and uncover their actual acquisition needs.



You should be able to ask follow-up questions such as:



“What are you actively looking to acquire right now?”



“What counties are you currently buying in?”



“What acreage are you looking for?”



“How many lots would you ideally like to get from a site?”



“What zoning do you require?”



“Are you buying raw land or only entitled/finished lots?”



“What utilities do you require?”



“What is your typical land budget?”



“What are the biggest reasons you would reject a property?”



“When are you looking to acquire your next property?”



“How many properties are you currently looking for?”



“Who is the decision maker for purchasing land?”



This is about understanding the builder’s BUSINESS and BUYING CRITERIA, not simply collecting contact information.



TO APPLY



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many years of real estate experience do you have?

2. What experience do you have working with home builders or land developers?

3. Have you personally called builders or developers to discuss their land acquisition needs? Explain exactly what you did.

4. What type of builders or developers have you spoken with?

5. What questions would you ask a builder to determine their land-buying criteria?

6. Give me an example of a builder buy box you have previously qualified.

7. Have you worked in vacant land, residential real estate, or both?

8. What CRM systems have you used?

9. How many outbound calls were you typically making per day in your previous position?

10. Please explain why you are no longer working with your previous client/employer.

11. How long have you been working in real estate?

12. How long have you been doing builder/developer outreach?



Please include the word BUILDER at the beginning of your application so I know you read the entire posting.



IMPORTANT: I am specifically looking for someone with REAL, VERIFIABLE EXPERIENCE. Please do not apply if you have never performed this type of work before.

title: Client Support / Accountability Coordinator — Online Fitness Coaching Business (VA)

Here's the fully combined, ready-to-post version:



---



**Job Title: Accountability Coordinator — Online Fitness Coaching Business (AU Client, Long-Term Role)**



**Pay: $1,300–$1,730 USD/month, based on experience**



**About the Role**



Pro Train Fitness runs the Men's Shred Program and Women's Shred Program — online coaching programs helping busy professional men and women (mostly ages 35–60) transform their health and fitness. We're growing, and we need a reliable, detail-driven Accountability Coordinator to keep our clients on track, engaged, and supported every single day.



This isn't a fitness-coaching role — you won't be designing programs or giving training advice. This is an **operations and client-support role**: keeping our systems accurate, our clients accountable, and our community engaged, so our coach can focus on actually coaching.



**What You'll Be Doing**



- Checking daily that clients are logging their food, weight, and workouts — and personally following up when they're not

- Keeping our WhatsApp community groups active and positive (weekdays only)

- Making sure clients show up to their coaching calls, and calling anyone who's missed their booking

- Helping new clients get set up smoothly in their first week

- Basic tech support (helping clients connect their fitness apps)

- Keeping accurate records in our systems

- A short weekly check-in with the business owner to flag anything that needs attention



**Hours**



Monday–Friday, 8:00am–6:30pm Sydney time, plus a short 2-hour window on Sunday afternoon (Sydney time) for outstanding call bookings. (We'll walk you through what this looks like in your own local time.)



**What We're Looking For**



- Excellent written English and a warm, professional communication style

- Someone who genuinely enjoys helping people and takes pride in follow-through

- Fast learner — comfortable picking up new apps and systems quickly

- Reliable internet with a backup connection (mobile data/pocket WiFi) — this is a requirement, not optional

- Detail-oriented and dependable — this role is trusted with real client health data

- A positive, can-do attitude — someone who brings energy to the team, not just gets the job done



No fitness industry experience required — we'll train you on everything specific to our systems. What matters most is your reliability, attitude, and communication.



**Bonus Skills (Not Required, But a Big Plus)**



- Experience using **Trainerize** (fitness coaching app)

- Experience with **InShot** or **CapCut** for basic video editing



**What We Offer**



- $1,300–$1,730 USD/month, based on experience

- Long-term, stable role with a growing business (not a short-term gig)

- 4-week paid trial period, followed by ongoing work once you're confirmed as a good fit

- Clear systems and a detailed SOP — you won't be left guessing what to do

- Real support from the business owner, not just left to figure it out alone



**To Apply**



Please include the word **"ELEPHANT"** somewhere in your application so we know you read the full ad. Then answer the following questions:



1. What word did we ask you to include in your application?

2. This role requires you to work 8:00am–6:30pm Sydney time on weekdays, plus 4:00pm–6:00pm Sydney time on Sundays. What would those hours be in your own local time, and are you able to commit to this schedule long-term?

3. A client hasn't logged their bodyweight or food for 3 days. What would you do?

4. Do you have a backup internet connection (e.g. mobile data or pocket WiFi) in addition to your main internet, or would you need to set one up?

5. Have you used Trainerize before? If yes, briefly describe how. Have you used InShot or CapCut? If yes, what kind of videos have you edited?

6. Tell us about a time you had to follow a detailed set of instructions or a process exactly, even when it felt repetitive. How did you stay consistent?

7. What's your current employment status — are you working full-time elsewhere, part-time, or fully available?

8. Are you a fast learner? Give an example of a time you were asked to learn a new tech-based skill — how quickly did you learn it, and were you able to use it effectively?
