title: Operations Coordinator (Client Support + Admin + Systems) - UK Hours, Part-Time to Full-Time
description:
KSTN Digital is a UK marketing-technology consultancy. We build patient acquisition systems for dental clinics - websites, CRMs, chatbots, automations, content and ads - plus selected e-commerce work. Small team (founder plus three), fast-moving and systems-heavy.



THE ROLE



We need a generalist who can run things. Someone who learns how a business actually works, takes the loose ends off the founder's plate, and keeps every loop closed without being chased.



Four things matter most.



1. Client coordination. Our clients are UK dental clinics and an e-commerce brand. You run their content approvals end to end (send the work, chase the decision, log the feedback, brief our designer), get client staff set up and actually using our systems, sort their access and logins, and follow up until things are done. You speak to clients directly, in writing and on the phone, with the founder in the loop.



2. Admin that keeps money moving. Invoice schedule and drafting, payment chasing, supplier and adviser follow-ups, account admin, password manager.



3. Keeping the record true. We run on Notion, Airtable, Slack and Google Workspace. You keep the picture accurate every day - what is done, what is waiting on whom, what happens next - so the founder does not have to hold it in his head.



4. Improving the machine. Processes get documented, gaps get closed, and things that keep going wrong get fixed at the root rather than chased every week.



You do not need to have used our exact tools. You do need to have built or run something for a team before, in any tool, and to be quick at picking up new ones. You will have a Claude seat and we expect you to use AI to move faster.



As the role grows: CRM checks in Airtable, client reporting, outbound work (lead lists,
 sequences, reply triage, demo booking), warm patient calls, and support across the founder's other ventures. Authority grows with trust, and we write the progression down.



HOURS



Part-time to start: 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, in a fixed window inside UK business hours - normally 12pm to 4pm UK (7pm to 11pm Manila). Full-time is 9am to 5pm UK. The UK-hours requirement is not negotiable; you will be talking to UK clients.



PAY AND PROGRESSION



$500 per month part-time, rising to $1,500 per month on moving to full-time. We review at 4 weeks, and the move to full-time can happen as early as month one or two. 13th month pay, pro-rated while part-time. Performance bonus tied to agreed outcomes. Training budget for certification in the tools we use. We hire on capability and trajectory, not years - early-career candidates are welcome if you can show us the work.



MUST HAVE



Excellent written English. Evidence of a system or process you built or ran for a team - any tool, screenshots or a portfolio link. Comfortable on the phone with a clear, friendly manner. Reliable internet with a backup connection and backup power. ID Proof 80+, Timeproof, camera on for interviews. Able to commit to the fixed UK window now, and to full-time later.



NICE TO HAVE



Notion, Airtable, Xero, Slack, Google Workspace admin, Shopify, Klaviyo. Dental, healthcare or agency experience.



HOW TO APPLY (applications that skip this are not read)



1. Start your message with the word LATTICE, then link or describe a system you built or ran for a team - what was in it, and what problem it solved.

2. Write the exact message you would send to a clinic manager who has twice ignored our request for their Instagram login, and our designer cannot post without it. Just the message - no explanation.

3. A client
s to say a discount code is not working on their online store. You have access to the store. What are the first three things you check, and what do you send back to them?

4. Tell us about a process or system you fixed that people still use today - what was broken, and what did you change?

5. A client says on WhatsApp that a video needs fixes, but our task tracker shows it approved. What do you do, in order? Three to five sentences.



Shortlisted candidates do a 15-minute video call, then a paid 2 to 3 day trial on realistic tasks.

title: Bookkeeper / QuickBooks Data Entry Specialist (Multi-Entity, US Company)
description:
JOB TYPE: Full Time SALARY: $ - $ USD per month HOURS: [40 hrs/week] - must include 3-4 hours of daily overlap with US Pacific Time business hours



===========================================



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a multi-location retail company in California, USA. We operate a group of retail stores plus supporting production and distribution operations, organized under a number of separate legal entities. Our back office is small and we need a dependable, detail-obsessed bookkeeper to keep our books accurate and current.



This is a long-term position. We are not hiring for a short project. We want someone who will still be with us in three years and who knows our chart of accounts better than we do.



IMPORTANT: This is high-volume, repetitive transaction entry work. You will spend most of your day inside QuickBooks. This is not a strategy, analysis, or advisory role. If you are looking for variety and creative problem solving, this is not the job. If you find genuine satisfaction in a clean reconciliation and a zero-variance month, keep reading.



===========================================



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Enter daily transactions into QuickBooks across multiple company files - sales, deposits, vendor bills, expenses, payroll journal entries, and transfers

Code every transaction to the correct entity, class, location, and GL account

Reconcile daily retail sales from our point-of-sale reports to bank deposits and QuickBooks

Perform monthly bank, credit card, and merchant account reconciliations

Enter and code accounts payable; maintain vendor records and backup documentation

Record intercompany transactions and transfers between entities

Maintain organized digital filing of receipts and invoices

Flag discrepancies and missing documents to your supervisor instead of guessing

Support month-end close checklists and year-end document packages for our CPA

===========================================



WHAT WE REQUIRE



Minimum 3 years of hands-on bookkeeping experience with US-based clients or employers

Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online (QuickBooks Desktop experience is a plus)

Experience working in more than one company file at a time without mixing them up

Solid Excel or Google Sheets skills - sorting, filtering, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, pivot tables

Excellent written English

Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a quiet place to work

Able to commit to 3-4 hours of daily overlap with US Pacific Time business hours

Ability to follow an established chart of accounts and coding conventions exactly as documented

Available for a paid test assignment before we make an offer



STRONG PLUS



QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification (please include proof)

Experience with multi-entity or multi-location accounting

Experience in cash-intensive retail, restaurant groups, or multi-unit operations

Familiarity with US sales tax and excise tax reporting

Experience segregating cost of goods sold from operating expenses for tax purposes

===========================================



INDUSTRY DISCLOSURE



We are a licensed and state-regulated cannabis retailer in California, where this is fully legal and taxed. All of your work is standard bookkeeping - you will never handle, ship, or come into contact with any product. You will only work with numbers, invoices, and bank records.



We are telling you this upfront because we do not want to waste your time or ours. If you are not comfortable working in this industry, please do not apply and there are no hard feelings.



===========================================



HOW TO APPLY - PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed. This is our first test of whether you follow directions.



Begin your application with the word: RECONCILED

Answer these five questions directly in your application. Short, specific answers are better than long ones. Do not use AI to write your answers - we can tell, and we will discard the application. a) How many separate QuickBooks company files have you worked in at the same time, and what was your system for not mixing them up? b) What is the Undeposited Funds account, and describe a situation where you used it. c) Your bank feed shows a transaction that you already entered manually last week. What do you do, and why? d) A monthly bank reconciliation is off by $482.15. Walk us through your process for finding it. e) Describe how you have used Classes and Locations in QuickBooks Online.

Tell us your years of QuickBooks experience and the industries of the clients you supported.

Attach your resume.

Record a 60-90 second video of yourself (unscripted, phone camera is fine) explaining your bookkeeping routine on a typical day. Share the link.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a SHORT PAID TEST ASSIGNMENT using sample data before we make an offer. We pay for your time on this.



===========================================



WHAT WE OFFER



Long-term, stable employment with a growing company

Paid time off and paid holidays

Direct access to company leadership - no layers of management

Clear expectations and a defined scope, so you always know what "done" looks like

Annual performance reviews with raises based on accuracy and reliability

title: CNC Cabinet Designer — Residential Cabinetry
description:
CNC Cabinet Designer — Residential Cabinetry



READ FIRST — NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENT



We are looking for an experienced residential cabinet designer who can take projects from design concept through fabrication-ready CNC files. You must understand cabinet construction, design for efficient CNC production, and already have access to the professional cabinet-design/CNC software you use. The specific platform does not matter, but you must be able to produce reliable production-ready output with it.



This is not an order-entry, drafting-only, rendering-only, or CNC-programming-only role. We need a true designer who understands how cabinets are built and can develop attractive, functional solutions while also designing for efficient fabrication.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are building a new CNC-based cabinetry capability within a growing US residential remodeling organization. Typical work will include kitchens, bathroom vanities, closets, pantries, laundry rooms, bars, built-ins, and similar residential cabinetry.



We previously fabricated cabinets using traditional shop methods and found the process too labor-intensive and expensive to scale. Our new approach is centered on designing specifically for CNC fabrication, with careful attention to material utilization, machining, assembly, hardware, installation, and overall production efficiency.



We already have an established CNC fabrication partner. You will work directly with the shop to make sure designs translate cleanly into production, resolve fabrication questions, make revisions when necessary, and help us develop a smooth and repeatable design-to-production workflow.



Strong interior-design capability is highly preferred. You should be able to develop cabinetry from client goals, site conditions, appliance and fixture requirements, storage needs, and the broader design of the room rather than simply converting measurements into cabinet boxes.



The role will begin as regular project-based work for the first few months while we refine the process and develop the marketing and sales side of this new capability. We expect the work to grow into a full-time role for the right person. Someone who helps us successfully build the cabinetry division and takes meaningful ownership of the process will receive increased compensation when transitioning to full-time work, with potential bonuses and profit sharing for exceptional performance.



COMPENSATION



Initial project-based compensation is expected to be approximately $10–$14 USD/hour depending on experience and demonstrated capability. We are willing to consider more for an exceptional candidate.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer the following three questions:



1. How many years have you professionally designed residential cabinetry specifically for CNC fabrication?

2. What cabinet-design/CNC software do you use, and do you currently have access to it?

3. Describe your experience taking a cabinet project from initial design through CNC-ready files and coordination with the fabrication shop.



Please also provide examples of at least two residential cabinetry projects showing both design ability and production capability. We want to see design drawings, elevations, renderings, or finished work together with shop drawings, cut lists/BOM, nesting, CNC output, or other fabrication-ready documentation.



We are looking for a top-tier designer who wants to help build a cabinetry division, not simply complete isolated drafting assignments.

title: Corporate Compliance & Company Administration Officer
description:
We are hiring a detail-oriented professional to manage company formation and renewals, bank compliance packs, supplier agreement and invoice checks, and day-to-day corporate administration. You will work closely with internal finance, operations, and leadership teams and keep deadlines tight.



ROLE OVERVIEW



You will own the lifecycle of our companies (new formations and annual renewals), respond to bank and KYC/compliance requests on time, check that supplier invoices match signed agreements, and handle structured administrative work. Accuracy, confidentiality, and follow-through matter more than flashy titles.

Company formation and renewals

- Maintain a compliance calendar for filings, local permits, registered office, and other statutory deadlines (and equivalent requirements if we operate in other jurisdictions).

- Prepare and track board/shareholder resolutions, secretary’s certificates, appointment/resignation documents, and statutory registers.

- Draft clear replies and submit complete packs before the deadline.

- Follow up until confirmation of receipt / account status is closed.

Supplier agreements and invoice audit

- Review supplier and vendor agreements and keep a simple register of key terms (rates, scope, payment terms, validity, notice periods).

- Audit incoming invoices against the signed agreement and approved POs.

- Query mismatches (wrong rates, extra line items, expired contracts, missing attachments) and escalate before payment.

- Other related duties as assigned.

- Experience in company secretarial / corporate compliance / legal operations / finance admin / BPO corporate services — ideally involving company registration, renewals, bank KYC packs, or contract-to-invoice checking.

- Confident using Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 (Docs/Word, Sheets/Excel, Drive/SharePoint,

Headlines, copy, typography, layout, spacing, and other text elements should be carefully created and placed in Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or a similar design tool. 



We’re looking for thoughtful performance creative, not fully AI-generated ads with baked-in text.



JOIN MYSWATCHES



We’re looking for a Performance Image Ad Designer who knows how to turn creative concepts into static ads that stop the scroll and drive sales.



This is a full-time, long-term remote role working with our creative team on paid social content, primarily for Meta.



You’ll be given concepts, copy, product assets, research, and examples of ads that are already working. 



From there, we want someone who can make strong creative decisions independently and turn those ideas into polished, high-converting image ads.



WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON



Your main focus will be creating and iterating on static performance creative for MySwatches.



You’ll be responsible for:



- Designing high-converting static image ads for Meta

- Turning creative briefs, concepts, and copy into finished ads independently

- Creating new concepts and thoughtful iterations of ads that are already performing

- Selecting or creating the right imagery for each concept, including using AI when it makes sense

- Designing strong typography, layouts, and visual hierarchy in Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or similar tools

- Testing different hooks, visuals, and creative approaches

- Taking feedback and turning around revisions quickly

- Staying familiar with winning DTC ads and current creative trends



We don’t want someone who simply generates an entire ad with AI and sends us the output.



AI can be a great tool for creating the image or visual behind an ad. But the actual ad still needs to be thoughtfully designed.



The headline should be placed intentionally. The typography should look good. The spacing should make sense. The visual hierarchy should be clear. Every element should feel like it was put there for a reason.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You’re a performance-driven designer with static paid social creative at the core of your work, ideally with experience in DTC, beauty, fashion, or lifestyle.



You understand that a great performance ad isn’t necessarily the prettiest ad. It needs to stop the scroll, communicate quickly, create curiosity, and ultimately drive action.



You should be able to take a creative brief and a folder of assets and turn them into finished ads without needing someone to tell you exactly where every image, headline, or element should go.



Ideally, you have:



* 2+ years of graphic design or performance creative experience

* Experience creating static ads for paid social or DTC brands

* A portfolio that demonstrates strong performance-focused image ads

* Strong instincts for visual hierarchy, composition, typography, and imagery

* Experience with direct-response advertising

* Proficiency in Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or similar design tools

* Experience creating ads from UGC, product photography, stock imagery, and AI-generated imagery

* Ability to create multiple strong variations of a concept quickly

* Strong written English

* The ability to work quickly and handle feedback well



Experience using AI image tools such as Higgsfield, Nano Banana, Midjourney, or similar tools is a major plus.



ABOUT MYSWATCHES



MySwatches is a personal color analysis brand helping women discover the colors that flatter them most.



Our professional color analysts determine each customer’s personal color palette, and we send them physical cards featuring their colors.



Our hero product, the Swatch Card, makes it simple to know which colors to wear and which colors to look for while shopping.



We’re growing quickly and building out our creative team to produce more performance creative in-house.



ROLE DETAILS



This is a full-time, ongoing remote contract position.



Compensation will be based on experience and skill level.



Applications without a portfolio link will be skipped.



Portfolios filled with fully AI-generated ads with baked-in AI text will also be skipped.

title: Merchant Support Officer (Technical)
description:
We are hiring a technical Merchant Support Officer to help merchants integrate our payment APIs and to resolve live transaction issues. You will be the first technical point of contact over live chat and
, and you will work closely with engineering, product, and operations.



Working hours:

Monday - Friday 1:00 PM – 11:00 PM Manila





What you will do



API integrations

- Oversee merchant API integrations from sandbox to live

- Guide merchants on credentials, endpoints, authentication, webhooks/callbacks, and test cases

- Review integration setups and flag missing fields, wrong environments, or weak error handling before go-live

- Support certification / UAT and confirm a clean first live transaction

- Track integration status and follow up on blocked merchants



Transaction support

- Troubleshoot failed, pending, declined, duplicated, or delayed transactions via live chat and
 tickets

- Investigate using transaction IDs, logs, response codes, merchant payloads, and gateway status

- Explain the issue and the fix in plain English, with exact next steps

- Reproduce issues in sandbox when needed and confirm whether the cause is merchant-side, API, or bank/gateway

- Escalate bugs, outages, and bank-side failures to engineering or operations with full evidence



Other core tasks

- Own tickets end to end: acknowledge, diagnose, update, resolve or escalate, then close with a clear summary

- Monitor recurring errors after go-live and push merchants or internal teams to fix the root cause

- Assist with settlement, reconciliation, refund, void, and chargeback queries when they are tied to a technical issue

- Maintain API FAQs, canned replies, and troubleshooting playbooks

- Flag gaps in documentation, error messages, or the merchant dashboard

- Liaise with product, engineering, risk, and finance so merchants are not bounced between teams

- Handle ad-hoc technical admin: test accounts, credential resets, webhook retries, and go-live checklists





What we’re looking for



Must-have

- Experience in technical support, merchant support, payments, or API onboarding

- Ability to read API docs, JSON, HTTP status codes, and webhook events

- Strong written English for chat and tickets

- Calm, structured troubleshooting under time pressure

- Comfortable with ticketing tools and live chat



Nice to have

- Payments experience (cards, e-wallets, QR, payouts)

- Tools such as Postman, log viewers, or payment gateway dashboards

- Basic understanding of settlement, MID setup, 3-D Secure, or chargebacks

- Experience supporting merchants in production, not only Level 1 FAQ support



How to apply



Send your CV and a short note covering:

1. Relevant technical / payments support experience  

2. Whether you have handled API integrations or transaction troubleshooting  

3. Expected monthly salary (PHP)  

4. Earliest start date

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
Knightwing Media is hiring a Social Media Coordinator to help manage our growing roster of client social accounts.



We create photo, video, and social content for a wide variety of brands, and we’re looking for someone who genuinely understands social media. Not just someone who can schedule a post, but someone who knows what good content looks like, catches when something feels off, and can help make sure every brand we manage feels intentional and consistent.



What You’ll Be Doing



You’ll help manage the day-to-day organization and quality control of our clients’ social media content.



This includes:



Managing and maintaining multiple client social media calendars

Organizing content so posts are scheduled strategically and consistently

Reviewing captions before they are sent to clients or published

Quality checking social media videos before they go live

Making sure videos feel polished, engaging, and appropriate for the individual brand

Catching editing mistakes, spelling errors, awkward cuts, caption issues, branding inconsistencies, or anything that simply doesn’t feel right

Communicating revision notes to our editing team when changes are needed

Helping make sure content is formatted properly for Instagram,
, Reels, and other social platforms

Keeping track of client approvals, requested changes, and upcoming content

Understanding each client's individual voice so their social media never feels copy-and-paste

Staying aware of current social trends, editing styles, hooks, formats, and platform changes

We’re Looking for Someone Who...



Lives and breathes social media.



You should understand what makes someone stop scrolling, what makes a Reel feel current, when an edit feels dated, when text on screen is too much, when a hook isn't strong enough, and when a piece of content simply needs another pass.



You should also be:



Extremely organized

Detail-oriented

Comfortable managing multiple brands at once

Able to give clear, constructive creative feedback

Familiar with Instagram and
, especially short-form video

Comfortable learning different brand voices

Able to work independently and keep projects moving

Strong with spelling, grammar, and written communication

Comfortable working with social scheduling and approval platforms



Experience with social media management, content creation, video editing, marketing, or a creative agency is a major plus.



About Knightwing Media



Knightwing Media is a photo, video, and creative media company working with brands across a variety of industries. Our content ranges from real estate and hospitality to local businesses, lifestyle brands, commercial clients, and more.



Because our clients are so different, one of the most important parts of this role is understanding that every brand should feel like its own brand.



We aren't looking for someone to slap the same trending audio, caption formula, and editing style onto every account.



We want someone who can look at a piece of content and ask:



Does this actually feel like this client?



If you're naturally the person noticing why one Reel works and another doesn't, saving ideas on Instagram, watching trends evolve, and obsessing over the little details that make content feel polished, we'd love to hear from you.

title: UGC Content Creator — Luxury Travel Brand
description:
UGC Content Creator — Luxury Travel Brand

Part-time to Full-time · Remote · 20–40 hours/week · $5/hour + performance bonuses

Immediate start · Brand launch imminent

 

 

ABOUT THE BRAND

 

We are a luxury travel content brand in the final days before launch. The founder has deep travel experience, a strong personal brand, and a full content library ready to go. We are looking for one exceptional person to help us launch and grow — someone who shows up, pays attention, and takes ownership.

 

Platforms: Instagram (primary), TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube

Content style: Luxury travel, smart travel strategies, real hotel reviews, personal stories

Stage: Imminent launch — sprint mode starts now.

 

 

THE ROLE

 

This is not a task-execution role. We need a creative partner who thinks ahead, catches things others miss, and brings real expertise to the work. You will be producing content, managing platforms, building pitch decks for brand partnerships, and automating workflows using AI.

 

The founder handles filming, brand decisions, approvals, and deal negotiations. You handle everything else — and you handle it well the first time.

 

Hours: 20–40 hours per week. Sprint capacity required immediately — the brand is launching now.

Schedule: Flexible — but morning and evening EST availability is required.

Rate: $5 USD per hour to start.

Launch bonus: Significant performance bonus tied to successful brand launch. This is real — not a talking point.

Growth: Ongoing raises and performance bonuses based on results. This role grows with the brand. The right person grows with it.

Tools provided: Google Workspace, Canva Pro, CapCut — all at no cost to you.

Start: Immediate.

 

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 

1 — UGC Content Creation & Editing

- Edit raw footage into polished Reels — strong hooks, tight pacing, on-brand captions, trending audio.

- Design branded carousels and static graphics from approved copy. On-brand, elevated, never generic.

- Quick turnaround is non-negotiable. Deliver on time, every time.

- When something doesn't look right or match the brief — say so before you produce it, not after.

 

2 — Content Operations

- Write platform-specific captions for IG, TikTok, Pinterest, and YouTube in the creator's voice.

- Build and maintain content briefs, hashtag banks, and keyword lists.

- Schedule and publish content across all platforms.

- Build lead magnet PDFs tied to comment keyword triggers.

- Submit weekly content ideas in a standard format.

 

3 — Brand Partnerships & Pitch Decks

- Research hotel, resort, and brand partnership opportunities.

- Build polished pitch decks for outreach to US-based brands and properties.

- Manage outreach, follow-ups, and partnership pipeline tracking.

- Manage brand presence on UGC platforms — Billo, JoinBrands, 
.

 

4 — AI Automation & Workflow

- Use agentic AI tools to automate content scheduling, posting workflows, and repetitive tasks.

- This goes beyond using ChatGPT to write captions — you know how to build and run automated workflows.

- Document your AI processes so they can be repeated and improved.

 

5 — Social Media Management

- Monitor, respond, and engage across all platforms in the creator's voice.

- Track weekly performance metrics and flag what is working and what is not.

- Stay current on platform trends, algorithm changes, and trending audio.

 

 

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

 

REQUIRED — Extensive UGC experience. You have created UGC content for real brands, worked on UGC platforms, and have a portfolio that proves it. Not just social media management — actual UGC deliverables. No UGC experience means no consideration.

 

REQUIRED — US-based client experience. You have worked with US-based clients and understand the market, the platforms, and the pace.

 

REQUIRED — Pitch deck creation. You have built pitch decks for brand partnerships or business development. You can create a polished, compelling deck from scratch.

 

REQUIRED — Agentic AI fluency. You use AI to build automated workflows, not just to write captions. You can show us specifically how you use it.

 

- Attention to detail — you follow direction the first time. You catch inconsistencies before they become problems. You compare information and flag when something doesn't add up.

- Proactive communication — you push back when something doesn't seem right. You update before you are asked. You never go quiet.

- Quick turnaround — when something needs to go out, it goes out. Launch sprint ready.

- Urban / hip hop cultural fluency — you genuinely live in this space. You know what audio is trending before it peaks. You understand the cultural nuances that make content feel authentic versus forced.

- Deep understanding of the travel industry — you don't need to have traveled everywhere but you need to understand the space. You know the difference between luxury and budget travel, you consume travel content, and you understand why someone chooses one brand over another.

- EST morning and evening availability — flexible schedule but responsive during key windows.

 

 

COMPENSATION & GROWTH

 

Starting rate: $5 USD per hour

Hours: 20–40 per week. Sprint capacity required immediately.

Launch bonus: Significant performance bonus tied to successful brand launch. Specifics discussed at offer stage.

Performance bonuses: Ongoing bonuses based on results — content performance, partnership deals closed, workflow improvements.

Raises: Regular rate reviews based on performance. This role is designed to grow.

Tools: Google Workspace, Canva Pro, CapCut — provided at no cost.

 

 

HOW TO APPLY

 

We read every application carefully. A generic application will not be considered.

 

Your application must include:

 

1. Introduction

Who you are, what you do best, and why this role is the right fit right now. Specific — not generic.

 

2. UGC Experience — REQUIRED

Tell us specifically what UGC work you have done, which brands you worked with, and what the deliverables were. No UGC experience means no consideration — do not skip this.

 

3. US Client Experience — REQUIRED

Which US-based clients have you worked with and what did you produce for them?

 

4. Pitch Deck Experience — REQUIRED

Have you built pitch decks for brand partnerships or business development? Tell us what they were for and share an example if possible.

 

5. AI Automation

Tell us specifically how you use agentic AI to automate workflows. Which tools, which processes, what results. "I use ChatGPT to write captions" is not an answer.

 

6. Portfolio

Show us your Reel editing work, carousel designs, pitch decks, and any automated workflows you have built. Links or attachments — no portfolio, no consideration.

 

7. The brand question

In 2–3 sentences: based on what you know from this posting, what do you think is the single biggest content opportunity for a luxury travel brand right now?

 

8. Availability

Confirm you are available to start immediately and that you have morning and evening EST availability. Tell us specifically when you are typically online.

 

9. Subject line — REQUIRED

Your application subject line must read exactly: "Luxury Travel Brand — UGC VA Application". Applications without this exact subject line will not be reviewed. This is your first attention-to-detail test.

 

 

GREEN FLAGS — We want to see these:

- Your UGC portfolio is strong and specific — real brands, real deliverables, real results.

- You have worked with US-based clients and your work reflects an understanding of the US market.

- You describe your AI automation workflows in specific, technical terms — not vague generalities.

- You reference the travel industry or luxury travel content in your application.

- You catch something in this posting and mention it — a question, an inconsistency, a detail worth flagging.

- You go beyond what we asked for and add something that shows your thinking.

 

RED FLAGS — These will disqualify your application:

- No UGC experience or portfolio.

- No US client experience.

- You have never built a pitch deck.

- "I use AI to help with my work" with no specifics.

- Generic opener with no reference to this brand or this role.

- You took 24+ hours to respond during the application process.

- You need to be asked multiple times before addressing feedback.

 

 

We are building something real in the luxury travel space.

We need someone who catches things others miss — and says so.

If that's you — we want to hear from you.

description:
We are looking for a **creative graphic designer + 2D animator** to work with us on an ongoing basis for our streaming brand.



The immediate project is our **animated “Starting Soon” screen and streaming overlays**, but we are specifically looking for someone we can continue hiring as the brand grows and the designs change.



### FIRST PROJECT



**Phase 1 — Logo Redraw | $25**



* Redraw/refine our existing logo into a cleaner, more professional version.

* You are NOT creating the brand from scratch. We already have the concept and direction.

* Must be able to actually draw and improve existing artwork—not simply use templates.

* We approve the finished logo before moving forward.



**Phase 2 — Temporary Animation | $25**

After the logo is approved, create a simple temporary animated version for our stream while the more detailed official animation is being developed.



This will include basic motion such as **animated/buffering lines and simple logo movement/effects**.



The official Starting Soon animation will be a **separate paid project with its own agreed price.**



### THIS IS RECURRING WORK



We want someone interested in becoming one of our regular designers/animators.

🎃 Halloween = new variation

🎄 Christmas = new variation

🎉 Special events = new variation

🎮 New stream ideas = additions/changes

👕 Brand updates = new graphics or animation changes

Every new request will include the details and proposed price **before you accept the project.** You are always free to accept or decline.

Pricing will change depending on the complexity of each request.



### IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS



You should be strong in:



* Logo drawing/redrawing and refinement

* 2D animation

* Logo animation

* Stream overlays and graphics

* Looping animations

* Working from references and detailed creative direction

* Editing and expanding your own previous work

* Keeping artwork visually consistent across future versions



**SOURCE FILES ARE REQUIRED FOR EVERY PROJECT.**



All editable/source files must be delivered with completed work. This is important because the artwork will continuously evolve and may need to be modified in future projects.



We value **communication, reliability, creativity, and consistency** more than fancy sales pitches.



When applying, please send examples of your **logo design/redrawing, 2D animation, logo animation, stream overlays, or similar work.**



You do NOT need to write a huge application. Show us what you can do.



Additional details about the Starting Soon screen, animation concept, branding, references, and future workflow will be explained to applicants we are interested in.



**If you have questions, ask. We would rather clear something up before starting than have someone guess our direction.**



If the relationship works well, expect **recurring paid projects as the streaming brand continues to evolve.**

title: Packaging & Brand Designer (E-Commerce / DTC)
description:
NOTE: DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT ADDING YOUR PORTFOLIO. APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A PORTFOLIO LINK WILL BE SKIPPED.



GENERIC AI-GENERATED DESIGN WORK WILL BE SKIPPED. AI can be used as part of your process, but we’re looking for someone with strong taste and real design ability who thoughtfully creates the final work.



JOIN MYSWATCHES



We’re looking for a talented Packaging & Brand Designer to help bring the MySwatches brand to life across our physical products and customer experience.



We’re looking for someone with a strong eye for branding, packaging, print design, typography, color, and physical presentation.



You’ll help us design everything our customers see when their MySwatches order arrives, from the box itself to inserts, thank-you cards, seasonal packaging, and future product packaging.



We want someone who can take our existing brand and make it feel more polished, recognizable, premium, and exciting to receive.



WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON



Projects may include:



Designing our shipping and product packaging

Creating thank-you cards, inserts, instruction cards, and other printed materials

Designing special edition and seasonal packaging, including Christmas and holiday boxes

Working with dielines and adapting designs for different packaging formats

Creating mockups so we can visualize concepts before production



We’re not looking for someone who just places our logo on a box.



We want someone who thinks about the entire unboxing experience, what the customer sees first, how the packaging feels, where information should go, how everything works together, and what will make the package feel special when it arrives.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You have strong taste and experience designing physical brand materials, ideally for DTC, beauty, fashion, lifestyle, cosmetics, or consumer products.



You should be comfortable taking a relatively open brief and developing several strong creative directions rather than needing every design decision explained to you.



Ideally, you have:



A strong portfolio of packaging and brand design

Experience designing packaging for physical consumer products

Strong typography, composition, color, and branding skills

Experience creating print-ready production files

Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, or similar professional design software

Experience creating realistic packaging mockups

Strong attention to detail

Strong written English and communication skills

The ability to take feedback and revise quickly



Experience working with DTC, beauty, fashion, cosmetics, gifting, or female-focused brands is a major plus.



Experience communicating with printers or packaging manufacturers and understanding production limitations is also highly valuable.



ABOUT MYSWATCHES



MySwatches is a personal color analysis brand helping women discover the colors that flatter them most.



Our professional color analysts determine each customer’s personal color palette, and we send them physical cards featuring their colors.



Our hero product, the Swatch Card, makes it simple for customers to know which colors to wear and look for while shopping.



As we grow, we want the physical experience of receiving MySwatches to feel just as special as the product itself.



ROLE DETAILS



This is a remote contract position with ongoing design opportunities.



We’re initially looking for help with several packaging and print projects, including thank-you cards, our standard packaging, Christmas boxes, and other branded materials.



There is potential for ongoing work as we launch new products and continue developing the MySwatches brand.



Compensation will be based on experience, portfolio, and scope of work.



Applications without a portfolio link will be skipped.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a paid design test or small initial project.

Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Eastern Time (EST)

Schedule: 40 hours/week 

Growth Opportunity: Performance-based increases 



About Us 



We are a boutique travel agency based in Atlanta, GA (EST). We specialize in luxury river cruises — especially Viking and now AmaWaterways — and offer white-glove support for discerning clients. 

 

We're warm, organized, and passionate about creating unforgettable cruise experiences. Our team is small, collaborative, and committed to doing things right. 

 

We have documented processes (SOPs) for most tasks, so you won't be guessing. You'll be trained and supported, not thrown into the deep end. 

 

We're looking for a talented Virtual Assistant to join us full-time. 

 

Before You Apply: 



This Role Is Likely a Great Fit If: 



You have cruise guest services experience or strong travel booking experience 



You have supported luxury or high-touch clients 



You enjoy detailed administrative work 



You want a stable, long-term remote position 



You can confidently communicate with senior clients 



You take ownership of your work and ask questions when needed 



DO NOT Apply If: 



Your experience is limited to general hospitality roles such as bartending, serving, retail, or unrelated customer service positions 



You are not comfortable speaking with clients on the phone, and couldn't be understood clearly with senior & elderly clients.



You are looking for freelance, temporary, or part-time work 



You cannot commit to U.S. Eastern Time business hours 



You submit generic applications without reviewing the requirements (we can always tell which is AI--all cover letters have the same phrases! Just be yourself).

 



Role Snapshot 



As our Virtual Assistant, you'll be responsible for: 



Speaking with clients on the phone 



Drafting client emails (hold reminders, confirmation, follow-ups, courtesy responses, answer inquiries) 



Updating HubSpot CRM and internal trackers — keeping booking statuses, contact details, and notes current 



Calling Viking Cruises and clients to verify information, request itineraries, or resolve booking questions 



Supporting the CEO and team with high-level administrative tasks 



Managing booking coordination from inquiry through post-travel follow-up 



Expectation:  



You'll work directly with our staff as internal support — not as an independent agent. 



Guest/client emails are drafts for review. 



You'll have autonomy for routine messages, with clear guidance on when to escalate (pricing, payments, sensitive situations). 



Some responses require an empathetic, reassuring tone; others follow standard templates. 



You'll be trained on our systems (HubSpot, booking trackers, Outlook) and supported by an experienced team invested in your success. 

 



Who We're Looking For 



Must-Have Qualifications 



Experience in cruise guest services, travel bookings, or itinerary  



Excellent spoken and written English with a warm, polished, professional tone 



Comfortable speaking with clients on the phone 



Ability to work independently and manage detailed tasks remotely 



High attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability 



Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace 



Executive Assistant experience involving complex travel coordination may also qualify. 



Bonus Points 



River cruise experience 



Familiarity with Viking or AmaWaterways 



Experience using the MyViking Journey (MVJ) Travel Advisor Portal or AmaWaterways 



HubSpot CRM experience (or fast learner with CRMs) 



Experience with booking portals, invoices, or guest information systems 



Strong time management and comfort with documented SOP 



Schedule 



Target Hours: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST 



For applicants in the Philippines, this is an evening/night shift schedule. Please ensure this works for you before applying. 



Hours may vary based on business needs. 



Saturday coverage may occasionally be required after training and will be handled through team rotation. 



How to Apply 



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed. We use this process to assess attention to detail, communication skills, and genuine interest in the role. 



Step 1 



Include the phrase: "Smooth Sailing" in your subject line or opening sentence. 



Step 2 



Submit a 1–2 minute video introduction (Required). Applications without a video introduction will not be reviewed. 



Your video should: 



Explain your relevant cruise guest services or travel booking experience 



Share why you're passionate about travel support or river cruising 



Describe what excites you about working with a team like ours 



Step 3 



Attach your resume/CV. (If using Google Drive, ensure access is granted) 



We're excited to meet someone who genuinely cares about delivering excellent travel service and wants to grow with a supportive team. 



If that sounds like you — smooth sailing ahead. 

(Please note, due to the volume of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted)

title: Real Estate Research & Data Specialist
description:
Online Research | Data Verification | Opportunity Research



I am a Houston, Texas REALTOR® seeking a highly organized, accurate, resourceful, and detail-oriented Real Estate Research & Data Specialist to support the research and information needs of my real estate business.



This position is primarily focused on online research, data gathering, verification, monitoring, spreadsheet management, and maintaining useful business information.



I am looking for someone who knows how to research beyond the first search result. Strong candidates will know how to investigate information, verify accuracy, identify inconsistencies, notice meaningful details and changes, and organize findings in a way that is easy to understand and use.



This is a strong fit for someone who genuinely enjoys research and is comfortable spending significant time finding, checking, organizing, updating, and maintaining information.



Prior U.S. residential real estate experience is helpful, but not required. Strong research ability, honesty, accuracy, judgment, organization, and reliability are more important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Responsibilities may include:



Conducting detailed online research using public sources

Building and maintaining organized research databases, trackers, and spreadsheets

Gathering and verifying property, market, business, professional, community, and local information

Researching people, businesses, organizations, events, resources, and opportunities based on specific criteria

Monitoring assigned information for changes and updates

Maintaining accurate source links and verification dates

Identifying duplicate, inconsistent, incomplete, outdated, or questionable information

Comparing multiple sources when information conflicts

Organizing research so that it is easy to review, filter, and use

Identifying relevant patterns, changes, deadlines, connections, and opportunities within researched information

Maintaining recurring research projects after the initial research has been completed

Completing special research projects as assigned

Providing concise updates that highlight meaningful findings without requiring review of every individual research entry



The scope of the research will evolve as you learn the business and demonstrate your ability to produce accurate, useful work.



RESEARCH STANDARD



I am looking for research, not copy-and-paste data collection.



You should be comfortable going deeper when necessary, determining whether information is current, using reliable sources, checking multiple sources when appropriate, and clearly identifying information that cannot be verified.



You should understand the difference between finding information and producing useful information.



Accuracy matters. Never guess simply to complete a field.



When information conflicts, is unclear, or cannot be confidently verified, document the issue and ask when appropriate.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Strong performance means your research is accurate, properly sourced, organized, current, and easy to use.



Recurring research should be completed consistently. Important changes and time-sensitive information should be identified. Useful findings should be surfaced clearly. Research should require minimal correction or cleanup.



As you learn the business, you should become better at recognizing relevant patterns, connections, changes, and opportunities within the information you research.



The goal is for your work to save time and make meaningful information easier to identify and use.



Quality, accuracy, relevance, and usability matter more than simply producing a large number of entries.



QUALIFICATIONS



You may be a strong fit if you:



Enjoy researching and investigating information online

Are naturally curious and resourceful

Have strong attention to detail

Enjoy working with spreadsheets and structured information

Can perform repetitive research without sacrificing accuracy

Notice inconsistencies and changes

Think about whether information is actually useful

Can follow detailed instructions

Work independently after learning a process

Keep recurring work organized

Verify information before making assumptions

Communicate clearly when something is uncertain

Are dependable with deadlines

Are interested in learning about U.S. residential real estate



Strong written English is required.



Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, Google Workspace, online research, data entry, data cleaning, database research, market research, contact research, web research, or data verification is valuable.



POSITION STRUCTURE



This position may begin part-time while work quality, accuracy, reliability, and productivity are established. Full-time is preferred and the right fit can grow into a full-time position rather quickly.  There is potential to grow into additional hours, including full-time work, based on demonstrated ability, performance, contribution, and business needs.



I am interested in someone seeking a long-term opportunity who can eventually take ownership of recurring research responsibilities once they are learned.



COMPENSATION



Starting compensation: $3.25–$3.75 USD per hour, based on experience and demonstrated ability.



There may be opportunities for increased hours and future compensation growth based on performance, reliability, productivity, contribution, and expanded responsibilities.



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer all questions below in your own words, no AI.  Specific examples are strongly preferred.



1. Tell me about a research assignment where the information you needed was difficult to find or verify. What were you researching, what steps did you take, and how did you determine that the information you found was reliable?



2. You are researching something for me and find conflicting information from multiple websites. How would you d
 what information to use and what to report to me?



3. You find 30 possible results for a research assignment, but I do not have time to review all 30. How would you determine which findings deserve my attention, and what information would you include so I can quickly understand why they matter?



4. Tell me about a time you noticed an error, pattern, connection, change, or useful piece of information that you were not specifically asked to find. What did you notice, and what did you do with it?



5. What research, spreadsheet, database, or data-management experience do you have? Please describe the type of work you performed, the approximate amount of information you managed, and what you were personally responsible for maintaining.



6. Please provide your available hours per week and your normal working hours in both Philippine Time and U.S. Central Time. The starting compensation is $3.25–$3.75 USD per hour. Please confirm that this is acceptable and state your requested starting rate within this range.



7. Please attach your résumé and, if available, one example of a spreadsheet, research project, tracker, database, or similar work that demonstrates your research and organization skills. Remove all confidential or private information before sharing.



8. Please include a 1–3 minute video introduction. Briefly introduce yourself and answer the following question:



What makes research genuinely useful to the person receiving it, rather than simply a collection of information?



Please provide a working video link that can be viewed without requesting access.



Applications that do not answer all required questions or include the requested résumé and video may not be considered.

You will be responsible for finding potential customers, contacting them, following up with them, keeping every opportunity organized, and helping move prospects through our sales process until they become customers.



Your Responsibilities



You will own the front end of our sales pipeline, including:

s

s you sent

Who We Want

IMPORTANT: How to Apply



We do not want a generic application.



To apply, send:

s.

We care about how you communicate and sell yourself.

“I WILL HELP STEADY STATE GET NEW CLIENTS.”

. For commercial electrical, I don’t want this person hiding behind a computer sending 300 generic

title: Part-Time UK Property & Tenancy Coordinator
description:
We are a UK landlord with an established residential property portfolio and plans to expand. We are looking for a highly organised, dependable Property & Tenancy Coordinator to take ownership of tenancy administration, tenant communication, licensing records and compliance deadlines.



The main objective is to build and maintain an auditable property-management system. We should be able to see what needed doing, what was done, when, by whom and the supporting evidence. You will be expected to identify missing information and upcoming obligations proactively, use current authoritative guidance and escalate uncertainties.



Key responsibilities



• Handle tenant enquiries and maintain dated records of issues, actions and outcomes.

• Repairs administration: maintain a dated record of tenant repair reports, photographs, decisions, appointments and outcomes. Obtain initial information, prepare drafts, coordinate tenant access when instructed and follow up for completion evidence. The landlord will normally select contractors, discuss work directly and approve quotations and expenditure. You will contact contractors or arrange work only when instructed or under an agreed routine procedure.

• Administer routine compliance appointments, such as annual gas-safety checks, using approved contractors and documented procedures. Escalate failures, remedial work, costs and uncertainties.

• Maintain accurate property and tenancy files, certificates, inspection records and compliance reminders.

• Check licensing requirements with the relevant local council; prepare applications and renewals, track licence conditions and retain evidence.

• Coordinate arrears follow-up using payment information supplied by our finance colleague.

• Prepare approved tenant letters, rent-review paperwork and draft formal notices for the landlord's review.

• Monitor relevant changes, including Renters' Rights Act processes and government rental-property registration requirements as they become applicable.

• Provide a concise weekly report covering outstanding matters, upcoming deadlines and decisions required.



New lettings and tenancy setup



When a property needs letting, you will coordinate advertising, enquiries, local viewings, referencing, Right to Rent checks, current tenancy documentation, deposit administration, prescribed information and move-in arrangements.



You will develop and maintain a checklist using current NRLA, 
 and relevant council guidance, tailored to each property and tenancy. Every step should identify its deadline, responsible person, required evidence, completion date and any approval needed.



Systems and resources



We have NRLA membership, including guidance, templates, checklists and access to advice, as well as other landlord resources. We are considering NRLA Portfolio but have not yet selected or configured the final management system.



Routine physical letters may be sent remotely using an approved service. Serious legal documents will be reviewed and handled by the landlord, with copies, posting evidence and follow-up retained in the records.



Potential future responsibility



If we develop a “sell my house quickly” enquiry portal, the role may later include maintaining records of homeowners contacted, setting follow-up reminders, preparing and sending approved follow-ups, and flagging enquiries requiring the landlord's attention. Tenancy management, licensing and compliance will remain the main priorities, and hours will be reviewed if this additional work grows.



Experience and working arrangements



Direct experience supporting UK landlords or letting agencies—particularly English residential tenancies—is strongly preferred. Excellent written English, careful record-keeping, initiative, sound judgement and reliable follow-through are essential.



The initial commitment is approximately 15 hours per week, spread across weekdays with some UK working-hours overlap. Additional agreed hours may be available during the initial portfolio setup, new lettings and major compliance projects. Further support may also be needed as government rental-property registration requirements are introduced, including preparing information, registering the landlord and relevant properties, retaining evidence and maintaining or renewing records in line with current guidance.



Pay is US$5 per hour.



The landlord will approve tenants, rents, contractors, significant expenditure, remedial works and formal legal action. Local contractors or agents will handle physical visits and works. You must recognise when specialist or legal advice is required.



To apply, please answer these questions:



1. Describe your direct experience with UK residential property, landlords or letting agencies. Which tenancy and compliance tasks have you personally handled?

2. How would you create an auditable system showing each obligation, deadline, responsible person, evidence and completion date?

3. If asked whether a property needs a council licence, how would you research and document the answer?

4. Give an example of a repair, tenant issue or compliance matter that you followed through from first report to verified completion.

5. What hours can you work, and what UK-hours overlap can you provide?



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a short paid practical assessment.

title: Senior Accountant — Multi-Entity Month-End Close & General Ledger (Big 4 / US National Firm Audit Background Required)
description:
READ THIS FIRST

This is an accountant role, not a bookkeeping role.



If your experience is categorizing transactions in QuickBooks, entering bills, chasing receipts, or running payroll — this is not the job for you, and we will not reply. We are hiring someone who has owned a general ledger, driven a close calendar, prepared the schedules an auditor asked for, and been the person who explains why an account moved.



If that describes you, keep reading.



About the Company

We are a California-based, multi-location retail and production company:



~10 plus retail locations plus cultivation and manufacturing/distribution facilities

~25 legal entities under common ownership, including operating companies, real estate holding entities, and management companies

We operate in the licensed cannabis industry. This is a fully legal, state-licensed business in California, but it is a heavily regulated, cash-intensive industry with unusual tax treatment (IRC §280E), excise and sales tax obligations to the CDTFA, and seed-to-sale tracking requirements. If working in this industry is a problem for you personally or professionally, please do not apply.



You will report directly to the Controller. This is a senior, high-trust seat with real ownership — not a production role in a large stack of accountants.



What You'll Own

Full-cycle month-end close across multiple entities: close calendar, journal entries, accruals, prepaids, deferred items, reclasses, and close binder

General ledger ownership — chart of accounts integrity, account mapping, recurring entries, and making sure the GL actually reflects operations

Balance sheet reconciliations with real supporting schedules for every material account — not tick-and-tie theater

Bank and cash reconciliations in a high-volume, cash-intensive environment across multiple accounts and locations

Intercompany accounting and eliminations — due to/due from, management fees, allocations, and consolidation across the entity group

Inventory and COGS reconciliation — tying POS/inventory system data (BLAZE) to the GL, investigating variances, and standing behind the COGS number

Fixed assets — additions, disposals, depreciation schedules, CIP rollforward, and tie-out to the fixed asset register

Revenue reconciliation — daily sales, discounts, excise and sales tax, and payment settlement tie-outs by location

AP and AR oversight — reviewing and controlling the work, not doing the data entry

Financial statements and variance analysis — monthly P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow by entity and consolidated, with flux commentary that explains the "why"

Audit, review, and tax support — preparing PBC schedules and workpapers for our outside CPA firm and responding to their requests without hand-holding

Process and controls — documenting the close, tightening cutoffs, and identifying where the current process is weak



Hard Requirements

Applications that do not meet these will not be reviewed.



Audit experience with a Big 4 firm — SGV & Co. (EY), Isla Lipana & Co. (PwC), R.G. Manabat & Co. (KPMG), or Navarro Amper & Co. (Deloitte). If not Big 4, then audit experience with a US national or large international firm (e.g., RSM, BDO, Grant Thornton, Crowe, Baker Tilly, P&A Grant Thornton, Reyes Tacandong). Please name the firm, your title, and your dates.

Hands-on general ledger experience — you have owned a GL, not just fed one.

Full-cycle month-end close experience — you have run a close from trial balance through to reviewed financial statements, on a deadline.

Bachelor of Science in Accountancy (BSA) from a CHED-recognized school. (BS Finance or a related degree will be considered only where the rest of the profile is exceptional.)

CPA (PRC-licensed) strongly preferred. If you are not yet licensed, you must be a BSA graduate who has sat for the CPALE or is formally scheduled to sit for it — tell us your status and your target sitting.

Excellent written and spoken English. You will be on video calls with US ownership and with our outside CPA firm.

Advanced Excel / Google Sheets — pivots, lookups, index-match, large-file discipline, and clean, reviewable workpaper structure.



Strongly Preferred

Experience with multi-entity consolidations and intercompany eliminations

US GAAP exposure (not just PFRS/IFRS)

Retail, restaurant, hospitality, or multi-location operations accounting

Inventory-heavy or COGS-driven business experience

Familiarity with QuickBooks Online and with AP automation platforms

Any exposure to US state and local tax filings, or to IRC §280E



Schedule

Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday

Minimum 4 hours of daily overlap with 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Pacific Time

Heavier overlap expected during close week (roughly the first 10 business days of the month) and training

This is a long-term role. We are not looking for short-term project help.



How to Apply

Applications that ignore these instructions are automatically rejected. This is intentional — it's the first test.



Start your message with the word: LEDGER



Then answer these four questions in a video link directly in your application. Short, specific answers. Do not send a generic cover letter.



Which audit firm did you work for, what was your title, and what were your start and end dates?

How many legal entities have you closed in a single monthly cycle, and how many days did the close take from period end to issued financials?

Walk me through one balance sheet account you reconciled monthly — what the schedule looked like and what you did when it didn't tie.

What is your CPA status? (Licensed and PRC number / passed CPALE / scheduled to sit — and when.)

Please attach your CV and state your expected monthly rate in USD.



We move fast on strong candidates. Shortlisted applicants will do a short paid test — a real reconciliation with real messy data — followed by a video interview with ownership.

title: Full-Time WFH Customer Success and Retention Manager — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Business Loan Sales Consultant / Closer — Warm Leads — AU Day Shift
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Have you sold business loans, mortgages, asset finance or insurance? Bring your closing experience to Ezy Pzy Finance and help Australian business owners access funding.

We also welcome proven sales professionals from other industries who can demonstrate consistent target achievement and experience closing business over the phone.

You’ll receive warm enquiries, product training, weekly coaching and the opportunity to earn commission on both new and repeat clients.





YOUR EARNING OPPORTUNITY



•During probation: AUD $500/week + commissions + bonuses (approx. ₱97,500/month fixed base). After 8 weeks probation: AUD $650/week including PhilCare allowance + commissions (approx. ₱126,750/month fixed pay).

• Our agents currently average AUD $5,200/month (₱234,000/month) in total earnings including commissions and monthly bonuses.

• Earn between AUD $100 - $800 (approximately ₱4,500–₱36,000) commission per deal..

• Repeat business stays with you: when a client you funded returns for more funding, you handle their next deal and earn commission again.

• Earn additional monthly performance bonuses based on KPI’s achieved.

After your two-month probation, benefits include the base salary increase, an HMO allowance, paid annual and sick leave, and access to higher bonus tiers.





WHO WE ARE



Ezy Pzy Finance is a fast growing Australian business finance company connecting business owners with a panel of non-bank lenders.

We’re growing our remote sales team and looking for consultants who combine strong closing skills with clear communication and disciplined follow-up.

Learn more: 





WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Call Australian business owners who have already expressed interest in funding.

• Understand their business, funding needs and timing.

• Qualify enquiries and guide clients through the application process.

• Explain available options clearly, handle objections and move deals towards settlement.

• Keep your pipeline organised and follow up consistently.

• Build relationships that generate repeat business.



Warm leads are provided. There is no cold prospecting or list building, but the role involves regular outbound calls and persistent follow-up.





WHO SHOULD APPLY



You have at least two years of phone-based sales experience and have personally been responsible for closing sales and achieving targets.



We particularly welcome sales experience in:



• Business lending or merchant cash advance campaigns.

• Australian or US mortgage and asset finance.

• Insurance, debt solutions or other financial products.



Successful closers from other industries are also encouraged to apply. Show us what you sold, your targets, your results and your role in winning the business.



You should be able to:



• Build trust and communicate confidently in spoken English.

• Run a discovery conversation and ask useful follow-up questions.

• Explain products clearly and handle objections professionally.

• Own your pipeline, maintain accurate records and follow through.

• Learn new products and apply coaching.



Finance processing, customer service or appointment-setting experience is useful, but you must also demonstrate personal closing experience.





TRAINING AND SUPPORT



Your first four weeks include structured product and sales training, with an initial focus on smaller loan facilities up to approximately A$30,000.

You’ll progress to larger deals as you meet quality and settlement milestones, supported by weekly one-to-one sales coaching.





SCHEDULE AND SETUP



• Monday–Friday, 6:30am–4:30pm Philippine time.

• One-hour lunch break; 45 working hours/week.

• Fully remote, with evenings free.

• Reliable computer, internet connection and backup internet/power arrangements required.





HOW TO APPLY



Incomplete applications will not be considered. Complete applications get a response within 48 hours.

Provide ALL 5 of the following:

A short video (3–5 minutes, Loom / Google Drive / unlisted YouTube link) in two parts:



Part 1 — introduce yourself, your sales experience, and the results/KPIs you achieved (numbers, not adjectives).



Part 2 — a 2-minute mock opening of a discovery call: pretend you’ve just dialled an Australian business owner from Ezy Pzy Finance — do your opening, build rapport, and start qualifying them for funding.



- Link to your resume.

- Screenshots of your DISC assessment and IQ test results (tests available at 
/testcontent).

- Screenshot of your internet speed test, provider, and PC/laptop specs.

- Your backup internet and power solutions.

- Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a Zoom interview, including a live discovery-call role-play.





If you’re a top performing sales professional and have the self drive to earn big commissions and grow in a company that is focused on long term success, then submit your application and we’ll see if we’re a good fit to work together.
